title.en: HKTVmall Support Assistant Identifier Exposure Review
title.zh: HKTVmall 客服助理識別碼外洩檢視

brief.en: You are an AI engineer in an independent demo for HKTVmall style e-commerce support. A fictional customer-support assistant reply exposed unnecessary identifiers. Review the invented policy, log and configuration records, choose the corrected setting, calculate the monthly saving, and write a 120 to 160 English word handover or comparable Traditional Chinese. All policies, staff and records are fictional learning assumptions. This demo is not endorsed by HKTV Group and is not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你在一項獨立示範中擔任 AI 工程師，情境為 HKTVmall 風格電子商貿客服。一個虛構客服助理回覆外洩了不必要的識別碼。請檢視虛構政策、日誌及設定記錄，選出修正設定，計算每月節省金額，並撰寫 120 至 160 英文詞或相若中文的交接說明。所有政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此示範未獲 HKTV 集團認可，亦非招聘職位。

title.zh: 虛構客服回覆政策 v3

body.en: Fictional policy for this demo only. The support assistant may confirm order status and delivery window. It must not repeat full customer identifiers in replies. Masked identifiers are allowed only when the customer asks for account verification. The assistant must never include full phone numbers, full email addresses or full order identifiers in any reply. Masking means showing only the last four characters. Policy v3 replaced v2 on 1 September. All records are invented for learning.
body.zh: 此政策僅為本示範而虛構。客服助理可確認訂單狀態及送貨時段。回覆中不得重複完整客戶識別碼。只有在客戶要求帳戶驗證時，才可使用遮蔽識別碼。助理在任何回覆中不得包含完整電話號碼、完整電郵地址或完整訂單識別碼。遮蔽指只顯示最後四個字元。政策 v3 於 9 月 1 日取代 v2。所有記錄均為學習而虛構。

body.en: Fictional log for this demo. Case A100: reply included full phone number 9123 4567. Case A101: reply included full email ada.cheung@example.com. Case A102: reply included full order identifier HKTV-88213. Case A103: reply included masked phone ending 4567 after the customer asked for account verification. Case A104: reply confirmed delivery window only. Each case is one reply. The log covers 5 replies in one month. All records are invented for learning.
body.zh: 此日誌僅為本示範而虛構。個案 A100：回覆包含完整電話號碼 9123 4567。個案 A101：回覆包含完整電郵 ada.cheung@example.com。個案 A102：回覆包含完整訂單識別碼 HKTV-88213。個案 A103：客戶要求帳戶驗證後，回覆包含以 4567 結尾的遮蔽電話。個案 A104：回覆只確認送貨時段。每個個案為一次回覆。日誌涵蓋一個月內 5 次回覆。所有記錄均為學習而虛構。

body.en: Fictional configuration for this demo. Setting S1: repeat full identifiers in replies. Setting S2: mask all identifiers in all replies. Setting S3: mask identifiers only when the customer asks for account verification, otherwise omit identifiers. Setting S4: omit all identifiers in all replies. The team wants the lowest estimated monthly identifier exposure count while still allowing masked identifiers for account verification. Exposure count means replies containing full identifiers. All settings are invented for learning.
body.zh: 此設定僅為本示範而虛構。設定 S1：在回覆中重複完整識別碼。設定 S2：在所有回覆中遮蔽所有識別碼。設定 S3：只在客戶要求帳戶驗證時遮蔽識別碼，否則省略識別碼。設定 S4：在所有回覆中省略所有識別碼。團隊希望在仍允許帳戶驗證時使用遮蔽識別碼的前提下，達到最低的每月估計識別碼外洩次數。外洩次數指包含完整識別碼的回覆數。所有設定均為學習而虛構。

label.en: Which setting best meets the team goal?
label.zh: 哪項設定最符合團隊目標？

label.en: S2: mask all identifiers in all replies
label.zh: S2：所有回覆遮蔽所有識別碼

label.en: S3: mask only for account verification, otherwise omit
label.zh: S3：只在帳戶驗證時遮蔽，否則省略

label.en: S4: omit all identifiers in all replies
label.zh: S4：所有回覆省略所有識別碼

label.en: How many logged replies contain full identifiers?
label.zh: 日誌中有多少次回覆包含完整識別碼？

label.en: Which policy version applies to the log month?
label.zh: 日誌月份適用哪個政策版本？

label.en: Which case shows allowed masked identifier use?
label.zh: 哪個個案顯示允許的遮蔽識別碼使用？

label.en: If each exposed reply costs HKD 40 to remediate, what is the estimated monthly saving when exposure drops from 3 replies to 0 replies?
label.zh: 若每次外洩回覆的補救成本為 40 港元，當外洩由 3 次回覆降至 0 次回覆，估計每月節省多少？

description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，英文 120 至 160 詞或相若中文，並包含下一步。

description.en: States the exposure count and monthly saving with correct units.
description.zh: 以正確單位說明外洩次數及每月節省金額。

expectedEvidence.en: Exposure count is 3 replies (A100, A101, A102). Saving is 3 times HKD 40 equals HKD 120.
expectedEvidence.zh: 外洩次數為 3 次回覆（A100、A101、A102）。節省為 3 乘 40 港元等於 120 港元。

description.en: Identifies what the records do not show and states a reasonable assumption.
description.zh: 指出記錄未顯示的內容並說明合理假設。

expectedEvidence.zh: 指出日誌只涵蓋一個月內 5 次回覆，未顯示其他月份或渠道，因此節省屬估計。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，英文 120 至 160 詞或相若中文，並包含下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states the corrected setting, policy version, exposure count, saving and a regression test plan such as replaying cases A100 to A104.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明指出修正設定、政策版本、外洩次數、節省金額，以及回歸測試計劃，例如重播個案 A100 至 A104。

description.en: Respects the masking rule and does not propose exposing identifiers.
description.zh: 遵守遮蔽規則，不建議外洩識別碼。

expectedEvidence.en: States masked identifiers are allowed only for account verification and full identifiers must never appear in replies.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出遮蔽識別碼只在帳戶驗證時允許，完整識別碼絕不得出現在回覆中。

exemplar.en: Handover for the HKTVmall style support assistant review. Evidence: source-config shows S3 masks identifiers only for account verification and otherwise omits them, which meets the goal of lowest exposure while keeping verification. Source-policy shows v3 applies from 1 September, so v3 governs the log month. Source-log shows cases A100, A101 and A102 contained full identifiers, so exposure count is 3 replies. Case A103 used a masked phone after a verification request, which is allowed. Saving: 3 replies times HKD 40 equals HKD 120 per month. Uncertainty: the log covers only 5 replies in one month, so this is an estimate and other channels are unseen. Next steps: set S3, replay cases A100 to A104 as a regression test, and confirm no full identifiers appear.
exemplar.zh: HKTVmall 風格客服助理檢視交接說明。證據：source-config 顯示 S3 只在帳戶驗證時遮蔽識別碼，否則省略，符合在保留驗證功能下達至最低外洩的目標。source-policy 顯示 v3 自 9 月 1 日適用，故日誌月份由 v3 規管。source-log 顯示個案 A100、A101 及 A102 包含完整識別碼，故外洩次數為 3 次回覆。個案 A103 在驗證要求後使用遮蔽電話，屬允許做法。節省：3 次回覆乘 40 港元等於每月 120 港元。不確定性：日誌只涵蓋一個月內 5 次回覆，故屬估計，其他渠道未見。下一步：設定 S3，重播個案 A100 至 A104 作回歸測試，並確認沒有完整識別碼出現。

title.zh: 送貨時段助理：過時的營運限制

brief.en: You are an AI engineer in an independent demo for HKTVmall style e-commerce. A customer-facing delivery-slot assistant still applies an old operating constraint, so it hides valid evening slots. Read the three fictional sources, identify the stale rule, choose the corrected configuration, and calculate the weekly slot gain. Then write a 120 to 160 English word handover or comparable Traditional Chinese. Policies, staff and records here are invented for learning.
brief.zh: 你在一項獨立示範中擔任 AI 工程師，情境為 HKTVmall 式電子商貿。一個面向客戶的送貨時段助理仍套用舊營運限制，因而隱藏了有效的晚間時段。請閱讀三份虛構文件，找出過時規則，選出修正設定，並計算每週時段增幅。然後撰寫120至160英文字或相若篇幅的繁體中文交接說明。此處政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。

managerRole.zh: 客戶人工智能營運團隊主管

body.en: The delivery-slot assistant reads one operating constraint file. Version 7 of the file sets the evening cutoff at 18:00 and hides any slot starting at or after that time. Version 8, approved on 3 March, moves the evening cutoff to 21:00. The assistant still loads version 7. Each weekday has 4 evening slots between 18:00 and 21:00. Saturday and Sunday each have 6 evening slots in the same window. No other slot type is affected.
body.zh: 送貨時段助理讀取一份營運限制檔案。該檔案第7版把晚間截單時間設為18:00，並隱藏任何於該時間或之後開始的時段。第8版於3月3日獲批，把晚間截單時間改為21:00。助理目前仍載入第7版。每個平日於18:00至21:00之間有4個晚間時段。星期六及星期日於同一時段各有6個晚間時段。其他時段類型不受影響。

body.en: The synthetic weekly record lists evening slots for one fulfilment week. Monday to Friday each show 4 evening slots. Saturday shows 6 evening slots. Sunday shows 6 evening slots. The record states that all listed evening slots are valid and bookable. It also states that the assistant currently displays none of them because of the loaded constraint version. No slot is cancelled and no slot is added by this record.
body.zh: 這份虛構每週記錄列出一個履約週的晚間時段。星期一至五各顯示4個晚間時段。星期六顯示6個晚間時段。星期日顯示6個晚間時段。記錄註明所有列出的晚間時段均有效並可預訂。記錄亦註明，由於所載入的限制版本，助理目前沒有顯示其中任何時段。此記錄沒有取消任何時段，亦沒有新增任何時段。

body.en: Log entry 41 states that version 8 was approved on 3 March and that version 7 is stale. Log entry 42 states that the assistant must load version 8 and must show evening slots starting before 21:00. Log entry 43 states that a regression test must confirm that all valid evening slots appear and that no morning or afternoon slot changes. Log entry 44 states that the test must run before release. The log does not approve any other change.
body.zh: 日誌第41項指出第8版於3月3日獲批，而第7版已過時。日誌第42項指出助理必須載入第8版，並須顯示於21:00之前開始的晚間時段。日誌第43項指出回歸測試必須確認所有有效晚間時段均出現，且上午或下午時段沒有變動。日誌第44項指出測試必須在發布前執行。日誌沒有批准任何其他變更。

label.en: Which constraint version is stale and must be replaced?
label.zh: 哪個限制版本已過時並須被取代？

label.en: What evening cutoff must the assistant apply after the fix?
label.zh: 修正後助理必須套用哪個晚間截單時間？

label.en: How many valid evening slots per week become visible after loading version 8?
label.zh: 載入第8版後，每週有多少個有效晚間時段會變為可見？

label.en: Which checks belong in the regression test? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些檢查屬於回歸測試？選出所有適用者。
所有有效晚間時段均出現

label.en: Morning and afternoon slots are unchanged
label.zh: 上午及下午時段沒有變動

expectedEvidence.en: The log approves no other change. The record adds and cancels no slots. No source confirms other assistant behaviour. Accept any statement that limits claims to the three sources.

expectedEvidence.en: Handover meets the stated 120 to 160 English word target or comparable Traditional Chinese length and covers evidence, decision, calculation and next steps.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接達到英文120至160字或相若繁體中文篇幅，並涵蓋證據、決策、計算及下一步。

exemplar.en: Evidence: source one shows the assistant still loads version 7, whose 18:00 evening cutoff hides slots. Version 8, approved on 3 March, moves the cutoff to 21:00. Source three log entry 41 confirms version 7 is stale and entry 42 requires version 8. Decision: load version 8 and show evening slots starting before 21:00. Calculation: Monday to Friday give 5 times 4 equals 20 slots. Saturday and Sunday give 6 plus 6 equals 12 slots. Weekly total is 20 plus 12 equals 32 slots. Risks: no source approves other changes, and the record adds or cancels no slots. Next steps: run the regression test before release, confirming all valid evening slots appear and morning and afternoon slots are unchanged.
exemplar.zh: 證據：文件一顯示助理仍載入第7版，其18:00晚間截單時間隱藏時段。第8版於3月3日獲批，把截單時間改為21:00。文件三日誌第41項確認第7版已過時，第42項要求第8版。決策：載入第8版，並顯示於21:00之前開始的晚間時段。計算：星期一至五為5乘4等於20個時段。星期六及日為6加6等於12個時段。每週總數為20加12等於32個時段。風險：沒有文件批准其他變更，記錄亦沒有新增或取消任何時段。下一步：在發布前執行回歸測試，確認所有有效晚間時段出現，且上午及下午時段不變。

brief.en: You are a data analyst on a fictional foodpanda-style delivery platform. A synthetic pilot tracked 500 Hong Kong merchant sign-ups through activation stages. Review the two source documents, then answer the questions and write a 120 to 160 word English handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) for the team lead. Use only the supplied figures. State unique stage counts, denominators and event definitions. Do not infer duplicate membership across stages or causality from simultaneous incidents. This is an independent learning demo, not foodpanda operational data.
brief.zh: 你是虛構 foodpanda 式配送平台的數據分析師。一個合成試點追蹤 500 個香港商戶登記的啟用階段。請閱讀兩份文件，回答問題，並為團隊主管撰寫 120 至 160 字英文交接說明（或相應繁體中文）。只可使用所提供數字。說明各階段唯一數目、分母及事件定義。不得推斷跨階段的重複成員，亦不得由同時發生的事件推斷因果。此為獨立學習示範，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。

body.en: Synthetic pilot, 500 unique merchant sign-ups. Stage 1 sign-up complete: 500 unique merchants. Stage 2 profile submitted: 320 unique merchants. Stage 3 menu uploaded: 200 unique merchants. Stage 4 first order received: 120 unique merchants. Each stage count is a unique merchant count for that stage only. The pilot does not record which merchants appear in more than one stage, so overlap between stages is unknown.

body.en: Activation rate is defined as unique merchants at a stage divided by 500 unique sign-ups. A stage is on target when its activation rate is at least 0.40 inclusive. A stage is below target when its rate is under 0.40. On one day, a menu upload tool outage and a separate payment gateway slowdown occurred at the same time. title.en: Attraction Booking Discrepancy: Case Log and Handover
title.zh: 景點預訂差異：個案紀錄與交接

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent demo, not endorsed). A traveller reports a discrepancy between the booked attraction ticket and the ticket received. Review the three fictional source documents, answer the questions, then write a 120 to 160 word English handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) for the escalation team. All policies, records and identifiers are fictional learning assumptions. Do not infer mobility capability or disability effects from any concern.
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（獨立示範，未經認可）。一名旅客報稱預訂的景點門票與實際收到的門票有差異。請閱讀三份虛構文件，回答問題，然後為轉交團隊撰寫 120 至 160 英文字交接說明（或相若繁體中文）。所有政策、紀錄及識別碼均為虛構學習假設。不得從任何關注推斷行動能力或殘疾影響。

body.en: Booking BR-4471, made 2026-09-02. Attraction: Skyline Wheel. Ticket type booked: Standard Adult, 2 tickets, HKD 480 total. Ticket type issued: Standard Child, 2 tickets, HKD 300 total. Guest name: M. Chan. Guest states the issued tickets are child tickets and cannot be used by the two adults travelling. No refund has been issued. Booking status: confirmed.
body.zh: 預訂 BR-4471，於 2026-09-02 建立。景點：Skyline Wheel。已預訂門票類型：標準成人，2 張，總額 HKD 480。已發出門票類型：標準小童，2 張，總額 HKD 300。旅客姓名：M. Chan。旅客表示已發出的是小童門票，同行兩名成人無法使用。未發出任何退款。預訂狀態：已確認。

title.zh: 虛構門票更正政策 TC-09

body.en: Policy TC-09 applies when the issued ticket type differs from the booked ticket type. Correction is allowed if the booking is confirmed and the attraction date has not passed. The price difference is charged or refunded at the published rate. A price difference of HKD 180 or less may be approved by the specialist. A price difference above HKD 180 must be escalated to the team lead. Escalation requires the booking identifier, the booked and issued ticket types, the price difference, and confirmation that the attraction date has not passed.
body.zh: 政策 TC-09 適用於已發出門票類型與已預訂門票類型不同的情況。若預訂已確認且景點日期尚未過去，則可更正。差價按公布價格收取或退還。差價為 HKD 180 或以下可由專員批准。差價高於 HKD 180 必須轉交團隊主管。轉交須提供預訂識別碼、已預訂及已發出門票類型、差價，以及確認景點日期尚未過去。

body.en: Guest message GM-88, received 2026-09-20. The guest writes that the two adults in the party cannot use child tickets. The guest asks for adult tickets or a refund of the difference. The guest mentions travelling with a companion who uses a walking aid and asks whether step-free access is available at the attraction entrance. The attraction date is 2026-10-15. The guest confirms the booking is under M. Chan.
body.zh: 旅客訊息 GM-88，於 2026-09-20 收到。旅客表示同行兩名成人無法使用小童門票，要求成人門票或退還差價。旅客提到同行者使用助行器具，並詢問景點入口是否有無障礙平坦通道。景點日期為 2026-10-15。旅客確認預訂人為 M. Chan。

title.en: Rescheduled Tour Booking With a Confirmed Exception
title.zh: 已確認例外情況的旅行團改期預訂

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent demo, not endorsed). A customer's rescheduled tour booking carries a confirmed exception. Review the two fictional source documents, answer the questions, then write a 120 to 160 word English handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) covering the case identifier, the confirmed condition, the policy qualifier, the functional need and the next step. All policies, records and names here are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（獨立示範，未經認可）。一名客戶的旅行團改期預訂帶有已確認例外情況。請閱讀兩份虛構文件，回答問題，然後撰寫 120 至 160 字的英文交接說明（或相若的繁體中文），涵蓋個案編號、已確認條件、政策限定、功能需要及下一步。此處所有政策、紀錄及姓名均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Case BR-4471. Customer booked Tour T-88 for 14 March. On 2 March the customer requested a reschedule to 21 March. The supplier confirmed the reschedule in writing on 3 March. The customer paid HKD 1,200. The standard reschedule fee is HKD 150. A confirmed supplier exception waives the reschedule fee when the request is made at least 10 days before the original tour date. The customer also asked for a step-free meeting point. This functional need is not yet confirmed.
body.zh: 個案 BR-4471。客戶預訂旅行團 T-88，日期為 3 月 14 日。客戶於 3 月 2 日要求改期至 3 月 21 日。供應商於 3 月 3 日以書面確認改期。客戶已支付 1,200 港元。標準改期費為 150 港元。若改期要求於原定旅行團日期前至少 10 天提出，已確認的供應商例外可豁免改期費。客戶亦要求無梯級集合點。此功能需要尚未確認。

body.en: Policy R-2. A reschedule request made at least 10 days before the original tour date qualifies for the confirmed supplier exception. The exception waives the HKD 150 reschedule fee. A request made fewer than 10 days before the original tour date does not qualify and the fee applies. The exception applies only when the supplier confirms in writing. Fee waiver is recorded as a saving of HKD 150 against the standard fee. Unconfirmed functional needs must be escalated to the accessibility team before the customer is told anything is arranged.

brief.en: You are a UX designer on a fictional MTR demo team. A small-screen station information search prototype must be reviewed. All records, budgets and findings below are fictional learning assumptions, not real MTR policies. Read the two source documents, answer the four questions, then write a handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. State the chosen search pattern, the accessibility fix, the notification coverage, and one uncertainty. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by MTR, and no real station safety decision is made.
brief.zh: 你是虛構港鐵示範團隊的用戶體驗設計師，需審視小螢幕車站資訊搜尋原型。以下所有記錄、預算及研究結果均為虛構學習假設，並非港鐵真實政策。閱讀兩份文件，回答四條問題，然後撰寫120至160英文詞或相若中文的交接說明。說明所選搜尋模式、無障礙修正、通知覆蓋及一項不確定因素。此為獨立示範，未獲港鐵認可，亦不涉及真實車站安全決策。

body.en: Fictional demo findings. Five participants searched for a station facility on a 360 pixel wide screen. Four completed the task only after scrolling past a full-width map panel. Median time was 48 seconds. Three said the search box was hidden below the fold. A fictional internal design requirement states that primary search must be visible without scrolling at 360 pixels. Two search patterns were tested. Pattern A keeps the search box above the map and needs 6 layout hours. Pattern B uses a tab bar and needs 10 layout hours. The fictional layout budget is 8 hours.
body.zh: 虛構示範研究結果。五名參與者在360像素寬螢幕搜尋車站設施。四人須滑過全寬地圖面板才完成任務，中位時間48秒。三人表示搜尋框藏於首屏之下。虛構內部設計要求訂明：在360像素下，主要搜尋必須無需滾動即可看見。測試了兩種搜尋模式。模式甲把搜尋框置於地圖上方，需6小時版面工時。模式乙使用分頁列，需10小時版面工時。虛構版面預算為8小時。

title.zh: 虛構無障礙及通知備註

body.en: Fictional demo notes. The prototype has three notification types: lift outage, platform change and weather alert. Lift outage and platform change are marked critical. Weather alert is not critical. The current build shows lift outage and weather alert only. A fictional internal accessibility requirement states that every critical notification must appear on the station card without opening a detail page. Contrast of the search box label is 3.1 to 1. A fictional internal design requirement sets the minimum at 4.5 to 1. Raising contrast needs 2 hours. The fictional accessibility budget is 3 hours.
body.zh: 虛構示範備註。原型有三類通知：升降機故障、月台更改及天氣警示。升降機故障與月台更改列為關鍵，天氣警示並非關鍵。現有版本只顯示升降機故障及天氣警示。虛構內部無障礙要求訂明：每項關鍵通知必須在無需開啟詳情頁下顯示於車站卡。搜尋框標籤對比度為3.1比1。虛構內部設計要求最低為4.5比1。提高對比度需2小時。虛構無障礙預算為3小時。

title.en: Community Event Materials Budget and Emissions Note
title.zh: 社區活動物資預算與排放說明

brief.en: You are a sustainability analyst supporting a fictional Swire Properties community event. Compare three mutually exclusive materials plans and choose exactly one with the maximum quantified emissions reduction within a hard budget of HKD 20,000. Do not stack plans or add contingency. Then write a 120 to 160 English word handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) explaining your choice, the arithmetic and one uncertainty. All figures are synthetic learning data, not company results.
brief.zh: 你是可持續發展分析師，支援一個虛構的太古地產社區活動。請比較三個互斥物資方案，並在硬性預算 HKD 20,000 內，選出剛好一個可量化減排量最高的方案。不可疊加方案或加入應急費用。然後撰寫120至160英文詞的交接說明（或相若繁體中文），解釋選擇、計算及一項不確定性。所有數字均為合成學習資料，並非公司成果。

body.en: Synthetic learning data. A fictional one-day community event in Quarry Bay uses 1,000 plastic giveaway bottles. Baseline emissions are 0.08 kg CO2e per bottle, so baseline total is 80 kg CO2e. The event also prints 2,000 paper leaflets at 0.01 kg CO2e each, total 20 kg CO2e. Baseline event materials total is therefore 100 kg CO2e. These figures are fictional and must not be presented as a Swire Properties sustainability result.
body.zh: 合成學習資料。一個虛構的鰂魚涌單日社區活動使用1,000個塑膠紀念水瓶。基準排放為每瓶0.08公斤二氧化碳當量，基準總量為80公斤二氧化碳當量。活動亦印製2,000張紙質單張，每張0.01公斤二氧化碳當量，總量20公斤二氧化碳當量。物資基準總量因此為100公斤二氧化碳當量。此等數字屬虛構，不得當作太古地產可持續發展成果。

title.zh: 虛構方案成本與減排量

body.en: Synthetic learning data. Plan A: reusable bottles, cost HKD 18,000, quantified reduction 45 kg CO2e. Plan B: digital leaflets only, cost HKD 6,000, quantified reduction 18 kg CO2e. Plan C: recycled paper leaflets plus reusable bottles, cost HKD 24,000, quantified reduction 60 kg CO2e. Plans are mutually exclusive and cannot be combined. The hard budget is HKD 20,000. No contingency, approval or preference is assumed.
body.zh: 合成學習資料。方案甲：可重用瓶，成本 HKD 18,000，可量化減排45公斤二氧化碳當量。方案乙：只採用電子單張，成本 HKD 6,000，可量化減排18公斤二氧化碳當量。方案丙：再生紙單張加可重用瓶，成本 HKD 24,000，可量化減排60公斤二氧化碳當量。方案互斥，不可合併。硬性預算為 HKD 20,000。不假設任何應急費用、審批或偏好。

title.zh: 虛構聲明與不確定性規則

body.en: Synthetic learning data. Public messages may only state quantified reductions supported by source-two. Do not claim net zero, carbon neutral or company-wide impact. One uncertainty must be named, for example supplier data quality or participation rate. The handover must be 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
body.zh: 合成學習資料。公開訊息只可陳述文件二所支持的可量化減排量。不得聲稱淨零、碳中和或全公司影響。必須指出一項不確定性，例如供應商數據質素或參與率。交接說明須為120至160英文詞或相若繁體中文。

label.en: Which plan gives the maximum quantified reduction within the hard budget?
label.zh: 哪個方案在硬性預算內提供最高可量化減排量？
方案甲，HKD 18,000，45公斤二氧化碳當量
方案乙，HKD 6,000，18公斤二氧化碳當量
方案丙，HKD 24,000，60公斤二氧化碳當量

label.en: Which plans are within the HKD 20,000 hard budget?
label.zh: 哪些方案在 HKD 20,000 硬性預算之內？

label.en: What is the baseline event materials total in kg CO2e?
label.zh: 活動物資基準總量是多少公斤二氧化碳當量？

label.en: For the chosen plan, what percentage of the 100 kg CO2e baseline is reduced? Enter a whole number.
label.zh: 就所選方案，減排量佔100公斤二氧化碳當量基準的百分比是多少？請輸入整數。

simulationStyle.zh: 在明確預算及有限排放範圍內比較虛構樓宇或活動改善方案，不把合成數字當作公司可持續發展成果。

label.zh: 硬性預算內的方案選擇

description.en: Selects exactly one plan with the maximum quantified reduction within the HKD 20,000 hard budget and does not stack plans.
description.zh: 在 HKD 20,000 硬性預算內選出剛好一個可量化減排量最高的方案，且不疊加方案。

description.en: Shows correct baseline total and correct percentage reduction for the chosen plan using source figures.
description.zh: 使用文件數字，正確展示基準總量及所選方案的減排百分比。

description.en: States only quantified reductions supported by the sources and avoids net zero, carbon neutral or company-wide claims.
description.zh: 只陳述文件支持的可量化減排量，避免淨零、碳中和或全公司聲明。

description.en: Names one specific uncertainty such as supplier data quality or participation rate.
description.zh: 指出一項具體不確定性，例如供應商數據質素或參與率。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with decision, calculation and next step.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的120至160英文詞或相若繁體中文交接說明，包含決策、計算及下一步。

label.zh: 硬性預算內的方案選擇

description.en: Selects exactly one plan with the maximum quantified reduction within the HKD 20,000 hard budget and does not stack plans.
description.zh: 在 HKD 20,000 硬性預算內選出剛好一個可量化減排量最高的方案，且不疊加方案。

expectedEvidence.en: Plan A is the only plan within budget with the highest reduction. Plan C exceeds budget at HKD 24,000. Plan B is within budget but reduces only 18 kg CO2e.

description.en: Shows correct baseline total and correct percentage reduction for the chosen plan using source figures.
description.zh: 使用文件數字，正確展示基準總量及所選方案的減排百分比。

expectedEvidence.en: Baseline is 80 plus 20 equals 100 kg CO2e. Plan A reduction share is 45 divided by 100 equals 45 percent.
expectedEvidence.zh: 基準為80加20等於100公斤二氧化碳當量。方案甲減排比例為45除以100等於45%。

description.en: States only quantified reductions supported by the sources and avoids net zero, carbon neutral or company-wide claims.

expectedEvidence.zh: 指出供應商數據質素、參與率或相若的具體不確定性。

description.zh: 撰寫清晰的120至160英文詞或相若繁體中文交接說明，包含決策、計算及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese and includes the chosen plan, the calculation method and a next step.

exemplar.en: Decision: choose Plan A, reusable bottles, at HKD 18,000. It is the only plan within the HKD 20,000 hard budget with the highest quantified reduction. Plan C reduces 60 kg CO2e but costs HKD 24,000, so it exceeds budget. Plan B is within budget but reduces only 18 kg CO2e. Calculation: baseline is 1,000 bottles at 0.08 kg CO2e, giving 80 kg CO2e, plus 2,000 leaflets at 0.01 kg CO2e, giving 20 kg CO2e. Baseline total is 100 kg CO2e. Plan A reduces 45 kg CO2e, which is 45 percent of baseline. Uncertainty: supplier data quality for reusable bottle emissions is not yet confirmed. Next step: confirm supplier figures before any public message. All figures are synthetic learning data, not company results.
exemplar.zh: 決策：選擇方案甲，可重用瓶，成本 HKD 18,000。它是唯一在 HKD 20,000 硬性預算內且可量化減排量最高的方案。方案丙減排60公斤二氧化碳當量，但成本 HKD 24,000，超出預算。方案乙在預算內，但只減排18公斤二氧化碳當量。計算：基準為1,000個瓶乘以0.08公斤二氧化碳當量，即80公斤二氧化碳當量，加上2,000張單張乘以0.01公斤二氧化碳當量，即20公斤二氧化碳當量。基準總量為100公斤二氧化碳當量。方案甲減排45公斤二氧化碳當量，即基準的45%。不確定性：可重用瓶排放的供應商數據質素尚未確認。下一步：在公開發布前確認供應商數字。所有數字均為合成學習資料，並非公司成果。

title.en: Connector pin mapping review for a fictional sensor board
title.zh: 虛構感測板連接器引腳映射審查

brief.en: You are an independent PCB design reviewer in a fictional simulation inspired by ASMPT's public customer-focused engineering innovation. Review the fictional low-voltage sensor board package against the simulated design rules. Confirm the pin mapping, identify rule breaches and hand over findings for engineering review. This demo is not endorsed by ASMPT and is not a job opening. All records are synthetic. Write a 120 to 160 English word handover or comparable Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 你是獨立 PCB 設計審查員，身處受 ASMPT 公開的以客戶為本工程創新啟發的虛構模擬。請按模擬設計規則審查虛構低電壓感測板文件，確認引腳映射、找出違規並把結果交予工程審核。此示範不獲 ASMPT 認可，亦非招聘。所有記錄均為合成。請撰寫 120 至 160 英文字交接說明，或相若長度繁體中文。

body.en: Simulated rules for the fictional sensor board only. Rule R1: every signal pin must map to exactly one net. Rule R2: a net may carry at most two pins. Rule R3: pin 1 is reserved for ground and must not carry signals. Rule R4: the total pin count must not exceed 8. Rule R5: any pin left unmapped must be recorded as spare. These rules are synthetic and are not ASMPT policy.
body.zh: 僅適用於虛構感測板的模擬規則。規則 R1：每個訊號引腳必須映射到恰好一個網絡。規則 R2：每個網絡最多可承載兩個引腳。規則 R3：引腳 1 保留作接地，不得承載訊號。規則 R4：引腳總數不得超過 8。規則 R5：任何未映射引腳必須記錄為備用。此等規則屬合成，並非 ASMPT 政策。

body.en: Synthetic record for the fictional board. Connector J1 has 8 pins. Mapping as recorded: pin 1 to net SIG-A. Pin 2 to net SIG-A. Pin 3 to net SIG-B. Pin 4 to net SIG-B. Pin 5 to net SIG-C. Pin 6 to net SIG-C. Pin 7 to net SIG-D. Pin 8 unmapped. No other connectors exist. This record is fictional and is not an ASMPT design.
body.zh: 虛構板的合成記錄。連接器 J1 有 8 個引腳。記錄映射如下：引腳 1 至網絡 SIG-A。引腳 2 至網絡 SIG-A。引腳 3 至網絡 SIG-B。引腳 4 至網絡 SIG-B。引腳 5 至網絡 SIG-C。引腳 6 至網絡 SIG-C。引腳 7 至網絡 SIG-D。引腳 8 未映射。並無其他連接器。此記錄屬虛構，並非 ASMPT 設計。

title.en: Fictional review log and budget note
title.zh: 虛構審查日誌與預算備註

body.en: Synthetic review note. The simulated rework budget is 900 HKD. Each corrected pin mapping costs 150 HKD. Each spare pin record costs 50 HKD. The review must stay within the 900 HKD budget. The log confirms the board is low voltage and no test has been run. This note is fictional and is not ASMPT policy.
body.zh: 合成審查備註。模擬返工預算為 900 港元。每項修正引腳映射花費 150 港元。每項備用引腳記錄花費 50 港元。審查必須維持在 900 港元預算內。日誌確認電路板屬低電壓，且未進行任何測試。此備註屬虛構，並非 ASMPT 政策。

label.en: Which rule is breached by pin 1 carrying net SIG-A?
label.zh: 引腳 1 承載網絡 SIG-A 違反哪條規則？

label.en: How many nets carry exactly two pins in the record?
label.zh: 記錄中有多少個網絡恰好承載兩個引腳？

label.en: Which pins must be recorded as spare?
label.zh: 哪些引腳必須記錄為備用？

label.en: What is the total simulated cost to correct pin 1 and record the spare pin?
label.zh: 修正引腳 1 並記錄備用引腳的模擬總成本是多少？

label.en: Does the corrected plan stay within the 900 HKD budget?
label.zh: 修正計劃是否維持在 900 港元預算內？

exemplar.en: Review of fictional sensor board J1 against simulated rules R1 to R5. Finding one: pin 1 carries net SIG-A, which breaches rule R3 because pin 1 is reserved for ground and must not carry signals. Correcting this mapping costs 150 HKD. Finding two: pin 8 is unmapped, so under rule R5 it must be recorded as a spare pin at 50 HKD. The corrected plan totals 200 HKD, which stays within the 900 HKD simulated budget. Nets SIG-A, SIG-B and SIG-C each carry two pins, so three nets meet rule R2. Pin 7 carries net SIG-D alone and is not a spare. No test has been run and the board is low voltage. Next step: submit this handover for simulated engineering review before any further mapping changes.
exemplar.zh: 按模擬規則 R1 至 R5 審查虛構感測板 J1。發現一：引腳 1 承載網絡 SIG-A，違反規則 R3，因引腳 1 保留作接地，不得承載訊號。修正此映射花費 150 港元。發現二：引腳 8 未映射，按規則 R5 必須記錄為備用引腳，花費 50 港元。修正計劃合共 200 港元，維持在 900 港元模擬預算內。網絡 SIG-A、SIG-B 及 SIG-C 各承載兩個引腳，故三個網絡符合規則 R2。引腳 7 單獨承載網絡 SIG-D，並非備用。未進行任何測試，電路板屬低電壓。下一步：在進一步修改映射前，把此交接交予模擬工程審核。

title.zh: 虛構低壓 PCB 修訂交接

brief.en: You are an independent PCB designer reviewing a fictional low-voltage sensor board package for an ASMPT-inspired demo. All documents are synthetic learning assumptions, not real ASMPT designs or policies. Review the simulated design rules and revision log, answer the questions, then write a 120 to 160 English word handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) for the engineering review meeting. State the revision, the rule breaches, the estimated saving, and one uncertainty. This demo is not endorsed and is not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你是獨立 PCB 設計師，為 ASMPT 啟發的示範審查虛構低壓感測板文件。所有文件均為模擬學習假設，並非真實 ASMPT 設計或政策。請審閱模擬設計規則與修訂記錄，回答問題，然後為工程審核會議撰寫 120 至 160 英文詞的交接說明（或相應繁體中文）。說明修訂版本、違規項目、估計節省及一項不確定因素。本示範未經認可，亦非招聘職位。

body.en: Fictional rules for the demo sensor board. Rule A: minimum trace width 0.15 mm. Rule B: minimum clearance 0.15 mm. Rule C: via drill diameter must be at least 0.30 mm. Rule D: silkscreen must not overlap any exposed pad. Rule E: board outline must keep a 0.50 mm edge clearance for all copper. A breach is counted only when the measured value is strictly below the stated minimum. Measured values equal to the minimum are compliant.
body.zh: 示範感測板的虛構規則。規則 A：最小線寬 0.15 毫米。規則 B：最小間距 0.15 毫米。規則 C：過孔鑽孔直徑至少 0.30 毫米。規則 D：絲印不得覆蓋任何外露焊盤。規則 E：所有銅箔須與板邊保持 0.50 毫米間距。只有量測值嚴格低於所述最小值才計為違規。等於最小值屬合規。

body.en: Fictional board SENS-204. Revision R3 is the current release. Revision R4 is a draft not yet released. R4 measurements: narrowest trace 0.12 mm, smallest clearance 0.15 mm, smallest via drill 0.25 mm, silkscreen overlaps one exposed pad, copper to board edge 0.40 mm. R3 measurements: narrowest trace 0.15 mm, smallest clearance 0.18 mm, smallest via drill 0.30 mm, no silkscreen overlap, copper to board edge 0.55 mm. R3 is fully compliant with rules A to E.
body.zh: 虛構電路板 SENS-204。修訂 R3 為現行發行版。修訂 R4 為尚未發行的草稿。R4 量測：最窄線寬 0.12 毫米、最小間距 0.15 毫米、最小過孔鑽孔 0.25 毫米、絲印覆蓋一個外露焊盤、銅箔至板邊 0.40 毫米。R3 量測：最窄線寬 0.15 毫米、最小間距 0.18 毫米、最小過孔鑽孔 0.30 毫米、無絲印覆蓋、銅箔至板邊 0.55 毫米。R3 完全符合規則 A 至 E。

body.en: Fictional cost note for the demo. The released R3 board costs 42 HKD per unit. The draft R4 layout is estimated at 36 HKD per unit because it uses a smaller via size. The saving is the released baseline cost minus the draft cost. The pilot build is 500 units. The hard budget for the pilot build is 20000 HKD. No contingency, approval or preference is assumed.
body.zh: 示範的虛構成本說明。已發行 R3 電路板每件成本 42 港元。草稿 R4 佈局因使用較小過孔，估計每件 36 港元。節省為已發行基準成本減去草稿成本。試產數量為 500 件。試產硬性預算為 20000 港元。不假設任何應急費用、審批或偏好。

label.zh: 草稿 R4 違反規則 A 至 E 中多少項？

label.zh: 哪個修訂版本完全符合規則 A 至 E？

expectedEvidence.zh: R3 為已發行且合規的修訂。R4 為草稿。R4 違反 A（0.12 低於 0.15）、C（0.25 低於 0.30）、D（絲印覆蓋外露焊盤）及 E（0.40 低於 0.50）。R4 不違反 B，因 0.15 等於最小值。

description.en: Shows the per-unit saving, the pilot total and the comparison with the hard budget using stated figures only.
description.zh: 僅用所述數字展示每件節省、試產總額及與硬性預算的比較。

expectedEvidence.en: Saving is 42 minus 36 equals 6 HKD per unit. Pilot saving is 6 times 500 equals 3000 HKD. Draft pilot cost is 36 times 500 equals 18000 HKD, which is within the 20000 HKD hard budget. No contingency is added.
expectedEvidence.zh: 每件節省為 42 減 36 等於 6 港元。試產節省為 6 乘 500 等於 3000 港元。草稿試產成本為 36 乘 500 等於 18000 港元，在 20000 港元硬性預算之內。不加入應急費用。

description.en: States at least one explicit uncertainty and explains how it affects the review decision.
description.zh: 說明至少一項明確不確定因素，並解釋其如何影響審核決定。

expectedEvidence.en: Acceptable uncertainties include that R4 is an unreleased draft, that the 36 HKD figure is an estimate, or that the smaller via size may need further review. The handover must say how the uncertainty affects the recommendation.
expectedEvidence.zh: 可接受的不確定因素包括 R4 為未發行草稿、36 港元為估計值，或較小過孔尺寸或需進一步審查。交接須說明該不確定因素如何影響建議。

description.en: Writes a clear 120 to 160 English word handover or comparable Traditional Chinese with revision, breaches, saving and next step.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的 120 至 160 英文詞交接或相應繁體中文，包含修訂、違規、節省及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: The handover names SENS-204, states R3 is released and R4 is a draft, lists the four breaches, gives the 3000 HKD pilot saving, notes the 18000 HKD draft cost is within the 20000 HKD budget, and proposes a next step such as correcting R4 before release.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接須指明 SENS-204，說明 R3 已發行而 R4 為草稿，列出四項違規，給出 3000 港元試產節省，指出 18000 港元草稿成本在 20000 港元預算之內，並提出下一步，例如在發行前修正 R4。

description.en: Applies the strict-below rule correctly and keeps the fictional demo boundary clear.
description.zh: 正確應用嚴格低於規則，並保持虛構示範界線清晰。

expectedEvidence.en: The handover treats 0.15 mm clearance as compliant because the rule counts a breach only when strictly below the minimum. It does not claim the demo certifies a real board or represents ASMPT designs.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接把 0.15 毫米間距視為合規，因規則只在嚴格低於最小值時計為違規。不得聲稱本示範認證真實電路板或代表 ASMPT 設計。

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional board SENS-204. Revision R3 is the released revision and is fully compliant with rules A to E. Revision R4 is an unreleased draft and breaches four rules. Rule A: narrowest trace 0.12 mm, below the 0.15 mm minimum. Rule C: smallest via drill 0.25 mm, below the 0.30 mm minimum. Rule D: silkscreen overlaps one exposed pad. Rule E: copper to board edge 0.40 mm, below the 0.50 mm minimum. Rule B is not breached because 0.15 mm equals the minimum. Cost: R3 is 42 HKD per unit and draft R4 is estimated at 36 HKD, so the saving is 6 HKD per unit and 3000 HKD for the 500-unit pilot. The draft pilot cost is 18000 HKD, within the 20000 HKD hard budget. Uncertainty: the 36 HKD figure is an estimate. Next step: correct the four R4 breaches and re-measure before any release decision.
exemplar.zh: 虛構電路板 SENS-204 交接。修訂 R3 為已發行版本，完全符合規則 A 至 E。修訂 R4 為未發行草稿，違反四項規則。規則 A：最窄線寬 0.12 毫米，低於 0.15 毫米下限。規則 C：最小過孔鑽孔 0.25 毫米，低於 0.30 毫米下限。規則 D：絲印覆蓋一個外露焊盤。規則 E：銅箔至板邊 0.40 毫米，低於 0.50 毫米下限。規則 B 不違反，因 0.15 毫米等於下限。成本：R3 每件 42 港元，草稿 R4 估計每件 36 港元，故每件節省 6 港元，500 件試產節省 3000 港元。草稿試產成本為 18000 港元，在 20000 港元硬性預算之內。不確定因素：36 港元為估計值。下一步：修正 R4 四項違規並重新量測，然後才決定是否發行。

title.en: Synthetic Water Monitoring Comparison for a Client Handover
title.zh: 合成水質監測比較與客戶交接

brief.en: You are an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs. A client asks which of two synthetic monitoring points, Point A or Point B, should be prioritised for follow-up sampling under an invented scenario threshold of 25 mg/L for a fictional marker. Read the two synthetic records, compare the results, and write a 120 to 160 word English handover, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decision, uncertainty and next steps. All records are fictional learning data, not legal standards.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家。客戶詢問在虛構情境門檻（虛構標記物25毫克／升）下，兩個合成監測點甲或乙應優先安排跟進採樣。請閱讀兩份合成紀錄，比較結果，並撰寫120至160字英文交接說明，或相若篇幅的繁體中文，涵蓋證據、決策、不確定性及下一步。所有紀錄均為虛構學習資料，並非法定標準。

body.en: Fictional learning record. Point A, synthetic river site. Three samples collected on three separate days. Marker results: 31 mg/L, 28 mg/L and 26 mg/L. The invented scenario threshold is 25 mg/L. All three results are above the threshold. The record notes that the sampling bottle for the third day was opened in the field before use, so that result has a possible contamination flag. No other quality flags are recorded.
body.zh: 虛構學習紀錄。甲點，合成河流位置。三日各採一個樣本。標記物結果：31毫克／升、28毫克／升及26毫克／升。虛構情境門檻為25毫克／升。三個結果均高於門檻。紀錄註明第三日的採樣瓶在現場使用前曾打開，因此該結果帶有可能污染標記。並無其他品質標記。

body.en: Fictional learning record. Point B, synthetic river site. Three samples collected on three separate days. Marker results: 22 mg/L, 24 mg/L and 23 mg/L. The invented scenario threshold is 25 mg/L. All three results are below the threshold. No quality flags are recorded. The record states that Point B is downstream of Point A and that both points were sampled in the same week.
body.zh: 虛構學習紀錄。乙點，合成河流位置。三日各採一個樣本。標記物結果：22毫克／升、24毫克／升及23毫克／升。虛構情境門檻為25毫克／升。三個結果均低於門檻。並無品質標記。紀錄指出乙點位於甲點下游，兩點於同一週採樣。

title.en: Synthetic client request and follow-up rule
title.zh: 合成客戶要求及跟進規則

body.en: Fictional learning record. The client asks which point to prioritise for follow-up sampling. The invented follow-up rule states that a point is prioritised when at least two valid results are above the scenario threshold. A result with a possible contamination flag is not counted as valid. Follow-up sampling must be proposed for the prioritised point only. The client also asks for one uncertainty statement and one practical next step.
body.zh: 虛構學習紀錄。客戶詢問應優先跟進哪一點。虛構跟進規則指出，當至少兩個有效結果高於情境門檻時，該點獲優先跟進。帶有可能污染標記的結果不計為有效。跟進採樣只須就獲優先跟進的一點提出。客戶亦要求一項不確定性陳述及一項實務下一步。

label.en: Which point should be prioritised for follow-up sampling?
label.zh: 哪一點應優先安排跟進採樣？

label.en: How many valid Point A results are above the scenario threshold?
label.zh: 甲點有多少個有效結果高於情境門檻？

label.en: What is the status of all Point B results against the scenario threshold?
label.zh: 乙點所有結果相對情境門檻的狀況為何？

label.en: Which fact creates the main uncertainty for Point A?
label.zh: 哪項事實構成甲點的主要不確定性？

label.en: The third-day bottle was opened in the field
label.zh: 第三日採樣瓶在現場曾打開

label.en: Point B is downstream of Point A
Both points were sampled in the same week

starter.en:
Evidence:
Decision and calculations:
Risks:
Next steps:
starter.zh:
證據：
決策與計算：

about.en: Enviro Labs lists environmental testing, including water and soil analysis, among its laboratory services.
about.zh: 環境化驗有限公司的化驗服務包括水質及泥土分析等環境測試。

simulationStyle.en: Interpret synthetic water or soil monitoring records with explicit scenario thresholds, sample limitations and a client handover. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards.
simulationStyle.zh: 以明確情境門檻、樣本限制及客戶交接紀錄解讀合成水質或泥土監測資料。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。

description.en: Compares the two synthetic records using specific results and the scenario threshold
description.zh: 以具體結果及情境門檻比較兩份合成紀錄

description.en: Applies the invented follow-up rule to select the prioritised point and proposes follow-up sampling for that point only
description.zh: 應用虛構跟進規則選出優先點，並只就該點提出跟進採樣

description.en: Identifies the contamination flag and explains how it affects the valid result count
description.zh: 指出污染標記並說明其如何影響有效結果數目

description.en: Writes a clear client handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with evidence, decision, uncertainty and next steps
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的客戶交接說明，英文120至160字或相若篇幅繁體中文，涵蓋證據、決策、不確定性及下一步

description.en: Treats the scenario threshold as invented and avoids presenting it as a legal discharge standard
description.zh: 把情境門檻視為虛構，避免將其表述為法定排放標準

description.en: Compares the two synthetic records using specific results and the scenario threshold
description.zh: 以具體結果及情境門檻比較兩份合成紀錄

expectedEvidence.en: Point A results 31, 28 and 26 mg/L, all above the 25 mg/L scenario threshold. Point B results 22, 24 and 23 mg/L, all below the threshold.
expectedEvidence.zh: 甲點結果31、28及26毫克／升，全部高於25毫克／升情境門檻。乙點結果22、24及23毫克／升，全部低於門檻。

description.en: Applies the invented follow-up rule to select the prioritised point and proposes follow-up sampling for that point only
description.zh: 應用虛構跟進規則選出優先點，並只就該點提出跟進採樣

expectedEvidence.en: Point A is prioritised because at least two valid results are above the threshold. Follow-up sampling is proposed for Point A only.
expectedEvidence.zh: 甲點獲優先跟進，因至少兩個有效結果高於門檻。跟進採樣只就甲點提出。

description.en: Identifies the contamination flag and explains how it affects the valid result count
description.zh: 指出污染標記並說明其如何影響有效結果數目

expectedEvidence.en: The third-day Point A bottle was opened in the field, so that result has a possible contamination flag and is not counted as valid. Two valid Point A results remain above the threshold.
expectedEvidence.zh: 甲點第三日採樣瓶在現場曾打開，該結果帶有可能污染標記，不計為有效。甲點仍有兩個有效結果高於門檻。

description.en: Writes a clear client handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with evidence, decision, uncertainty and next steps
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的客戶交接說明，英文120至160字或相若篇幅繁體中文，涵蓋證據、決策、不確定性及下一步

expectedEvidence.en: A structured handover that states the Point A and Point B results, the threshold comparison, the prioritised point, the contamination flag limitation and one practical next step such as resampling Point A with sealed bottles.
expectedEvidence.zh: 結構清晰的交接說明，列出甲點及乙點結果、門檻比較、優先點、污染標記限制，以及一項實務下一步，例如以密封瓶重新採集甲點樣本。

description.en: Treats the scenario threshold as invented and avoids presenting it as a legal discharge standard
description.zh: 把情境門檻視為虛構，避免將其表述為法定排放標準

expectedEvidence.en: States or implies that the 25 mg/L threshold is an invented scenario value for this exercise, not a legal discharge standard.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明或暗示25毫克／升門檻為本練習的虛構情境數值，並非法定排放標準。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Point A results were 31, 28 and 26 mg/L, all above the invented 25 mg/L scenario threshold. Point B results were 22, 24 and 23 mg/L, all below it. Decision: under the invented follow-up rule, Point A is prioritised because at least two valid results are above the threshold, so follow-up sampling is proposed for Point A only. Uncertainty: the third-day Point A bottle was opened in the field, so that result has a possible contamination flag and is not counted as valid. Two valid Point A results remain above the threshold. The 25 mg/L value is a fictional scenario threshold, not a legal discharge standard. Next step: resample Point A with sealed bottles and confirm handling records before comparing with Point B.
exemplar.zh: 證據：甲點結果為31、28及26毫克／升，全部高於虛構的25毫克／升情境門檻。乙點結果為22、24及23毫克／升，全部低於門檻。決策：按虛構跟進規則，甲點因至少兩個有效結果高於門檻而獲優先跟進，因此只就甲點提出跟進採樣。不確定性：甲點第三日採樣瓶在現場曾打開，該結果帶有可能污染標記，不計為有效。甲點仍有兩個有效結果高於門檻。25毫克／升為虛構情境門檻，並非法定排放標準。下一步：以密封瓶重新採集甲點樣本，並在與乙點比較前確認處理紀錄。

feedback.en: You cite Point A at 31, 28 and 26 mg/L and Point B at 22, 24 and 23 mg/L and compare both directly against the invented 25 mg/L scenario threshold, so the evidence comparison is complete and accurate.
feedback.zh: 你列出甲點31、28及26毫克／升，乙點22、24及23毫克／升，並直接與虛構的25毫克／升情境門檻比較，證據比較完整準確。

feedback.en: You apply the invented follow-up rule correctly, prioritise Point A on two valid above-threshold results and propose follow-up sampling for Point A only, which matches the client request rule.
feedback.zh: 你正確應用虛構跟進規則，以兩個有效超標結果選出甲點，並只就甲點提出跟進採樣，符合客戶要求規則。

feedback.en: You identify the third-day bottle opened in the field, strip that result from the valid count and confirm two valid Point A results still exceed the threshold. This shows the flag's effect on the count clearly.
feedback.zh: 你指出第三日採樣瓶在現場曾打開，將該結果剔除於有效數目之外，並確認甲點仍有兩個有效結果高於門檻，清楚說明標記對數目的影響。

feedback.en: Your handover runs 128 English words, inside the 120 to 160 guidance, and covers evidence, decision, uncertainty and a practical next step in a clear structure. Naming sealed bottles and confirming handling records makes the next step actionable.
feedback.zh: 你的交接說明為128個英文字，符合120至160的指引，並以清晰結構涵蓋證據、決策、不確定性及實務下一步。提出密封瓶及確認處理紀錄使下一步具體可行。

feedback.en: You state that the 25 mg/L value is a fictional scenario threshold and not a legal discharge standard, so the scope boundary is met. All four structured answers also match the supplied records.
feedback.zh: 你說明25毫克／升為虛構情境門檻，並非法定排放標準，符合範圍界線。四個結構化答案亦與所提供紀錄一致。

summary.en: All four structured answers match the supplied records and rule, and the 128-word handover applies the follow-up rule correctly while separating the flagged result from the valid count. Full marks are warranted across all five criteria. This is a synthetic learning exercise and does not represent certification or legal compliance.
summary.zh: 四個結構化答案均與所提供紀錄及規則一致，128字交接說明正確應用跟進規則，並將帶標記結果與有效數目分開。五項準則均值得滿分。本練習屬虛構學習用途，不代表認證或法律合規。

nextSteps.en: Keep this structure. Where a real client scenario is involved, add the sampling date range and the method or detection limit reference so the comparison is fully traceable.
nextSteps.zh: 可沿用此結構。如涉及真實客戶情境，請補充採樣日期範圍及方法或檢出限參考，使比較具完整可追溯性。

title.en: Synthetic Soil Record and Blank-Control Review
title.zh: 合成泥土紀錄與空白對照審閱

brief.en: You are an independent demo learner at Enviro Labs, not staff. A client sent synthetic soil monitoring records for a fictional site. Review the two source documents, answer the questions, then write a 120 to 160 English word handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) for the client. All thresholds, budgets, records and results are fictional learning assumptions, not legal discharge standards or real laboratory procedures. Do not run any tests.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的獨立示範學員，並非員工。客戶就一個虛構場地提交了合成泥土監測紀錄。請審閱兩份文件、回答問題，然後為客戶撰寫120至160英文字的交接說明（或相若篇幅的香港繁體中文）。所有門檻、預算、紀錄及結果均為虛構學習假設，並非法定排放標準或真實化驗程序。請勿進行任何測試。

body.en: Fictional site code SOIL-22. Four soil samples were taken at one depth. Results in mg/kg dry weight. S1 41, S2 47, S3 52, S4 44. The scenario screening threshold is 50 mg/kg, applied as exceedance when a result is greater than 50. The client budget for follow-up sampling is HKD 6000. Each follow-up sample costs HKD 1500. The client asked for the maximum number of follow-up samples within that budget.
body.zh: 虛構場地編號 SOIL-22。於同一深度採集四個泥土樣本。結果以每公斤乾重毫克數表示。S1 41、S2 47、S3 52、S4 44。情境篩選門檻為每公斤50毫克，結果大於50即屬超標。客戶跟進採樣的預算為6,000港元。每個跟進樣本費用1,500港元。客戶要求計算預算內可進行的最多跟進樣本數目。

title.zh: 空白對照與不確定性說明

body.en: Fictional note. The batch blank control result was 3 mg/kg, below the scenario blank limit of 10 mg/kg, so the batch is treated as acceptable for this exercise. Sample S3 was logged as slightly turbid at reception. The record does not state a re-test. The client needs to know which single result exceeds the scenario threshold and what the blank control shows. No legal or medical conclusion may be drawn from these synthetic records.
body.zh: 虛構說明。該批次空白對照結果為每公斤3毫克，低於情境空白限值每公斤10毫克，因此本練習視該批次為可接受。樣本S3於接收時記錄為略混濁。紀錄沒有註明重測。客戶需要知道哪一個結果超出情境門檻，以及空白對照顯示甚麼。不得從這些合成紀錄得出任何法律或醫療結論。

label.en: How many soil results exceed the scenario threshold of 50 mg/kg?
label.zh: 有多少個泥土結果超出每公斤50毫克的情境門檻？

label.en: What is the maximum number of follow-up samples within the HKD 6000 budget?
label.zh: 在6,000港元預算內，最多可進行多少個跟進樣本？

label.en: What does the blank control show for this batch?
label.zh: 本批次的空白對照顯示甚麼？

label.en: Blank result 3 mg/kg is below the 10 mg/kg blank limit, so the batch is acceptable for this exercise
label.zh: 空白結果每公斤3毫克低於每公斤10毫克空白限值，本練習視批次為可接受

label.en: Blank result 3 mg/kg exceeds the 10 mg/kg blank limit
label.zh: 空白結果每公斤3毫克超出每公斤10毫克空白限值

label.en: No blank control result is recorded
label.zh: 沒有記錄空白對照結果

label.en: Which statement best handles sample S3?
label.zh: 哪一項陳述最能妥善處理樣本S3？

label.en: Report S3 as above threshold and flag the reception turbidity as an uncertainty, noting no re-test is recorded
label.zh: 報告S3超出門檻，並把接收時混濁列為不確定性，註明沒有重測紀錄

label.en: Discard S3 and report only three samples
Report S3 without mentioning the turbidity note
label.zh: 報告S3但不提及混濁紀錄

label.en: Which statement respects the boundary of these synthetic records?
label.zh: 哪一項陳述尊重這些合成紀錄的界線？

label.en: State that no legal or medical conclusion can be drawn from the synthetic records
label.zh: 說明不得從合成紀錄得出任何法律或醫療結論

about.en: Enviro Labs lists environmental testing, including water and soil analysis, among its laboratory services.

simulationStyle.en: Interpret synthetic water or soil monitoring records with explicit scenario thresholds, sample limitations and a client handover. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards.

description.en: Identifies the single exceeding result and links it to the stated scenario threshold

description.en: Explains the blank control outcome and the S3 turbidity limitation
description.zh: 解釋空白對照結果及S3混濁限制

description.en: Avoids legal or medical conclusions from synthetic records
description.zh: 避免從合成紀錄得出法律或醫療結論

description.en: Identifies the single exceeding result and links it to the stated scenario threshold
description.zh: 指出唯一超標結果並連結至所述情境門檻

expectedEvidence.en: S3 at 52 mg/kg is greater than the 50 mg/kg scenario threshold. S1 41, S2 47 and S4 44 are at or below 50. Acceptable alternative wording that names S3 as the only exceedance.
expectedEvidence.zh: S3為每公斤52毫克，大於每公斤50毫克情境門檻。S1 41、S2 47及S4 44均等於或低於50。可接受其他指明S3為唯一超標的表述。

description.en: Shows the maximum follow-up sample count within the stated budget
description.zh: 展示所述預算內最多跟進樣本數目

expectedEvidence.en: 6000 divided by 1500 equals 4 follow-up samples. Acceptable alternative wording that states four samples within budget.
expectedEvidence.zh: 6000除以1500等於4個跟進樣本。可接受其他說明預算內為四個樣本的表述。

description.en: Explains the blank control outcome and the S3 turbidity limitation
description.zh: 解釋空白對照結果及S3混濁限制

expectedEvidence.en: Blank 3 mg/kg is below the 10 mg/kg blank limit so the batch is acceptable for this exercise. S3 was logged slightly turbid at reception and no re-test is recorded, so this is an uncertainty. Acceptable alternatives that state both facts.
expectedEvidence.zh: 空白每公斤3毫克低於每公斤10毫克空白限值，本練習視批次為可接受。S3於接收時記錄為略混濁，且沒有重測紀錄，因此屬不確定性。可接受同時說明兩項事實的其他表述。

description.en: Avoids legal or medical conclusions from synthetic records
description.zh: 避免從合成紀錄得出法律或醫療結論

expectedEvidence.en: States that no legal or medical conclusion can be drawn from these synthetic records. Acceptable alternatives that keep the boundary.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明不得從這些合成紀錄得出任何法律或醫療結論。可接受其他維持界線的表述。

description.en: Writes a clear 120 to 160 English word handover or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的120至160英文字交接說明或相若香港繁體中文，並包含下一步

expectedEvidence.en: A handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese that covers the exceedance, the blank control, the budget calculation and next steps. Acceptable alternatives that meet the length and cover these points.
expectedEvidence.zh: 120至160英文字或相若香港繁體中文的交接說明，涵蓋超標、空白對照、預算計算及下一步。可接受符合篇幅並涵蓋這些要點的其他表述。

exemplar.en: Client handover for SOIL-22. Four soil samples were reviewed against the fictional scenario threshold of 50 mg/kg. S1 41, S2 47 and S4 44 are at or below the threshold. S3 at 52 mg/kg is the only exceedance. The batch blank control was 3 mg/kg, below the 10 mg/kg blank limit, so the batch is acceptable for this exercise. S3 was logged slightly turbid at reception and no re-test is recorded, so this remains an uncertainty. The HKD 6000 budget at HKD 1500 per sample allows a maximum of four follow-up samples. Next steps are to confirm sampling locations with the client and to note that no legal or medical conclusion can be drawn from these synthetic records.
exemplar.zh: SOIL-22客戶交接說明。四個泥土樣本已對照虛構情境門檻每公斤50毫克審閱。S1 41、S2 47及S4 44均等於或低於門檻。S3為每公斤52毫克，是唯一超標。批次空白對照為每公斤3毫克，低於每公斤10毫克空白限值，本練習視批次為可接受。S3於接收時記錄為略混濁，且沒有重測紀錄，因此仍屬不確定性。6,000港元預算按每個樣本1,500港元計算，最多可進行四個跟進樣本。下一步是與客戶確認採樣位置，並註明不得從這些合成紀錄得出任何法律或醫療結論。

brief.en: You are a laboratory analyst at STC. Review the fictional calibration records for three balances and decide which balance can be used for a new sample batch. All records are synthetic learning data, not real STC policies or results. Use only the supplied documents. Then write a handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese covering the chosen balance, the calculation, uncertainty, the start deadline and next steps. This is an independent demo and not an endorsement or a current job opening.
brief.zh: 你是 STC 的化驗分析員。請覆核三個天平的虛構校正紀錄，並決定哪個天平可用於新一批樣本。所有紀錄均為合成學習資料，並非真實 STC 政策或結果。只可使用提供的文件。然後撰寫 120 至 160 英文詞或相若香港繁體中文的交接說明，涵蓋所選天平、計算、不確定性、開始期限及下一步。此為獨立示範，並非認可或現有職位空缺。

body.en: Synthetic learning record. Balance B-101: last calibrated 2026-08-01, drift +0.04 g, tolerance +0.05 g. Balance B-102: last calibrated 2026-08-15, drift +0.07 g, tolerance +0.05 g. Balance B-103: last calibrated 2026-09-01, drift +0.02 g, tolerance +0.05 g. Drift is the absolute difference between the balance reading and the reference mass. A balance passes only if drift is less than or equal to tolerance. All balances are physically available. No real calibration was performed.
body.zh: 合成學習紀錄。天平 B-101：上次校正 2026-08-01，偏差 +0.04 g，容差 +0.05 g。天平 B-102：上次校正 2026-08-15，偏差 +0.07 g，容差 +0.05 g。天平 B-103：上次校正 2026-09-01，偏差 +0.02 g，容差 +0.05 g。偏差是天平讀數與參考砝碼之間的絕對差。天平僅在偏差小於或等於容差時合格。所有天平均實際可用。沒有進行真實校正。

body.en: Synthetic learning record. The new sample batch requires a balance with drift less than or equal to 0.05 g. The batch has 12 samples. Each sample needs one weighing. The laboratory can complete at most 10 weighings per day. The batch must start within 3 working days of the review. Two balances, B-101 and B-103, meet the drift requirement. The batch also requires the balance with the smallest drift among qualifying balances. No real samples or chemicals are involved.
body.zh: 合成學習紀錄。新樣本批次要求天平偏差小於或等於 0.05 g。批次有 12 個樣本，每個樣本需要一次稱量。化驗所每日最多可完成 10 次稱量。批次必須在覆核後 3 個工作日內開始。B-101 及 B-103 兩個天平符合偏差要求。批次亦要求使用合格天瓶中偏差最小者。不涉及真實樣本或化學品。

body.en: Synthetic learning record. Every calibration record must state the balance identifier, calibration date, drift value and tolerance. Records missing any of these four fields are incomplete. B-101, B-102 and B-103 each contain all four fields. The review must record the chosen balance identifier and the drift comparison. Uncertainty: the log does not state the reference mass value, so the absolute drift cannot be independently recalculated from the log alone.
body.zh: 合成學習紀錄。每份校正紀錄必須列明天平識別碼、校正日期、偏差值及容差。缺少任何一項的紀錄均為不完整。B-101、B-102 及 B-103 均包含全部四項。覆核必須記錄所選天平識別碼及偏差比較。不確定性：紀錄沒有列明參考砝碼數值，因此無法僅從紀錄獨立重新計算絕對偏差。

label.en: Which balance meets the drift requirement and the smallest-drift rule for the new batch?
label.zh: 哪個天平符合新批次的偏差要求及最小偏差規則？

label.en: Which statement correctly compares drift and tolerance?
label.zh: 哪項陳述正確比較偏差與容差？

label.en: B-101 drift 0.04 g is less than or equal to tolerance 0.05 g
label.zh: B-101 偏差 0.04 g 小於或等於容差 0.05 g

label.en: B-102 drift 0.07 g is less than or equal to tolerance 0.05 g
label.zh: B-102 偏差 0.07 g 小於或等於容差 0.05 g

label.en: B-103 drift 0.02 g is greater than tolerance 0.05 g
label.zh: B-103 偏差 0.02 g 大於容差 0.05 g

label.en: What is the minimum number of working days needed to complete all 12 weighings at 10 weighings per day?
label.zh: 每日最多 10 次稱量，完成全部 12 次稱量最少需要多少個工作日？

label.en: Which balances have complete calibration records?
label.zh: 哪些天平具備完整校正紀錄？

about.en: Hong Kong Standards and Testing Centre describes itself as an independent, not-for-profit testing, inspection and certification organisation established in 1963.

simulationStyle.en: Inspect synthetic sample records and quality-control results on paper. Interpret supplied criteria and document uncertainty. No chemicals, organisms or real certification decisions are involved.

description.en: Connects the chosen balance to specific drift and tolerance facts from the calibration log.
description.zh: 把所選天平與校正紀錄中的具體偏差及容差事實連結。

description.en: Shows the minimum working days calculation using the supplied weighing limit.
description.zh: 使用提供的稱量上限展示最少工作日計算。

description.en: Identifies the missing reference mass value and its effect on independent recalculation.
description.zh: 指出缺少參考砝碼數值及其對獨立重新計算的影響。

description.en: Confirms all three balances have complete records with the four required fields.
description.zh: 確認三個天平均有包含四項必要欄位的完整紀錄。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，英文 120 至 160 詞或相若香港繁體中文，並包含下一步。

description.en: Connects the chosen balance to specific drift and tolerance facts from the calibration log.
description.zh: 把所選天平與校正紀錄中的具體偏差及容差事實連結。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects B-103 and cites drift 0.02 g is less than or equal to tolerance 0.05 g. Notes B-101 also passes the drift rule at 0.04 g but B-103 has the smaller drift, so B-103 satisfies the smallest-drift rule.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇 B-103，並引用偏差 0.02 g 小於或等於容差 0.05 g。指出 B-101 亦以 0.04 g 符合偏差規則，但 B-103 偏差較小，故 B-103 符合最小偏差規則。

description.en: Shows the minimum working days calculation using the supplied weighing limit.
description.zh: 使用提供的稱量上限展示最少工作日計算。

expectedEvidence.en: States 12 samples times 1 weighing equals 12 weighings. Divides 12 by 10 weighings per day to get 1.2 days, then rounds up to 2 working days. Accepts 2 days.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 12 個樣本乘以 1 次稱量等於 12 次稱量。以 12 除以每日 10 次稱量得 1.2 日，再向上取整為 2 個工作日。接受 2 日。

description.en: Identifies the missing reference mass value and its effect on independent recalculation.
description.zh: 指出缺少參考砝碼數值及其對獨立重新計算的影響。

expectedEvidence.en: States the log does not give the reference mass value, so absolute drift cannot be independently recalculated from the log alone. Accepts a statement that the drift comparison relies on the recorded drift value.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出紀錄沒有提供參考砝碼數值，因此無法僅從紀錄獨立重新計算絕對偏差。接受偏差比較依賴紀錄偏差值的陳述。

description.en: Confirms all three balances have complete records with the four required fields.
description.zh: 確認三個天平均有包含四項必要欄位的完整紀錄。

expectedEvidence.en: States B-101, B-102 and B-103 each contain balance identifier, calibration date, drift value and tolerance, so all three records are complete.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 B-101、B-102 及 B-103 均包含天平識別碼、校正日期、偏差值及容差，因此三份紀錄均完整。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，英文 120 至 160 詞或相若香港繁體中文，並包含下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states chosen balance B-103, drift comparison, 2 working days calculation, uncertainty about reference mass, the 3-working-day start deadline, and next steps such as recording the review and starting the batch within 3 working days.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明指出所選天平 B-103、偏差比較、2 個工作日計算、參考砝碼的不確定性、3 個工作日開始期限，以及下一步如記錄覆核並在 3 個工作日內開始批次。

exemplar.en: Handover for batch review. Chosen balance: B-103. The calibration log shows B-103 drift 0.02 g, which is less than or equal to the 0.05 g tolerance. B-101 drift 0.04 g also passes the drift rule, but B-103 has the smaller drift, so B-103 meets the smallest-drift rule. B-102 drift 0.07 g fails. Calculation: 12 samples times 1 weighing equals 12 weighings. At 10 weighings per day, 12 divided by 10 equals 1.2 days, rounded up to 2 working days. All three records are complete with identifier, date, drift and tolerance. Uncertainty: the log does not state the reference mass value, so absolute drift cannot be independently recalculated. Next steps: record this review, use B-103, and start the batch within 3 working days.
exemplar.zh: 批次覆核交接。所選天平：B-103。校正紀錄顯示 B-103 偏差 0.02 g，小於或等於容差 0.05 g。B-101 偏差 0.04 g 亦符合偏差規則，但 B-103 偏差較小，故 B-103 符合最小偏差規則。B-102 偏差 0.07 g 不合格。計算：12 個樣本乘以 1 次稱量等於 12 次稱量。每日 10 次稱量，12 除以 10 等於 1.2 日，向上取整為 2 個工作日。三份紀錄均完整，包含識別碼、日期、偏差及容差。不確定性：紀錄沒有列明參考砝碼數值，因此無法獨立重新計算絕對偏差。下一步：記錄本次覆核，使用 B-103，並在 3 個工作日內開始批次。

title.en: Synthetic Sample-Condition Evidence Review for a Client Handover
title.zh: 合成樣本狀況證據審閱及客戶交接

brief.en: You are assisting an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs on an independent demo. A client sent synthetic water and soil monitoring records for a screening review. All thresholds, records and limits in the documents are fictional scenario assumptions, not legal discharge standards. Read the two source documents, answer the questions, then write a 120 to 160 English word handover (or comparable Traditional Chinese) for the client. State the condition decision, the estimated reduction, uncertainty and next steps. Do not treat any scenario threshold as official.
brief.zh: 你正協助環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家進行獨立示範。客戶提交合成水質及泥土監測紀錄作篩選審閱。文件內所有門檻、紀錄及限值均為虛構情境假設，並非法定排放標準。請閱讀兩份文件、回答問題，然後為客戶撰寫120至160英文詞的交接說明（或相若中文）。說明狀況判定、估計減幅、不確定性及下一步。切勿把任何情境門檻當作官方標準。

title.zh: 合成水質監測紀錄 W-204

body.en: Fictional scenario record. Client: Harbour View Facility. Sample W-204 collected 12 March, one grab sample, no duplicate. Turbidity 18 NTU. Scenario screening threshold for turbidity is 15 NTU, values above the threshold are flagged. Baseline turbidity before a proposed settling step is 18 NTU. The proposed settling step is estimated to reduce turbidity by 4 NTU. Hard budget for this step is HKD 9000. Estimated cost is HKD 7200. Chain of custody is complete. Sample volume was low, so no re-test is possible from this bottle.
body.zh: 虛構情境紀錄。客戶：海景設施。樣本 W-204 於3月12日採集，單一抓取樣本，無重複樣本。濁度18 NTU。濁度情境篩選門檻為15 NTU，高於門檻即被標示。建議沉降步驟前的基線濁度為18 NTU。建議沉降步驟估計可降低濁度4 NTU。此步驟硬性預算為9,000港元。估計成本為7,200港元。監管鏈完整。樣本體積偏低，此瓶無法重測。

title.en: Synthetic Soil Record S-118 and Review Rules
title.zh: 合成泥土紀錄 S-118 及審閱規則

body.en: Fictional scenario record. Client: Harbour View Facility. Sample S-118 collected 12 March, one composite sample from three points, no field duplicate. Lead 42 mg/kg. Scenario screening threshold for lead is 50 mg/kg, values at or above the threshold are flagged. Zinc 130 mg/kg. Scenario screening threshold for zinc is 120 mg/kg, values above the threshold are flagged. Review rule: a sample is classed as condition-flagged when any analyte is flagged. A sample with no flagged analyte is classed as condition-clear. Zinc has no proposed reduction step in this scenario.
body.zh: 虛構情境紀錄。客戶：海景設施。樣本 S-118 於3月12日採集，由三個點組成的單一混合樣本，無現場重複樣本。鉛42 mg/kg。鉛的情境篩選門檻為50 mg/kg，達到或高於門檻即被標示。鋅130 mg/kg。鋅的情境篩選門檻為120 mg/kg，高於門檻即被標示。審閱規則：任何分析物被標示，樣本即列為狀況標示。無分析物被標示的樣本列為狀況清晰。此情境中鋅並無建議減排步驟。

label.en: Using the review rule, how is sample S-118 classed?
label.zh: 根據審閱規則，樣本 S-118 屬哪一類？

label.en: How is sample W-204 classed against the turbidity threshold?
label.zh: 樣本 W-204 相對濁度門檻屬哪一類？

label.en: What is the estimated turbidity after the proposed settling step, in NTU?
label.zh: 建議沉降步驟後估計濁度為多少 NTU？

label.en: What is the estimated budget headroom for the settling step, in HKD?
label.zh: 沉降步驟的估計預算餘額為多少港元？

label.en: Which statements about evidence limits are supported by the records? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些關於證據限制的陳述獲紀錄支持？選出所有適用者。

label.en: Neither sample has a duplicate for precision checking
label.zh: 兩個樣本均無重複樣本作精密度檢查

label.en: W-204 cannot be re-tested from the same bottle
label.zh: W-204 無法以同一瓶重測

label.en: A zinc reduction step is proposed in this scenario
label.zh: 此情境建議了鋅減排步驟

label.en: The chain of custody for W-204 is complete

description.zh: 撰寫清晰的120至160英文詞或相若中文交接，包含判定、數字、不確定性及下一步。

description.en: Treats all thresholds and limits as fictional scenario assumptions rather than official standards.
description.zh: 把所有門檻及限值視為虛構情境假設，而非官方標準。

description.en: States the correct condition class for both samples using the stated rules and thresholds.
description.zh: 運用所述規則及門檻，為兩個樣本說明正確狀況分類。

expectedEvidence.en: S-118 is condition-flagged because zinc 130 mg/kg is above the zinc threshold of 120 mg/kg, even though lead 42 mg/kg is below the lead threshold of 50 mg/kg. W-204 is above threshold and flagged because turbidity 18 NTU is above the 15 NTU threshold.
expectedEvidence.zh: S-118 屬狀況標示，因鋅130 mg/kg高於鋅門檻120 mg/kg，即使鉛42 mg/kg低於鉛門檻50 mg/kg。W-204 高於門檻並被標示，因濁度18 NTU高於15 NTU門檻。

description.en: Shows the estimated post-step turbidity and budget headroom with correct arithmetic and units.
description.zh: 以正確運算及單位展示步驟後估計濁度及預算餘額。

expectedEvidence.en: Estimated turbidity is 18 minus 4 equals 14 NTU. Budget headroom is 9000 minus 7200 equals 1800 HKD. Accept 14 NTU and 1800 HKD with the method shown.
expectedEvidence.zh: 估計濁度為18減4等於14 NTU。預算餘額為9,000減7,200等於1,800港元。展示方法並接受14 NTU及1,800港元。

description.en: Identifies the specific record limitations and explains how they affect confidence in the screening result.
description.zh: 指出具體紀錄限制，並解釋其如何影響篩選結果的可信度。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that W-204 is a single grab sample with no duplicate and low volume so no re-test is possible, and S-118 is a single composite from three points with no field duplicate. Explains that these limits reduce confidence and that the 4 NTU reduction is only an estimate.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 W-204 為單一抓取樣本、無重複樣本且體積偏低，無法重測；S-118 為三個點的單一混合樣本，無現場重複樣本。解釋這些限制降低可信度，而4 NTU減幅僅屬估計。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, with decisions, numbers, uncertainty and next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的120至160英文詞或相若中文交接，包含判定、數字、不確定性及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states both condition classes, 14 NTU, 1800 HKD headroom, the sample limitations, and a practical next step such as confirming sampling or re-sampling before any decision. Word count within 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明兩個狀況分類、14 NTU、1,800港元餘額、樣本限制，以及實用下一步，例如在決定前確認採樣或重新採樣。英文詞數介乎120至160或相若中文。

description.en: Treats all thresholds and limits as fictional scenario assumptions rather than official standards.
description.zh: 把所有門檻及限值視為虛構情境假設，而非官方標準。

expectedEvidence.en: States or implies that the 15 NTU, 50 mg/kg and 120 mg/kg thresholds are invented scenario screening values and not legal discharge standards, and avoids giving legal or official technical advice.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明或暗示15 NTU、50 mg/kg及120 mg/kg門檻為虛構情境篩選值，並非法定排放標準，且避免提供法律或官方技術意見。

exemplar.en: Handover for Harbour View Facility, synthetic screening review. Sample S-118 is condition-flagged because zinc at 130 mg/kg is above the scenario zinc threshold of 120 mg/kg, although lead at 42 mg/kg is below its 50 mg/kg threshold. Sample W-204 is above threshold and flagged because turbidity at 18 NTU is above the scenario 15 NTU threshold. The proposed settling step is estimated to reduce turbidity by 4 NTU, giving 14 NTU. Estimated cost is HKD 7200 against a hard budget of HKD 9000, leaving HKD 1800 headroom. Confidence is limited. W-204 is a single grab sample with no duplicate and low volume, so no re-test is possible. S-118 is one composite from three points with no field duplicate. The 4 NTU reduction is only an estimate. All thresholds are fictional scenario values, not legal discharge standards. Next step: confirm sampling and consider re-sampling before any decision.
exemplar.zh: 海景設施交接說明，合成篩選審閱。樣本 S-118 屬狀況標示，因鋅130 mg/kg高於情境鋅門檻120 mg/kg，雖然鉛42 mg/kg低於其50 mg/kg門檻。樣本 W-204 高於門檻並被標示，因濁度18 NTU高於情境15 NTU門檻。建議沉降步驟估計降低濁度4 NTU，即14 NTU。估計成本7,200港元，相對硬性預算9,000港元，餘額1,800港元。可信度有限。W-204 為單一抓取樣本、無重複樣本且體積偏低，無法重測。S-118 為三個點的單一混合樣本，無現場重複樣本。4 NTU減幅僅屬估計。所有門檻均為虛構情境值，並非法定排放標準。下一步：確認採樣，並在決定前考慮重新採樣。

title.en: Merchant Request Prioritisation for a Fictional Delivery Pilot
title.zh: 虛構配送試點商戶需求優先排序

brief.en: You are a business analyst in an independent demo, not endorsed by Lalamove. A fictional merchant pilot has four candidate requests and a hard budget of HKD 20,000. The stated objective is to maximise the estimated monthly reduction in late deliveries within that budget. Read the two fictional source documents, choose which requests to fund, calculate the total cost and estimated reduction, and write a 120 to 160 word English handover or comparable Traditional Chinese. All internal figures, teams and records are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是一名商業分析師，參與獨立示範，並非獲 Lalamove 認可。一個虛構商戶試點有四項候選需求，硬性預算為 20,000 港元。既定目標是在該預算內把預計每月延誤減幅最大化。閱讀兩份虛構文件，選出資助哪些需求，計算總成本及預計減幅，並撰寫 120 至 160 英文字交接說明或相若中文。所有內部數字、團隊及紀錄均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional merchant pilot register. Request R1 route batching costs HKD 8,000 and is estimated to reduce late deliveries by 30 cases per month. Request R2 driver reminder messages costs HKD 5,000 and is estimated to reduce late deliveries by 12 cases per month. Request R3 merchant packing checklist costs HKD 9,000 and is estimated to reduce late deliveries by 25 cases per month. Request R4 customer pickup notice costs HKD 4,000 and is estimated to reduce late deliveries by 8 cases per month. Each request may be funded at most once. The pilot budget is HKD 20,000 and must not be exceeded.
body.zh: 虛構商戶試點登記表。需求 R1 路線合併成本 8,000 港元，預計每月減少 30 宗延誤。需求 R2 司機提示訊息成本 5,000 港元，預計每月減少 12 宗延誤。需求 R3 商戶包裝清單成本 9,000 港元，預計每月減少 25 宗延誤。需求 R4 顧客取貨通知成本 4,000 港元，預計每月減少 8 宗延誤。每項需求最多資助一次。試點預算為 20,000 港元，不得超支。

body.en: Fictional pilot constraints. The current baseline is 120 late deliveries per month. The pilot must fund at least three requests. R1 and R3 cannot both be funded because they share the same fictional packing team. R2 and R4 may be funded together. Estimated reductions are monthly and additive when requests are combined. The pilot runs for one month only. The stated objective is to maximise the estimated monthly reduction in late deliveries within the HKD 20,000 hard budget. No contingency, approval or preference is assumed beyond these stated rules.
body.zh: 虛構試點限制。目前基線為每月 120 宗延誤。試點必須資助至少三項需求。R1 與 R3 不可同時資助，因兩者共用同一虛構包裝團隊。R2 與 R4 可同時資助。預計減幅為每月數字，合併時可相加。試點只運行一個月。既定目標是在 20,000 港元硬性預算內，把預計每月延誤減幅最大化。除上述規則外，不假設任何應急費用、審批或偏好。

label.en: Which combination of requests should be funded to maximise the estimated monthly reduction within the hard budget?
label.zh: 為在硬性預算內把預計每月減幅最大化，應資助哪個需求組合？

label.en: What is the total cost in HKD of the funded combination?
label.zh: 獲資助組合的總成本是多少港元？

label.en: What is the total estimated monthly reduction in late deliveries for the funded combination?
label.zh: 獲資助組合的預計每月延誤減幅總數是多少？

label.en: Which statements about the pilot constraints are correct?
label.zh: 哪些關於試點限制的陳述正確？

label.en: The baseline is 120 late deliveries per month.
label.zh: 基線為每月 120 宗延誤。

label.en: The pilot must fund at least three requests.
label.zh: 試點必須資助至少三項需求。

label.en: R1 and R3 can both be funded.
label.zh: R1 與 R3 可同時資助。

label.en: The pilot runs for one month only.

about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.
about.zh: Lalamove 介紹其為 2013 年於香港創立的即時配送平台，連結個人、企業及配送車輛。

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse a fictional merchant workflow, prioritise requirements and propose a measurable service improvement without making promises about actual driver or platform performance.
simulationStyle.zh: 分析虛構商戶流程，排列需求優先次序，並提出可量度的服務改善，不對真實司機或平台表現作出承諾。

description.en: Selects the combination that maximises the estimated monthly reduction within the hard budget and respects the R1 and R3 restriction.
description.zh: 在硬性預算內選出使預計每月減幅最大化的組合，並遵守 R1 與 R3 的限制。

description.en: Calculates total cost and estimated reduction correctly using the stated figures.
description.zh: 使用所列數字正確計算總成本及預計減幅。

description.en: Identifies and applies the baseline, minimum request count, R1 and R3 restriction, one month duration and the stated objective.
description.zh: 識別並應用基線、最少需求數目、R1 與 R3 限制、一個月期限及既定目標。

description.en: Explains the decision with specific source facts and clear reasoning, including why the chosen combination beats the alternative.
description.zh: 以具體文件事實及清晰推理說明決策，包括所選組合為何優於另一組合。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，120 至 160 英文字或相若中文，並包含下一步。

description.en: Selects the combination that maximises the estimated monthly reduction within the hard budget and respects the R1 and R3 restriction.
description.zh: 在硬性預算內選出使預計每月減幅最大化的組合，並遵守 R1 與 R3 的限制。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects R1, R2 and R4. Total cost HKD 17,000, within the HKD 20,000 budget, and reduction 50 cases per month, which is higher than the alternative R2, R3 and R4 at 45 cases per month. Avoids R3 because R1 and R3 cannot both be funded.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選出 R1、R2 及 R4。總成本 17,000 港元，在 20,000 港元預算內，減幅為每月 50 宗，高於另一組合 R2、R3 及 R4 的每月 45 宗。避免 R3，因 R1 與 R3 不可同時資助。

description.en: Calculates total cost and estimated reduction correctly using the stated figures.
description.zh: 使用所列數字正確計算總成本及預計減幅。

expectedEvidence.en: Cost: 8,000 + 5,000 + 4,000 = HKD 17,000. Reduction: 30 + 12 + 8 = 50 cases per month.

description.en: Identifies and applies the baseline, minimum request count, R1 and R3 restriction, one month duration and the stated objective.
description.zh: 識別並應用基線、最少需求數目、R1 與 R3 限制、一個月期限及既定目標。

expectedEvidence.en: States baseline 120 late deliveries per month, at least three requests, R1 and R3 cannot both be funded, the pilot runs one month only, and the objective is to maximise estimated monthly reduction within the hard budget.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出基線為每月 120 宗延誤、至少資助三項需求、R1 與 R3 不可同時資助、試點只運行一個月，以及目標是在硬性預算內把預計每月減幅最大化。

description.en: Explains the decision with specific source facts and clear reasoning, including why the chosen combination beats the alternative.
description.zh: 以具體文件事實及清晰推理說明決策，包括所選組合為何優於另一組合。

expectedEvidence.en: Links the chosen combination to the request register costs and reductions, and to the constraint document rules. Explains why R3 is excluded and why R1, R2 and R4 at 50 cases per month beats R2, R3 and R4 at 45 cases per month.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把所選組合連繫到需求登記表的成本及減幅，以及限制文件規則。解釋為何排除 R3，以及為何 R1、R2 及 R4 的每月 50 宗優於 R2、R3 及 R4 的每月 45 宗。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of 120 to 160 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，120 至 160 英文字或相若中文，並包含下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover within 120 to 160 English words or comparable Chinese, covering decision, cost, reduction, risk and next steps.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明在 120 至 160 英文字或相若中文內，涵蓋決策、成本、減幅、風險及下一步。

exemplar.en: Decision: fund R1, R2 and R4. The register shows R1 costs HKD 8,000 and reduces 30 late deliveries monthly, R2 costs HKD 5,000 and reduces 12, and R4 costs HKD 4,000 and reduces 8. Total cost is HKD 17,000, within the HKD 20,000 budget. Total estimated reduction is 50 cases per month against a baseline of 120. The alternative R2, R3 and R4 costs HKD 18,000 and reduces only 45 cases, so it is worse. I excluded R3 because the constraint document states R1 and R3 cannot both be funded, as they share the same fictional packing team. The pilot must fund at least three requests and runs one month only, so this combination meets both rules. Risk: estimates are fictional and monthly only. Next step: confirm the fictional packing team schedule before launch.
exemplar.zh: 決策：資助 R1、R2 及 R4。登記表顯示 R1 成本 8,000 港元，每月減少 30 宗延誤；R2 成本 5,000 港元，減少 12 宗；R4 成本 4,000 港元，減少 8 宗。總成本 17,000 港元，在 20,000 港元預算內。預計總減幅為每月 50 宗，基線為 120 宗。另一組合 R2、R3 及 R4 成本 18,000 港元，只減少 45 宗，因此較差。我排除 R3，因限制文件指出 R1 與 R3 不可同時資助，兩者共用同一虛構包裝團隊。試點必須資助至少三項需求，且只運行一個月，此組合符合兩項規則。風險：估算屬虛構且僅為每月數字。下一步：啟動前確認虛構包裝團隊時間表。

feedback.en: You correctly funded R1 R2 and R4 at HKD 17,000 and 50 cases per month, which beats the R2 R3 R4 alternative at 45 cases and respects the R1 and R3 restriction.
feedback.zh: 你正確資助 R1、R2 及 R4，總成本 17,000 港元，每月減少 50 宗，優於 R2、R3 及 R4 的 45 宗，並遵守 R1 與 R3 的限制。

feedback.en: Your arithmetic is fully correct: 8,000 + 5,000 + 4,000 = HKD 17,000 and 30 + 12 + 8 = 50 cases per month.
You applied the baseline of 120 late deliveries, the minimum of three requests, the R1 and R3 conflict, the one month duration and the budget objective.
feedback.zh: 你應用了每月 120 宗延誤的基線、最少三項需求、R1 與 R3 的衝突、一個月期限及預算目標。

feedback.en: Your handover cites specific register costs and reductions and clearly explains why R3 is excluded and why your chosen option beats the alternative.
feedback.zh: 你的交接說明引用了登記表的具體成本及減幅，並清楚解釋為何排除 R3，以及所選方案為何優於另一方案。

feedback.en: At 140 English words you are within the 120 to 160 guidance, and your handover covers decision, cost, reduction, risk and next step.
feedback.zh: 你的英文 140 字在 120 至 160 字指引內，交接涵蓋決策、成本、減幅、風險及下一步。

summary.en: All selected answers and written evidence are accurate. The submission meets the fictional pilot brief and constraints with a clear, well evidenced handover.
summary.zh: 所有選項答案及書面證據均準確。提交內容符合虛構試點簡介及限制，交接說明清晰且證據充分。

nextSteps.en: No correction is needed. If you revise, continue to cite source figures and keep the explicit objective in future handovers.
nextSteps.zh: 無需更正。如需修改，請繼續引用文件數字，並在日後交接中保留明確目標。

title.en: Zone reliability snapshot with explicit denominators
title.zh: 分區可靠性快照：明確分母

brief.en: You are a junior data analyst in a fictional learning simulation, not a foodpanda employee. A synthetic weekly operations extract for three Hong Kong service zones is attached. Clean the records, compute each zone's on-time rate using the stated denominator, and identify which zone has the lowest on-time rate. Then write a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, explaining the metric, the uncertainty, and one next step. Do not claim causality.
brief.zh: 你是一個虛構學習情境中的初級數據分析師，並非 foodpanda 員工。附件是三個香港服務分區的合成每週營運摘錄。請清理記錄，按指定分母計算各區準時率，並找出準時率最低的分區。然後撰寫約100至180英文字（或相若繁體中文）的簡潔證據為本交接說明，解釋指標、不確定性及一項下一步。不要宣稱因果關係。

body.en: Fictional learning data. Week 41, three zones. Each zone has a stated total order count and a stated count of orders delivered within the promised window. Central: 400 total orders, 340 on time. Harbour: 250 total orders, 195 on time. Peak: 150 total orders, 108 on time. On-time means delivered at or before the promised time. Orders with missing timestamps are excluded from both counts and are not in the totals above. No duplicate order IDs exist.
body.zh: 虛構學習資料。第41週，三個分區。每區有明確總訂單數及明確在承諾時限內送達的訂單數。中環：總訂單400，準時340。港灣：總訂單250，準時195。高峰：總訂單150，準時108。準時指在承諾時間或之前送達。時間戳缺失的訂單已從兩個計數中排除，並不在上述總數內。沒有重複訂單編號。

title.zh: 指標定義與不確定性說明

body.en: Fictional learning note. On-time rate equals on-time orders divided by total orders for that zone. Report rates to one decimal place. A rate difference below 2.0 percentage points between two zones is treated as inconclusive in this exercise. Simultaneous incidents in two zones do not establish that one caused the other. Weather and staffing are not recorded in this extract, so they cannot be tested here.
body.zh: 虛構學習備註。準時率等於該區準時訂單除以總訂單。比率以一個小數位表示。兩個分區之間比率差距低於2.0個百分點，在本練習中視為未能定論。兩個分區同時發生事故，並不證明其一導致其二。本摘錄沒有記錄天氣與人手，因此無法在此檢驗。

label.en: Which zone has the lowest on-time rate?
label.zh: 哪個分區的準時率最低？

label.en: Central on-time rate, in percent to one decimal place
label.zh: 中環準時率，百分比，一個小數位

label.en: Harbour on-time rate, in percent to one decimal place
label.zh: 港灣準時率，百分比，一個小數位

label.en: Peak on-time rate, in percent to one decimal place
label.zh: 高峰準時率，百分比，一個小數位

label.en: Is the gap between the two lowest zones conclusive under the stated rule?
label.zh: 按指定規則，最低兩區之間的差距是否可下定論？

label.en: Conclusive, gap is 2.0 points or more
label.zh: 可下定論，差距為2.0個百分點或以上
未能定論，差距低於2.0個百分點

about.en: foodpanda operates a Hong Kong food-delivery platform connecting customers with restaurants and retail partners.
about.zh: foodpanda 在香港營運餐飲配送平台，連結客戶、餐廳及零售合作商戶。

simulationStyle.en: Work with synthetic delivery data, explain uncertainty and distinguish service observations from causal claims. This is a learning scenario, not foodpanda operational data.
simulationStyle.zh: 使用合成配送資料，說明不確定性，並區分服務觀察與因果判斷。這是學習情境，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。

description.en: States the on-time rate formula and uses the correct zone denominator for each calculation.
description.zh: 說明準時率公式，並為每個計算使用正確的分區分母。

description.en: Reports each zone rate to one decimal place and identifies the lowest zone correctly.
description.zh: 各區比率以一個小數位表示，並正確指出最低分區。

description.en: Applies the stated 2.0 percentage point rule and avoids causal claims from simultaneous incidents.
description.zh: 應用指定的2.0個百分點規則，並避免由同時發生事故作出因果判斷。

description.en: Writes a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with metric, uncertainty and one next step.
description.zh: 撰寫約100至180英文字或相若繁體中文的簡潔證據為本交接，包含指標、不確定性及一項下一步。

description.en: Mentions exclusion of missing-timestamp orders and absence of duplicate order IDs.
description.zh: 提及排除時間戳缺失訂單及沒有重複訂單編號。

description.en: States the on-time rate formula and uses the correct zone denominator for each calculation.
