expectedEvidence.en: On-time rate equals on-time orders divided by total orders. Central 340/400, Harbour 195/250, Peak 108/150. Missing-timestamp orders are excluded and not in totals.
expectedEvidence.zh: 準時率等於準時訂單除以總訂單。中環340/400，港灣195/250，高峰108/150。時間戳缺失訂單已排除，不在總數內。

description.en: Reports each zone rate to one decimal place and identifies the lowest zone correctly.
description.zh: 各區比率以一個小數位表示，並正確指出最低分區。

expectedEvidence.en: Central 85.0 percent, Harbour 78.0 percent, Peak 72.0 percent. Peak is lowest.

description.en: Applies the stated 2.0 percentage point rule and avoids causal claims from simultaneous incidents.
description.zh: 應用指定的2.0個百分點規則，並避免由同時發生事故作出因果判斷。

expectedEvidence.en: Harbour to Peak gap is 6.0 points, so conclusive. Weather and staffing are not recorded and cannot be tested. Simultaneous incidents do not prove causation.
expectedEvidence.zh: 港灣與高峰差距為6.0個百分點，故可下定論。天氣與人手沒有記錄，無法檢驗。同時發生事故不證明因果。

description.en: Writes a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with metric, uncertainty and one next step.
description.zh: 撰寫約100至180英文字或相若繁體中文的簡潔證據為本交接，包含指標、不確定性及一項下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states the formula, the three rates, the lowest zone, the threshold result, and one practical next step such as checking missing timestamps or adding weather and staffing fields.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明公式、三個比率、最低分區、門檻結果，以及一項實務下一步，例如檢查缺失時間戳或加入天氣與人手欄位。

description.en: Mentions exclusion of missing-timestamp orders and absence of duplicate order IDs.
description.zh: 提及排除時間戳缺失訂單及沒有重複訂單編號。

expectedEvidence.en: Missing-timestamp orders excluded from both counts and totals. No duplicate order IDs exist.
expectedEvidence.zh: 時間戳缺失訂單已從兩個計數及總數中排除。沒有重複訂單編號。

exemplar.en: This fictional Week 41 extract covers three zones. On-time rate equals on-time orders divided by total orders, with missing-timestamp orders excluded and no duplicate order IDs. Central is 340 of 400, or 85.0 percent. Harbour is 195 of 250, or 78.0 percent. Peak is 108 of 150, or 72.0 percent. Peak has the lowest on-time rate. The Harbour to Peak gap is 6.0 percentage points, above the 2.0 point rule, so the difference is conclusive in this exercise. Weather and staffing are not recorded, so they cannot be tested, and simultaneous incidents do not prove causation. Next step: add weather and staffing fields and review missing timestamps before next week.
exemplar.zh: 這份虛構第41週摘錄涵蓋三個分區。準時率等於準時訂單除以總訂單，時間戳缺失訂單已排除，且沒有重複訂單編號。中環為400分之340，即85.0%。港灣為250分之195，即78.0%。高峰為150分之108，即72.0%。高峰的準時率最低。港灣與高峰差距為6.0個百分點，高於2.0個百分點規則，故本練習中差距可下定論。天氣與人手沒有記錄，無法檢驗，同時發生事故不證明因果。下一步：加入天氣與人手欄位，並在下週前檢視缺失時間戳。

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist in a fictional Klook-style booking support simulation. A customer's outdoor activity was cancelled by the operator. Review the two fictional source documents, decide the correct goodwill offer within the capped budget, and write a concise evidence-based handover for the escalation team. Aim for around 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese. Completeness and clarity matter more than an exact count. All policies, budgets and records are fictional learning assumptions. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by Klook, and not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你在一間虛構的 Klook 風格預訂支援模擬中擔任客戶營運專員。一位客戶的戶外活動被營運商取消。請閱讀兩份虛構文件，在設有上限的預算內決定正確的善意補償方案，並為轉交審核團隊撰寫簡潔且以證據為本的交接說明。目標約 100 至 180 英文字，或相若繁體中文。完整與清晰比精確字數更重要。所有政策、預算及紀錄均為虛構學習假設。此為獨立示範，未獲 Klook 認可，亦非招聘廣告。

title.zh: 虛構善意補償政策摘錄

body.en: Fictional policy for this simulation only. Case KX-2041: operator cancelled an outdoor activity 30 hours before start. The customer paid HKD 800 and has already received a full refund of HKD 800. Goodwill credit applies only when the operator cancels within 48 hours of start. The goodwill cap per case is HKD 300. Standard goodwill is HKD 150. An uplift of HKD 100 applies only when the customer confirmed a booked flight or train to reach the activity. Total goodwill must not exceed the cap. No cash payments are allowed.
body.zh: 此政策僅適用於本模擬。個案 KX-2041：營運商於活動開始前 30 小時取消戶外活動。客戶已付 HKD 800，並已獲全額退款 HKD 800。善意補償只適用於營運商在活動開始前 48 小時內取消的情況。每宗個案善意補償上限為 HKD 300。標準善意補償為 HKD 150。只有當客戶確認已預訂航班或火車前往活動地點時，才可加 HKD 100。善意補償總額不得超過上限。不允許現金賠償。

body.en: Case KX-2041. Customer: fictional guest. Activity: outdoor kayaking tour. Operator cancelled 30 hours before start. Refund of HKD 800 confirmed. Customer confirmed a booked train to the activity area. Customer asked whether the refund covers the train cost. The train cost is not covered by this fictional policy. Customer also asked for a written explanation of the goodwill decision. No injury or safety incident is recorded. Customer did not state any mobility need.
body.zh: 個案 KX-2041。客戶：虛構訪客。活動：戶外獨木舟團。營運商於開始前 30 小時取消。已確認退款 HKD 800。客戶確認已預訂火車前往活動地區。客戶詢問退款是否涵蓋火車費用。此虛構政策不涵蓋火車費用。客戶亦要求書面解釋善意補償決定。紀錄沒有受傷或安全事故。客戶沒有說明任何行動需要。

title.en: Support Queue Service Levels and Cancelled Tickets
title.zh: 支援隊列服務水平與已取消工單

brief.en: You are a data analyst at a fictional Hong Kong delivery platform. Review the synthetic support queue records for one week. Clean the data, calculate service-level metrics, and interpret what the numbers do and do not show. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. All records are fictional learning data, not real company data. This is an independent demo and is not endorsed by any company.
brief.zh: 你是虛構香港配送平台的數據分析師。請審閱一週的合成支援隊列記錄，清理資料、計算服務水平指標，並解讀數字能與不能說明的事。以英文或香港繁體中文交付簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，建議約100至180英文字或相應中文。所有記錄均為虛構學習資料，並非真實公司資料。此為獨立示範，未獲任何公司認可。

body.en: Synthetic week of 10 October 2026. Total tickets raised: 240. Tickets cancelled by customers before any agent reply: 30. Tickets resolved within 4 hours: 150. Tickets resolved after 4 hours: 60. Tickets still open at week end: 0. All 240 tickets are counted once. Cancelled tickets are not counted as resolved. Service-level target: resolved within 4 hours, inclusive of exactly 4 hours.
body.zh: 合成記錄，2026年10月10日該週。新增工單總數：240。客戶在客服回覆前取消的工單：30。4小時內完成的工單：150。超過4小時完成的工單：60。週末仍待處理：0。240張工單各計算一次。已取消工單不計為已完成。服務水平目標：4小時內完成，包含剛好4小時。

body.en: Synthetic codes for the 30 cancelled tickets. Customer changed mind: 12. Duplicate ticket raised by same customer: 8. Restaurant closed before reply: 6. App error reported: 4. Each cancelled ticket has exactly one code. Duplicate tickets are separate tickets in the 240 total. No cancelled ticket was later reopened.
body.zh: 30張已取消工單的合成代碼。客戶改變主意：12。同一客戶重複開單：8。餐廳在回覆前關閉：6。應用程式錯誤：4。每張已取消工單只有一個代碼。重複工單在240總數中屬獨立工單。沒有已取消工單其後重開。

body.en: Synthetic definitions. Resolution rate equals resolved tickets divided by all tickets raised. Resolved tickets are those completed within 4 hours plus those completed after 4 hours. Cancelled tickets stay in the denominator. Service-level rate equals tickets resolved within 4 hours divided by all tickets raised. Do not treat cancellation reasons as causes of slow resolution.
body.zh: 合成定義。完成率等於已完成工單除以新增工單總數。已完成工單為4小時內完成加上超過4小時完成。已取消工單仍留在分母。服務水平率等於4小時內完成工單除以新增工單總數。不要把取消原因當作處理緩慢的原因。

label.en: How many tickets were resolved in total?
label.zh: 共有多少張工單已完成？

label.en: What is the service-level rate, as a percentage rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 服務水平率為多少百分比，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: Which statement about the cancelled tickets is best supported?

label.en: Cancellations reduce the denominator used for the service-level rate.
label.zh: 取消情況會減少服務水平率所用的分母。

label.en: Cancellations stay in the denominator and are not resolved tickets.
label.zh: 取消工單留在分母，且不屬已完成工單。

label.en: Duplicate tickets were removed from the 240 total.
label.zh: 重複工單已從240總數中移除。

label.en: Which cleaning and interpretation points are correct? Select all that apply.

label.en: Each ticket is counted once in the 240 total.
label.zh: 每張工單在240總數中只計算一次。

label.en: Cancelled tickets should be added to resolved tickets.
label.zh: 已取消工單應加入已完成工單。

label.en: Cancellation reasons cannot be read as causes of late resolution.
label.zh: 取消原因不可解讀為延遲完成的原因。

label.zh: 服務水平目標為65.0%。計算所得的服務水平率顯示甚麼？

It misses the target because it is below 65.0 percent.
It cannot be compared because cancelled tickets are excluded.

label.en: It meets the target only if late tickets are removed.
label.zh: 只有移除延遲工單才達到目標。

exemplar.en: Handover for the synthetic week of 10 October 2026. All 240 tickets are counted once, and the 30 cancelled tickets stay in the denominator because they were never resolved. Resolved tickets are 150 within 4 hours plus 60 after 4 hours, giving 210. The service-level rate is 150 divided by 240, which equals 62.5 percent. This is below the 65.0 percent target, so the week misses the service-level goal. The 30 cancelled tickets are not resolved tickets, and their reason codes cannot explain the 60 late resolutions. The data cannot show why those tickets were late, so I would not claim a cause. Next step: review the late-resolution records for process patterns before proposing any change.
exemplar.zh: 2026年10月10日該週合成交接說明。全部240張工單各計算一次，30張已取消工單因從未完成而留在分母。已完成工單為4小時內150張加超過4小時60張，共210張。服務水平率為150除以240，等於62.5%，低於65.0%目標，因此該週未達服務水平目標。30張已取消工單不屬已完成工單，其原因代碼不能解釋60張延遲完成。資料無法顯示延遲原因，因此我不會斷言成因。下一步：先檢視延遲完成記錄的流程模式，再提出任何改動。

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist in a fictional Klook-style booking support simulation. A traveller reports paying twice for one sunset harbour cruise. Review the three fictional source documents, decide the refund outcome under the supplied duplicate-booking rule, calculate the refundable amount, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese for the escalation queue. Aim for roughly 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. Completeness and clarity matter, not an exact word count. All policies, records and figures are fictional learning assumptions, not real Klook terms.

body.en: Fictional rule DB-2. Two confirmed bookings for the same experience, same traveller and same start time count as a duplicate. The later booking is refundable in full when the traveller did not attend it. The earlier booking is non-refundable. A booking counts as attended only when the supplier scan record shows entry. Refunds are issued in HKD. Service fees are never refunded. This rule is a synthetic learning assumption and not a real Klook policy.
body.zh: 虛構規則 DB-2。同一體驗、同一旅客及同一開始時間的兩筆已確認預訂屬重複預訂。若旅客沒有出席，較後一筆預訂可全額退款。較早一筆預訂不可退款。只有供應商掃描紀錄顯示入場，方算出席。退款以港元發放。服務費一律不退。本規則為合成學習假設，並非 Klook 真實政策。

body.en: Fictional records for traveller LEE-4471, sunset harbour cruise, start 18:30. Booking BK-8801 confirmed first, paid HKD 620 including HKD 40 service fee, no supplier scan record. Booking BK-8802 confirmed later, paid HKD 620 including HKD 40 service fee, no supplier scan record. Both bookings name the same traveller and the same start time. The traveller states they attended once but provides no scan evidence. These records are synthetic and not real customer data.

body.en: Fictional note. The traveller asks for a refund of the later booking only. They confirm they did not attend the later booking. No accessibility, medical or mobility need is stated, so none should be assumed. The escalation queue needs the case identifier, the rule applied, the refundable amount in HKD and any uncertainty. This note is a synthetic learning assumption.

Two confirmed bookings, BK-8801 and BK-8802, share the same traveller, the same sunset harbour cruise and the same 18:30 start time, so fictional rule DB-2 applies. BK-8802 was confirmed later and the traveller confirms non-attendance, so it is refundable in full. The paid amount of HKD 620 minus the HKD 40 service fee equals HKD 580 refundable. BK-8801 is the earlier booking and is non-refundable. Uncertainty: neither booking has a supplier scan record, so attendance rests on the traveller's statement. No accessibility, medical or mobility need is stated and none is assumed. Next step: send this case to the escalation queue for refund processing of HKD 580.

brief.en: You are an independent PCB design reviewer in a fictional simulation, not an ASMPT employee. Review the fictional low-voltage sensor board package SNB-204 v1.2 for a customer-focused engineering review. Check the BOM against the footprint library, apply the simulated design rules, and identify any mismatches and rule issues. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, covering evidence, decisions, risks and next steps. All documents are synthetic learning assumptions.

body.en: Synthetic BOM for board SNB-204. Line 1: U1 sensor IC, package QFN-24, 0.5 mm pitch, footprint QFN-24-05. Line 2: C7 capacitor, 0402, footprint CAP-0402. Line 3: J3 connector, 10-pin, 1.0 mm pitch, footprint CON-10-10. Line 4: R12 resistor, 0603, footprint RES-0603. All parts are fictional. Quantities are one each.
body.zh: 虛構板 SNB-204 的合成物料清單。第 1 項：U1 感測器集成電路，封裝 QFN-24，0.5 毫米間距，焊盤圖 QFN-24-05。第 2 項：C7 電容，0402，焊盤圖 CAP-0402。第 3 項：J3 連接器，10 針，1.0 毫米間距，焊盤圖 CON-10-10。第 4 項：R12 電阻，0603，焊盤圖 RES-0603。所有零件均為虛構。每項數量為一。

title.en: Fictional footprint library and design rules
title.zh: 虛構焊盤圖庫與設計規則

body.en: Synthetic library: QFN-24-05 matches 0.5 mm pitch QFN-24. CAP-0402 matches 0402. CON-10-10 matches 1.0 mm pitch 10-pin. RES-0603 matches 0603. Simulated rule DR-7: minimum pad clearance is 0.15 mm, inclusive. Simulated rule DR-9: component courtyard must not overlap. Board SNB-204 measured minimum pad clearance is 0.12 mm. Courtyards for U1 and C7 overlap by 0.05 mm.
body.zh: 虛構圖庫：QFN-24-05 對應 0.5 毫米間距 QFN-24。CAP-0402 對應 0402。CON-10-10 對應 1.0 毫米間距 10 針。RES-0603 對應 0603。模擬規則 DR-7：最小焊盤間距為 0.15 毫米，包含在內。模擬規則 DR-9：元件外框不得重疊。板 SNB-204 量得最小焊盤間距為 0.12 毫米。U1 與 C7 外框重疊 0.05 毫米。

body.en: Synthetic log for SNB-204. Version v1.2 reviewed. BOM line 3 lists J3 as 10-pin 1.0 mm pitch. Library CON-10-10 is 10-pin 1.0 mm pitch. No mismatch found for J3. U1 footprint QFN-24-05 matches BOM. C7 and R12 footprints match BOM. Two rule issues remain: DR-7 clearance 0.12 mm against 0.15 mm minimum, and DR-9 courtyard overlap 0.05 mm.
body.zh: SNB-204 的合成記錄。已審查版本 v1.2。物料清單第 3 項列 J3 為 10 針 1.0 毫米間距。圖庫 CON-10-10 為 10 針 1.0 毫米間距。J3 未發現不匹配。U1 焊盤圖 QFN-24-05 與物料清單相符。C7 與 R12 焊盤圖與物料清單相符。仍有兩項規則問題：DR-7 間距 0.12 毫米對 0.15 毫米下限，以及 DR-9 外框重疊 0.05 毫米。

expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此為虛構紙面審查，不認證真實電路板。

exemplar.en: Evidence: BOM line 3 lists J3 as 10-pin 1.0 mm pitch and library CON-10-10 matches, so no BOM mismatch exists. U1, C7 and R12 footprints also match. The synthetic log for SNB-204 v1.2 shows two rule issues. DR-7 minimum pad clearance is 0.15 mm inclusive, measured 0.12 mm, a gap of 0.03 mm. DR-9 courtyard overlap is 0.05 mm between U1 and C7. Decision: flag DR-7 and DR-9 for engineering review, no BOM change needed. Risks: measured values come from the simulated log, not a real board, and this is a fictional paper review only. Next steps: send the two rule issues to the review lead with the v1.2 log reference.
exemplar.zh: 證據：物料清單第 3 項列 J3 為 10 針 1.0 毫米間距，圖庫 CON-10-10 相符，故物料清單無不匹配。U1、C7 及 R12 焊盤圖亦相符。SNB-204 v1.2 合成記錄顯示兩項規則問題。DR-7 最小焊盤間距為 0.15 毫米，包含在內，量得 0.12 毫米，差 0.03 毫米。DR-9 外框重疊為 U1 與 C7 之間 0.05 毫米。決策：把 DR-7 及 DR-9 交工程審核，物料清單無需更改。風險：量得數值來自模擬記錄，並非真實電路板，且此僅為虛構紙面審查。下一步：連同 v1.2 記錄引用，把兩項規則問題交予審核主管。

brief.en: You are a laboratory analyst at STC (independent demo, not endorsed, no current vacancy). STC is an independent not-for-profit testing organisation established in 1963. Review fictional synthetic sample records against the supplied acceptance criteria. All records, limits, budgets and outcomes are fictional learning assumptions, not real STC policies or certification decisions. No chemicals, organisms or lab work are involved. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, covering evidence, decisions, calculations, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: 你是 STC 的化驗分析員（獨立示範，未經認可，並非現有職位）。STC 是成立於 1963 年的獨立非牟利測試機構。請按提供的接納標準，檢視虛構的合成樣本紀錄。所有紀錄、限值、預算及結果均為虛構學習假設，並非 STC 真實政策或認證決定，不涉及化學品、生物或實驗室工作。請提交簡潔且以證據為本的交接說明，以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫，建議約 100 至 180 英文字或相若中文，涵蓋證據、決策、計算、不確定性及下一步。

body.en: Fictional batch B-204, synthetic records only. Stage counts are unique and not deduplicated. Stage 1: 40 samples, 3 outside limit. Stage 2: 25 samples, 1 outside limit. Stage 3: 15 samples, 0 outside limit. Total samples 80. Acceptance rule: a stage passes when its outside-limit count is 2 or fewer. Batch passes only when all three stages pass. Recheck budget is HKD 1,200. Each recheck costs HKD 150.
body.zh: 虛構批次 B-204，僅為合成紀錄。各階段樣本數獨立，不重複計算。第一階段：40 個樣本，3 個超出限值。第二階段：25 個樣本，1 個超出限值。第三階段：15 個樣本，0 個超出限值。樣本總數 80。接納規則：某階段超出限值數為 2 或以下即通過。批次須三個階段全部通過方為通過。覆檢預算為 1,200 港元，每次覆檢費用 150 港元。

body.en: Fictional log for batch B-204. Stage 1 sample S-11 has a missing collection time entry. Stage 2 sample S-27 has a courier-caused delay of 6 hours, stated in the log. Stage 3 samples all have complete entries. The log confirms the batch identifier B-204 on every page. Uncertainty note: missing time entries and courier delays are recorded as traceability gaps, not as failed results.
body.zh: 批次 B-204 的虛構紀錄。第一階段樣本 S-11 缺少採集時間紀錄。第二階段樣本 S-27 有由速遞引致的 6 小時延誤，紀錄已註明。第三階段樣本紀錄完整。每頁均確認批次編號 B-204。不確定性備註：缺少時間紀錄及速遞延誤列作追溯缺口，不列作結果不合格。

body.en: Fictional checklist for batch B-204. Reports must state the batch identifier, the stage counts, the acceptance rule used, and any traceability gaps. Reports must not claim certification. A stage result is reported as pass or fail only. The checklist states that a batch with any failed stage is reported as not accepted. Recheck decisions must stay within the HKD 1,200 budget.
body.zh: 批次 B-204 的虛構檢查表。報告須列明批次編號、各階段樣本數、所用接納規則及任何追溯缺口。報告不得聲稱認證。階段結果只報告通過或不通過。檢查表訂明，任何階段不通過的批次須報告為不予接納。覆檢決定須在 1,200 港元預算之內。

label.en: What is the Stage 1 outcome under the acceptance rule?
label.zh: 按接納規則，第一階段結果為何？

label.en: What is the batch B-204 outcome?

exemplar.en: Batch B-204 synthetic review. Stage 1 has 40 samples with 3 outside limit, above the rule of 2 or fewer, so Stage 1 fails. Stage 2 has 25 samples with 1 outside limit and passes. Stage 3 has 15 samples with 0 outside limit and passes. Because one stage failed, batch B-204 is not accepted. Traceability gaps are S-11 missing collection time and S-27 courier-caused 6 hour delay. These are gaps, not failed results. Stage 3 entries are complete and B-204 is confirmed on every page. Budget: 1200 divided by 150 gives 8 rechecks maximum. Five rechecks cost HKD 750, within budget. Next steps: record the two gaps, confirm the stage counts, and report not accepted without claiming certification.
exemplar.zh: 批次 B-204 合成評審。第一階段 40 個樣本中有 3 個超出限值，高於 2 個或以下的規則，故第一階段不通過。第二階段 25 個樣本中有 1 個超出限值，通過。第三階段 15 個樣本中有 0 個超出限值，通過。因一個階段不通過，批次 B-204 不予接納。追溯缺口為 S-11 缺少採集時間及 S-27 由速遞引致的 6 小時延誤。這些屬缺口，並非結果不合格。第三階段紀錄完整，每頁確認 B-204。預算：1200 除以 150 為最多 8 次覆檢。5 次覆檢費用 750 港元，在預算內。下一步：記錄兩項缺口、確認各階段樣本數，並報告不予接納，不聲稱認證。

title.en: Synthetic Baseline and Follow-up Comparison for a Client Handover
title.zh: 合成基線與跟進比較：客戶交接紀錄

brief.en: You are an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs. A client sent synthetic baseline and follow-up monitoring records for one fictional site. Compare the two stages against the scenario thresholds, note sample limitations and uncertainty, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. A helpful target is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. All records are fictional learning data. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by Enviro Labs, and not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家。客戶就一個虛構場地提交了合成基線及跟進監測紀錄。請按情境門檻比較兩個階段，說明樣本限制及不確定性，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接紀錄。建議目標約為100至180英文字或相若中文。所有紀錄均為虛構學習資料。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。此為獨立示範，未經環境化驗有限公司認可，亦非招聘職位。

body.en: Fictional site code S-17. Scenario threshold for zinc: 0.50 mg/L, applied to each sample result. Baseline stage: 4 samples, results 0.42, 0.47, 0.44, 0.43 mg/L. Follow-up stage: 4 samples, results 0.58, 0.61, 0.55, 0.60 mg/L. All samples are grab samples from one synthetic pond. No duplicate samples and no field blanks were collected. Zinc is the only parameter reported. Results are fictional and are not legal discharge standards.
body.zh: 虛構場地編號 S-17。鋅的情境門檻為 0.50 mg/L，適用於每個樣本結果。基線階段：4個樣本，結果為 0.42、0.47、0.44、0.43 mg/L。跟進階段：4個樣本，結果為 0.58、0.61、0.55、0.60 mg/L。所有樣本均為來自一個合成池塘的抓取樣本。沒有採集平行樣本，亦沒有現場空白樣本。僅報告鋅一項參數。結果為虛構，並非法定排放標準。

body.en: Fictional scenario rules. A stage is above threshold if its mean result is greater than 0.50 mg/L. A stage is at or below threshold if its mean result is 0.50 mg/L or less. The client asks whether the follow-up stage mean is above threshold and what the mean change from baseline to follow-up is. The client also asks for one limitation of this dataset. No duplicate samples and no field blanks were collected. No other site data exists.
body.zh: 虛構情境規則。若某階段的平均結果大於 0.50 mg/L，該階段即高於門檻。若某階段的平均結果為 0.50 mg/L 或以下，該階段即等於或低於門檻。客戶詢問跟進階段平均值是否高於門檻，以及由基線至跟進的平均變化。客戶亦要求指出此資料集的一項限制。沒有採集平行樣本，亦沒有現場空白樣本。沒有其他場地資料。

body.en: Fictional quality control record for site S-17. The laboratory confirmed that no duplicate samples and no field blanks were collected for either stage. The record states that this is the only quality control limitation identified for this dataset. Zinc was the only parameter requested by the client, and all samples came from one synthetic pond. These facts are confirmed and are not in dispute.
body.zh: 虛構場地 S-17 品質控制紀錄。化驗所確認兩個階段均沒有採集平行樣本，亦沒有現場空白樣本。紀錄指出這是此資料集唯一已識別的品質控制限制。客戶僅要求鋅一項參數，而所有樣本均來自一個合成池塘。此等事實已確認，並無爭議。

label.en: Is the follow-up stage mean above the scenario threshold?
label.zh: 跟進階段平均值是否高於情境門檻？

label.en: Yes, the follow-up mean is above 0.50 mg/L
label.zh: 是，跟進平均值高於 0.50 mg/L

label.en: No, the follow-up mean is 0.50 mg/L or less
label.zh: 否，跟進平均值為 0.50 mg/L 或以下

label.zh: 由基線至跟進的平均變化是多少？

label.zh: 哪一項是此資料集唯一已識別的品質控制限制？

label.en: No duplicate samples and no field blanks were collected
label.zh: 沒有採集平行樣本，亦沒有現場空白樣本

label.en: All samples came from one synthetic pond
label.zh: 所有樣本均來自一個合成池塘

expectedEvidence.en: Cites S-17, the 0.50 mg/L threshold, baseline results 0.42, 0.47, 0.44, 0.43 mg/L and follow-up results 0.58, 0.61, 0.55, 0.60 mg/L. States baseline mean 0.44 mg/L is at or below threshold and follow-up mean 0.585 mg/L is above threshold.

exemplar.en: Site S-17 synthetic records compare a baseline stage with a follow-up stage against the fictional scenario threshold of 0.50 mg/L. Baseline results were 0.42, 0.47, 0.44 and 0.43 mg/L, giving a mean of 0.44 mg/L, which is at or below threshold. Follow-up results were 0.58, 0.61, 0.55 and 0.60 mg/L, giving a mean of 0.585 mg/L, which is above threshold. The mean change is an increase of 0.145 mg/L. The only identified quality control limitation is that no duplicate samples and no field blanks were collected, so quality control and representativeness are uncertain. Next step: collect duplicates and field blanks before any further comparison. These are fictional results and the threshold is not a legal discharge standard.
exemplar.zh: 場地 S-17 的合成紀錄把基線階段與跟進階段對照虛構情境門檻 0.50 mg/L 作比較。基線結果為 0.42、0.47、0.44 及 0.43 mg/L，平均值 0.44 mg/L，等於或低於門檻。跟進結果為 0.58、0.61、0.55 及 0.60 mg/L，平均值 0.585 mg/L，高於門檻。平均變化為增加 0.145 mg/L。唯一已識別的品質控制限制是沒有採集平行樣本及現場空白樣本，因此品質控制及代表性均不確定。下一步：在進一步比較前採集平行樣本及現場空白樣本。此等結果為虛構，該門檻並非法定排放標準。

title.en: Lalamove Fictional Merchant Booking Workflow Gap
title.zh: Lalamove 虛構商戶預約流程缺口

brief.en: You are an independent business analyst in a fictional simulation, not endorsed by Lalamove. A fictional Hong Kong bakery merchant, Sunny Crust, reports that staff lose time when booking same-day delivery. Review the two fictional source documents, identify the biggest workflow gap, choose one improvement within a hard monthly budget of HKD 2,000, and calculate the estimated monthly saving. Then write a concise handover of around 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decision, calculation, risks and next steps. All figures are synthetic learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是一項虛構模擬中的獨立商業分析師，並非獲 Lalamove 認可。虛構香港麵包商戶 Sunny Crust 表示員工在同日配送預約上耗時。請閱讀兩份虛構文件，找出最大流程缺口，在每月硬性預算 HKD 2,000 內選擇一項改善，並計算預計每月節省。然後撰寫約 100 至 180 英文詞的簡潔交接說明，或相若中文，涵蓋證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步。所有數字均為虛構學習假設。

title.zh: 虛構商戶預約紀錄摘要

body.en: Synthetic learning record. Sunny Crust staff book same-day delivery by phone. In a four-week fictional period, 80 bookings were made. Average staff time per booking was 12 minutes. Of these, 30 bookings needed a second call because vehicle type was unclear, adding 6 minutes each. The merchant pays a fictional platform fee of HKD 15 per booking. Staff time is valued at HKD 60 per hour. No real Lalamove policy or performance is described.
body.zh: 虛構學習紀錄。Sunny Crust 員工以電話預約同日配送。在四週虛構期間，共 80 次預約。每次平均員工耗時 12 分鐘。其中 30 次因車型不清需第二次來電，每次額外 6 分鐘。商戶每次預約支付虛構平台費 HKD 15。員工時間按每小時 HKD 60 計算。此文件不描述任何真實 Lalamove 政策或表現。

body.en: Synthetic learning options. Option A: a fictional booking form template that removes the second call for all 30 affected bookings. One-off setup cost HKD 1,200, monthly running cost HKD 300. Option B: a fictional staff training session that reduces average booking time by 2 minutes for all 80 bookings. Monthly cost HKD 1,800. Option C: a fictional priority phone line costing HKD 2,400 monthly, which exceeds the hard budget. The hard monthly budget is HKD 2,000. Savings are counted as staff time saved only.
body.zh: 虛構學習方案。方案 A：虛構預約表格範本，可為全部 30 次受影響預約免除第二次來電。一次性設定費 HKD 1,200，每月運作費 HKD 300。方案 B：虛構員工培訓，可為全部 80 次預約平均減少 2 分鐘。每月費用 HKD 1,800。方案 C：虛構優先電話線，每月 HKD 2,400，超出硬性預算。每月硬性預算為 HKD 2,000。節省只計算員工時間。

label.en: Which workflow gap causes the largest avoidable staff time loss?
label.zh: 哪個流程缺口造成最大可避免的員工時間損失？

exemplar.en: Evidence: Source one shows 80 bookings in four weeks. Thirty bookings needed a second call because vehicle type was unclear, adding 6 minutes each. That is 180 minutes, or 3 hours, of avoidable staff time. Decision and calculations: I choose Option A, the booking form template. It removes all 30 second calls. Option C exceeds budget. Risks: all figures are fictional learning assumptions, staff may not adopt the form, and second calls may not fall to zero. Next steps: pilot the form with Sunny Crust for two weeks and review call data.

title.en: Synthetic Rain-Event Monitoring Uncertainty for a Client Handover
title.zh: 合成雨水事件監測不確定性與客戶交接

brief.en: You are an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs. A client sent synthetic rain-event monitoring records for fictional site R1. Interpret the records, identify the exceedance flag and the main uncertainty, and write a concise evidence-based handover for the client. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards. All records are synthetic. Do not run any laboratory procedure. A suggested length is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. This is a guide, not a strict graded limit.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家。客戶提交了虛構場地R1的合成雨水事件監測紀錄。請解讀紀錄、找出超標標記及主要不確定性，並為客戶撰寫一份簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。所有紀錄均為合成。請勿進行任何化驗程序。建議長度約100至180英文詞或相若繁體中文。此為指引，並非嚴格的評分字數限制。

title.zh: 合成雨水事件監測紀錄

body.en: Fictional site R1. Scenario threshold for turbidity is 25 NTU, inclusive. Event A (heavy rain, 40 mm): three samples, turbidity 18, 22, 31 NTU. Event B (light rain, 8 mm): three samples, turbidity 14, 16, 19 NTU. One Event A sample was collected 35 minutes after the rain stopped. All other samples were collected during rain. Records are synthetic and incomplete for flow rate.
body.zh: 虛構場地R1。濁度情境門檻為25 NTU，包含在內。事件A（大雨，40毫米）：三個樣本，濁度18、22、31 NTU。事件B（小雨，8毫米）：三個樣本，濁度14、16、19 NTU。事件A其中一個樣本在停雨後35分鐘採集。其餘樣本均在降雨期間採集。紀錄為合成，流量資料不完整。

body.en: Fictional note. Event A has one late sample. Event B has no late sample. The client asks whether Event A exceeds the scenario threshold. A single result above the threshold is an exceedance flag, not proof of a continuing discharge problem. Flow rate is missing, so load cannot be calculated. No duplicate samples were taken. The client wants a concise handover with the comparison and the main uncertainty.
body.zh: 虛構說明。事件A有一個延遲樣本。事件B沒有延遲樣本。客戶詢問事件A是否超出情境門檻。單一高於門檻的結果屬超標標記，並非持續排放問題的證明。流量資料缺失，因此無法計算負荷。沒有採集重複樣本。客戶要求一份簡潔交接，包含比較及主要不確定性。

label.zh: 哪項限制最直接影響事件A超標標記是否代表持續排放問題？

exemplar.en: Client handover for fictional site R1. Event A (heavy rain, 40 mm) recorded turbidity of 18, 22 and 31 NTU. Event B (light rain, 8 mm) recorded 14, 16 and 19 NTU. The main uncertainty is that one Event A sample was collected 35 minutes after rain stopped, and flow rate is missing, so load cannot be calculated. A single exceedance flag is not proof of a continuing discharge problem. Next step: collect flow data and a repeat sample during rain. These scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards.
exemplar.zh: 虛構場地R1客戶交接。事件A（大雨，40毫米）濁度為18、22及31 NTU。事件B（小雨，8毫米）為14、16及19 NTU。情境門檻為25 NTU並包含在內，因此事件A有一個超標標記，事件B沒有。事件A最高值為31 NTU。事件B平均值為49除以3，即16.33 NTU（兩位小數）。主要不確定性為事件A其中一個樣本在停雨後35分鐘採集，且流量資料缺失，因此無法計算負荷。單一超標標記並非持續排放問題的證明。下一步：收集流量資料並在降雨期間重複採樣。此等情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。

title.en: Fictional Merchant Requirements Backlog for a Delivery Pilot
title.zh: 虛構商戶配送試點需求待辦清單

brief.en: You are an independent business analyst supporting a fictional merchant pilot on a delivery platform. All policies, budgets, records and team practices in the sources are fictional learning assumptions, not real company rules, and this demo is not endorsed by any company. Read the three fictional sources, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. Recommend which requirements to fund first within the stated hard budget, show your calculation method, and note one uncertainty.
brief.zh: 你是一名獨立商業分析師，支援一個虛構商戶在配送平台上的試點。文件內所有政策、預算、記錄及團隊做法均為虛構學習假設，並非任何公司的真實規則，本示範亦未獲任何公司認可。閱讀三份虛構文件後，以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180英文字或相若中文的簡潔證據為本交接說明。在所述硬性預算內建議優先資助哪些需求，展示計算方法，並指出一項不確定因素。

body.en: Fictional learning assumption only. A merchant pilot has four candidate requirements. R1: merchant order status page, estimated reduction 40 late enquiries per month. R2: driver arrival alert, estimated reduction 25 late enquiries per month. R3: bulk order upload, estimated reduction 10 late enquiries per month. R4: monthly report export, estimated reduction 5 late enquiries per month. Each requirement is independent. The pilot baseline is 120 late enquiries per month. The merchant confirms all four needs are functional needs, not preferences.
body.zh: 僅為虛構學習假設。一個商戶試點有四項候選需求。R1：商戶訂單狀態頁，預計每月減少40宗延誤查詢。R2：司機到達提示，預計每月減少25宗延誤查詢。R3：批量訂單上載，預計每月減少10宗延誤查詢。R4：每月報告匯出，預計每月減少5宗延誤查詢。各需求互相獨立。試點基線為每月120宗延誤查詢。商戶確認四項均為功能需求，並非偏好。

body.en: Fictional learning assumption only. The pilot has a hard one-off budget of HKD 30,000. Costs are one-off and independent. R1 costs HKD 14,000. R2 costs HKD 9,000. R3 costs HKD 7,000. R4 costs HKD 4,000. No contingency, approval or preference is assumed. Any combination must stay at or below HKD 30,000. The merchant states that the objective is the maximum estimated monthly reduction in late enquiries within this hard budget.
body.zh: 僅為虛構學習假設。試點設有一次性硬性預算30,000港元。成本為一次性且互相獨立。R1成本14,000港元。R2成本9,000港元。R3成本7,000港元。R4成本4,000港元。不假設任何應急費用、審批或偏好。任何組合必須等於或低於30,000港元。商戶表明目標是在此硬性預算內，令每月延誤查詢的預計減幅最大。

title.en: Fictional condition confirmation and uncertainty log
title.zh: 虛構條件確認與不確定因素記錄

body.en: Fictional learning assumption only. The merchant confirms the pilot runs for one month only, so reductions are counted once. The merchant confirms R1 and R2 can be delivered together without conflict. The merchant confirms R3 and R4 can be delivered together without conflict. The merchant notes one uncertainty: the reduction estimates come from a small fictional sample and may be lower in practice. No courier-caused delay is assumed in this case.
body.zh: 僅為虛構學習假設。商戶確認試點只運行一個月，因此減幅只計算一次。商戶確認R1與R2可同時交付而不衝突。商戶確認R3與R4可同時交付而不衝突。商戶指出一項不確定因素：減幅估算來自一個小型虛構樣本，實際可能較低。本個案不假設任何由速遞員造成的延誤。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The fictional sources set a hard one-off budget of HKD 30,000 and an objective of maximum estimated monthly reduction in late enquiries. R1 reduces 40, R2 reduces 25, R3 reduces 10 and R4 reduces 5 enquiries per month, and all requirements are independent. Decision and calculations: I recommend R1, R2 and R3. Cost is 14,000 + 9,000 + 7,000 = HKD 30,000, which is at the hard budget. Reduction is 40 + 25 + 10 = 75 enquiries per month. Adding R4 would cost HKD 34,000, above budget. Risks: The reduction estimates come from a small fictional sample and may be lower in practice, so realised benefit could be less than 75. Next steps: Validate estimates with a larger sample before scaling, and confirm the one-month pilot count with the merchant.
exemplar.zh: 證據：虛構文件設定一次性硬性預算30,000港元，目標為每月延誤查詢的最大預計減幅。R1每月減少40宗，R2減少25宗，R3減少10宗，R4減少5宗，各需求互相獨立。決策與計算：我建議R1、R2及R3。成本為14,000＋9,000＋7,000＝30,000港元，達到硬性預算。減幅為40＋25＋10＝每月75宗查詢。加入R4將花費34,000港元，超出預算。風險：減幅估算來自小型虛構樣本，實際可能較低，因此實際效益可能少於75宗。下一步：擴大規模前以較大樣本驗證估算，並與商戶確認一個月試點的計算次數。

title.zh: FIMMICK 虛構推廣活動指標審查

brief.en: You are an independent demo analyst reviewing a fictional FIMMICK client campaign. All figures, records and rules are synthetic learning assumptions, not actual FIMMICK policies or client data. Read the three sources, answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Target around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. This is a guide, not a strict graded limit. Do not access any real account.
brief.zh: 你是獨立示範分析師，正審查一個虛構的 FIMMICK 客戶推廣活動。所有數字、紀錄及規則均為虛構學習假設，並非 FIMMICK 實際政策或客戶資料。請閱讀三份文件，回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。建議約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文，此為指引而非嚴格評分字數限制。請勿存取任何真實帳戶。

title.zh: 虛構推廣活動指標紀錄

body.en: Synthetic record for demo only. Campaign code HK-114. Reporting window covers 14 unique days. Platform A recorded 40,000 impressions, 2,000 clicks and 120 purchases. Platform B recorded 10,000 impressions, 400 clicks and 60 purchases. The client defines click-through rate as clicks divided by impressions. The client defines conversion rate as purchases divided by clicks. All counts are final and no deduplication is required.
body.zh: 僅供示範的虛構紀錄。活動代碼 HK-114。報告期涵蓋 14 個獨立日。平台 A 錄得 40,000 次曝光、2,000 次點擊及 120 次購買。平台 B 錄得 10,000 次曝光、400 次點擊及 60 次購買。客戶把點擊率定義為點擊除以曝光。客戶把轉換率定義為購買除以點擊。所有計數均為最終數字，無需去重。

body.en: Synthetic rules for demo only. The client requires human approval before any budget change above HKD 5,000. The client requires human approval before any change to creative assets. The client does not require approval for metric reporting. The client states that click-through rate and conversion rate must always be reported separately and never combined into one score. The client states that Platform B is the priority platform for the next stage.
body.zh: 僅供示範的虛構規則。客戶要求任何超過 5,000 港元的預算變更須經人手審批。客戶要求任何創意素材變更須經人手審批。客戶不要求指標報告經人手審批。客戶表明點擊率與轉換率必須分開報告，不得合併為單一分數。客戶表明平台 B 為下一階段優先平台。

body.en: Synthetic note for demo only. The next stage has a hard test budget of HKD 8,000. Option X is estimated to reduce cost per purchase by HKD 12 and needs HKD 6,000. Option Y is estimated to reduce cost per purchase by HKD 20 and needs HKD 9,000. Option Z is estimated to reduce cost per purchase by HKD 5 and needs HKD 3,000. Only one option can be selected. The client wants the maximum estimated reduction within the hard budget.
body.zh: 僅供示範的虛構備註。下一階段設有 8,000 港元硬性測試預算。選項 X 估計可把每次購買成本降低 12 港元，需要 6,000 港元。選項 Y 估計可把每次購買成本降低 20 港元，需要 9,000 港元。選項 Z 估計可把每次購買成本降低 5 港元，需要 3,000 港元。只可選擇一個選項。客戶希望在硬性預算內取得最大估計減幅。

description.en: Writes a concise evidence-based handover with decisions, uncertainty and next steps.

expectedEvidence.en: Handover references campaign HK-114, the 14-day window, the separate metrics, the approval rules, the HKD 8,000 hard budget and the selected Option X. Notes that estimates are synthetic and that Platform B is the priority platform for the next stage. Suggests around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese as a guide, not a strict limit.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明引用活動 HK-114、14 日報告期、分開的指標、審批規則、8,000 港元硬性預算及所選的選項 X。指出估計數字屬虛構，並指出平台 B 為下一階段優先平台。建議約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文作為指引，而非嚴格限制。

exemplar.en: Evidence. Campaign HK-114 covers 14 unique days. Platform A recorded 40,000 impressions, 2,000 clicks and 120 purchases. Platform B recorded 10,000 impressions, 400 clicks and 60 purchases. The client defines click-through rate as clicks divided by impressions and conversion rate as purchases divided by clicks, and requires them reported separately. Platform A click-through rate is 2,000 divided by 40,000, equal to 5 percent. Platform B conversion rate is 60 divided by 400, equal to 15 percent. Decisions. A budget change above HKD 5,000 and any creative asset change need human approval. Metric reporting does not. The next stage has a hard budget of HKD 8,000. Option X costs HKD 6,000 and gives the largest estimated reduction of HKD 12 among options that fit. Option Y costs HKD 9,000 and exceeds the budget. Risks. All figures and estimates are synthetic learning assumptions, not actual FIMMICK data. Next steps. Report the two metrics separately, seek approval for any qualifying budget or creative change, and treat Platform B as the priority platform for the next stage.
exemplar.zh: 證據。活動 HK-114 涵蓋 14 個獨立日。平台 A 錄得 40,000 次曝光、2,000 次點擊及 120 次購買。平台 B 錄得 10,000 次曝光、400 次點擊及 60 次購買。客戶把點擊率定義為點擊除以曝光，轉換率定義為購買除以點擊，並要求分開報告。平台 A 點擊率為 2,000 除以 40,000，等於 5%。平台 B 轉換率為 60 除以 400，等於 15%。決策。超過 5,000 港元的預算變更及任何創意素材變更須經人手審批。指標報告則不需要。下一階段設有 8,000 港元硬性預算。選項 X 成本 6,000 港元，在符合預算的選項中提供最大估計減幅 12 港元。選項 Y 成本 9,000 港元，超出預算。風險。所有數字及估計均為虛構學習假設，並非 FIMMICK 實際資料。下一步。分開報告兩項指標，就任何符合條件的預算或創意變更申請審批，並把平台 B 視為下一階段優先平台。

feedback.en: You correctly state that click-through rate is clicks divided by impressions and conversion rate is purchases divided by clicks, and you keep the two metrics separate as the client requires. The supplied figures for Platform A (2,000 clicks, 40,000 impressions) and Platform B (60 purchases, 400 clicks) are used accurately.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出點擊率是點擊除以曝光、轉換率是購買除以點擊，並按客戶要求把兩項指標分開報告。你亦準確引用平台 A（2,000 次點擊、40,000 次曝光）及平台 B（60 次購買、400 次點擊）的數字。

feedback.en: Your calculations are shown clearly and give the right results: 2,000 divided by 40,000 equals 5 percent, and 60 divided by 400 equals 15 percent. Both the method and the outputs match the client definitions.
feedback.zh: 你的計算清晰並得出正確結果：2,000 除以 40,000 等於 5%，60 除以 400 等於 15%。計算方法與結果均符合客戶定義。

feedback.en: You apply the fictional approval rules correctly, noting that a budget change above HKD 5,000 and creative asset changes need human approval while metric reporting does not. Your Option X decision is well justified: HKD 6,000 fits the HKD 8,000 hard budget and gives the largest estimated reduction of HKD 12 among fitting options, and you correctly exclude Option Y at HKD 9,000.
feedback.zh: 你正確應用虛構審批規則，指出超過 5,000 港元的預算變更及創意素材變更須經人手審批，而指標報告則不需要。你選擇選項 X 的理由充分：6,000 港元符合 8,000 港元硬性預算，且在符合預算的選項中提供最大估計減幅 12 港元，並正確排除成本 9,000 港元的選項 Y。

feedback.en: Your handover is concise and evidence-based, referencing campaign HK-114, the 14-day window, the separate metrics, the approval rules, the HKD 8,000 budget and the Option X decision with clear risks and next steps. At 182 English words you are just above the suggested 100 to 180 guide, which is not a strict limit, so this does not affect your marks. You could briefly note that Platform B is the priority platform to strengthen the next-steps section further.
feedback.zh: 你的交接簡潔並以證據為本，引用活動 HK-114、14 日報告期、分開的指標、審批規則、8,000 港元預算及選項 X 決策，並清楚列明風險與下一步。全篇 182 個英文詞略高於建議的 100 至 180 指引，惟該指引並非嚴格限制，故不影響評分。你可補充平台 B 為優先平台，以進一步強化下一步部分。

summary.en: All five structured answers are correct and your written handover applies the fictional definitions, approval rules and hard budget accurately with clear calculations. The only minor point is that the handover runs slightly above the suggested 100 to 180 English word guide, which is guidance only and not penalised. Overall this is a strong, well-evidenced submission.
summary.zh: 五項結構化答案全部正確，你的書面交接準確應用虛構定義、審批規則及硬性預算，計算清晰。唯一小處是交接略超建議的 100 至 180 個英文詞指引，惟該指引僅供參考，不作扣分。整體而言這是一份論據充分的高質素提交。

nextSteps.en: In future handovers, briefly flag priority platforms such as Platform B and keep the note at or near the suggested 100 to 180 word guide for maximum clarity. Continue separating click-through rate and conversion rate and always name the option excluded by budget with its cost.
nextSteps.zh: 日後撰寫交接時，可簡略標明平台 B 等優先平台，並把篇幅保持在建議的 100 至 180 個英文詞左右，以達最佳清晰度。請繼續把點擊率與轉換率分開報告，並說明因預算而被排除的選項及其成本。

title.zh: 虛構有限流程改善成本比較

brief.en: You are an independent business analyst reviewing a fictional merchant support workflow for a delivery platform demo. All documents are synthetic learning assumptions, not actual company policies. Compare two bounded improvement options for the fictional merchant onboarding support process, choose one within a hard budget of HKD 40,000, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Target around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. Do not promise real driver or platform performance.
brief.zh: 你是一名獨立商業分析師，正在為一個配送平台示範檢視虛構商戶支援流程。所有文件均為虛構學習假設，並非真實公司政策。請比較兩個虛構商戶開戶支援流程的有限改善方案，在硬性預算 HKD 40,000 內選擇其一，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。目標約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文。請勿對真實司機或平台表現作出承諾。

body.en: Synthetic baseline for a fictional merchant support pilot. Current onboarding support handles 500 merchant requests per month. Average handling time is 12 minutes per request. The support team costs HKD 180 per hour. A manual status update step causes 80 requests per month to be reworked, each rework taking 10 minutes. No automation exists today. These figures are fictional learning assumptions only.
body.zh: 虛構商戶支援試點的合成基線。現時開戶支援每月處理 500 宗商戶請求。每宗平均處理時間為 12 分鐘。支援團隊成本為每小時 HKD 180。手動狀態更新步驟導致每月 80 宗請求需要重做，每宗重做需時 10 分鐘。目前並無自動化。此等數字僅為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Synthetic options for the fictional pilot. Option A is a guided form template costing HKD 22,000 to build. It is estimated to reduce average handling time by 2 minutes per request and reduce rework by 30 requests per month. Option B is a status notification rule costing HKD 35,000 to build. It is estimated to reduce rework by 60 requests per month but does not change average handling time. Both options are one-time build costs with no monthly fee. Estimates are fictional.
body.zh: 虛構試點的合成方案。方案甲為引導式表格範本，建置成本 HKD 22,000。預計每宗請求平均處理時間減少 2 分鐘，每月重做減少 30 宗。方案乙為狀態通知規則，建置成本 HKD 35,000。預計每月重做減少 60 宗，但不改變平均處理時間。兩個方案均為一次性建置成本，並無月費。估算屬虛構。

body.en: Synthetic constraints for the fictional pilot. The hard budget is HKD 40,000. Only one option may be selected. Savings are calculated as reduced support labour cost per month. Labour cost is HKD 180 per hour, equal to HKD 3 per minute. Rework reduction and handling time reduction are separate savings and must not be double counted. Any option above the hard budget is not eligible. These rules are fictional learning assumptions.
body.zh: 虛構試點的合成限制。硬性預算為 HKD 40,000。只可選擇一個方案。節省按每月減少的支援人力成本計算。人力成本為每小時 HKD 180，即每分鐘 HKD 3。重做減少與處理時間減少屬兩項獨立節省，不得重複計算。任何超出硬性預算的方案均不合資格。此等規則屬虛構學習假設。

label.en: Which option is eligible under the hard budget of HKD 40,000?
label.zh: 在 HKD 40,000 硬性預算下，哪個方案合資格？

label.en: What is the monthly labour saving from Option A's handling time reduction alone, in HKD?
label.zh: 僅計算方案甲處理時間減少所帶來的每月人力節省，以 HKD 計是多少？

label.en: What is the monthly labour saving from Option B's rework reduction alone, in HKD?
label.zh: 僅計算方案乙重做減少所帶來的每月人力節省，以 HKD 計是多少？

label.en: Which option gives the higher first-month net benefit, calculated as monthly saving minus one-time build cost?
label.zh: 以每月節省減一次性建置成本計算，哪個方案首月淨效益較高？

label.en: Which statement best describes a limitation of the fictional estimates?

label.en: Handling and rework savings must be double counted
label.zh: 處理與重做節省必須重複計算

expectedEvidence.en: Option A reduces handling by 2 minutes per request across 500 requests, so 1,000 minutes saved. At HKD 3 per minute, saving is HKD 3,000 per month. Accept 3000 or HKD 3000.
expectedEvidence.zh: 方案甲每宗請求減少 2 分鐘，500 宗即節省 1,000 分鐘。以每分鐘 HKD 3 計算，每月節省 HKD 3,000。接受 3000 或 HKD 3000。

expectedEvidence.en: Option B reduces rework by 60 requests per month, each rework taking 10 minutes, so 600 minutes saved. At HKD 3 per minute, saving is HKD 1,800 per month. Accept 1800 or HKD 1800.
expectedEvidence.zh: 方案乙每月減少 60 宗重做，每宗重做需時 10 分鐘，即節省 600 分鐘。以每分鐘 HKD 3 計算，每月節省 HKD 1,800。接受 1800 或 HKD 1800。

expectedEvidence.en: Option A monthly saving is HKD 3,000 from handling plus HKD 900 from 30 rework requests times 10 minutes times HKD 3, total HKD 3,900. Net benefit is HKD 3,900 minus HKD 22,000, equal to negative HKD 18,100. Option B monthly saving is HKD 1,800. Net benefit is HKD 1,800 minus HKD 35,000, equal to negative HKD 33,200. Option A has the higher first-month net benefit. Accept option-a with correct figures.
expectedEvidence.zh: 方案甲每月節省為處理時間 HKD 3,000，加上 30 宗重做乘以 10 分鐘乘以 HKD 3 的 HKD 900，合共 HKD 3,900。淨效益為 HKD 3,900 減 HKD 22,000，即負 HKD 18,100。方案乙每月節省為 HKD 1,800。淨效益為 HKD 1,800 減 HKD 35,000，即負 HKD 33,200。方案甲首月淨效益較高。接受 option-a 並附正確數字。

description.en: Identifies that the estimates are fictional and not verified against real operations.

expectedEvidence.en: The sources state the figures and estimates are fictional learning assumptions. The defensible answer is estimates-are-fictional.

description.en: Writes a concise evidence-based handover with decision, calculations, risks and next steps, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，包含決策、計算、風險及下一步，約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文。

expectedEvidence.en: A complete handover states the chosen option, shows the HKD 3,000 handling saving and HKD 900 rework saving for Option A, notes the HKD 22,000 build cost, acknowledges the fictional estimates, and proposes a small verification step. Accept either English or Traditional Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 完整交接說明應指出所選方案，展示方案甲的 HKD 3,000 處理節省及 HKD 900 重做節省，註明 HKD 22,000 建置成本，承認估算屬虛構，並提出小型驗證步驟。接受英文或香港繁體中文。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The fictional baseline handles 500 merchant requests monthly at 12 minutes each, with 80 reworks of 10 minutes. Labour costs HKD 180 per hour, equal to HKD 3 per minute. Option A costs HKD 22,000 and Option B costs HKD 35,000, so both fit the HKD 40,000 hard budget. Decision: Option A gives the higher first-month net benefit. Its handling reduction saves 500 times 2 minutes times HKD 3, equal to HKD 3,000. Its rework reduction saves 30 times 10 minutes times HKD 3, equal to HKD 900. Total monthly saving is HKD 3,900, so first-month net benefit is HKD 3,900 minus HKD 22,000, equal to negative HKD 18,100. Option B saves 60 times 10 minutes times HKD 3, equal to HKD 1,800, giving negative HKD 33,200. Risks: All estimates are fictional and unverified, and savings may not persist. Next steps: Run a one-month limited trial on 50 requests to check actual handling time and rework before wider use.
exemplar.zh: 證據：虛構基線每月處理 500 宗商戶請求，每宗 12 分鐘，另有 80 宗重做，每宗 10 分鐘。人力成本為每小時 HKD 180，即每分鐘 HKD 3。方案甲成本 HKD 22,000，方案乙成本 HKD 35,000，兩者均符合 HKD 40,000 硬性預算。決策：方案甲首月淨效益較高。其處理時間減少節省 500 乘以 2 分鐘乘以 HKD 3，即 HKD 3,000。其重做減少節省 30 乘以 10 分鐘乘以 HKD 3，即 HKD 900。每月總節省為 HKD 3,900，首月淨效益為 HKD 3,900 減 HKD 22,000，即負 HKD 18,100。方案乙節省 60 乘以 10 分鐘乘以 HKD 3，即 HKD 1,800，淨效益為負 HKD 33,200。風險：所有估算均屬虛構且未經驗證，節省未必持續。下一步：就 50 宗請求進行為期一個月的有限試行，以核實實際處理時間及重做情況，然後再考慮擴大使用。

title.en: FIMMICK AI Content Approval Workflow Review
title.zh: FIMMICK 人工智能內容審批流程檢視

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional FIMMICK client campaign. A draft AI-assisted content workflow has been logged, and the client wants a short evidence-based handover before the next batch runs. Review the supplied fictional records, identify the correct approval path, calculate the review capacity, and recommend the next step. Write your handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. This is an independent demo, not an official FIMMICK policy or job opening.
brief.zh: 你正支援一個虛構的 FIMMICK 客戶推廣活動。一份人工智能輔助內容流程草稿已有紀錄，客戶希望下一批內容運行前收到簡短的證據為本交接。請檢視提供的虛構紀錄，找出正確審批路徑，計算審核容量，並建議下一步。請以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫交接，約100至180英文字或相若中文。此為獨立示範，並非 FIMMICK 官方政策或招聘職位。

body.en: Fictional record only. Campaign code HK-204. Bot version v3.2. Draft batch size 40 items. The workflow has two stages. Stage one is drafting. Stage two is human approval. Only stage two requires a named human approver. The log shows 12 items passed stage one and 9 items passed stage two. The client brand rule states that any item mentioning a regulated health claim must be routed to legal review before publishing. Two draft items mention a regulated health claim. No item has been published.
body.zh: 僅為虛構紀錄。活動代碼 HK-204。機械人版本 v3.2。草稿批次數量 40 項。流程有兩個階段。第一階段為起草。第二階段為人手審批。只有第二階段需要指定人手審批人。紀錄顯示 12 項通過第一階段，9 項通過第二階段。客戶品牌規則訂明，任何提及受規管健康聲明的項目，必須在發布前轉交法律審核。有兩份草稿提及受規管健康聲明。沒有任何項目已發布。

body.en: Fictional note only. One reviewer can complete 6 item reviews per hour. The next batch has 30 items. Every item must pass stage two human approval. The client requires all 30 items reviewed within 4 hours. The reviewer is available for 3 hours only. A second reviewer can be added for 2 hours at a cost of HKD 900 per hour. Adding the second reviewer is the only way to increase capacity. No overtime is allowed.
body.zh: 僅為虛構說明。一名審核員每小時可完成 6 項審核。下一批有 30 項。每項必須通過第二階段人手審批。客戶要求全部 30 項於 4 小時內完成審核。該審核員僅可工作 3 小時。可增派第二名審核員 2 小時，每小時費用 HKD 900。增派第二名審核員是唯一增加容量的方法。不允許加班。

body.en: Fictional rule only. Items that mention a regulated health claim must go to legal review before publishing. Items without such a claim may proceed after stage two human approval. The legal reviewer is available and can review both flagged items within the 4 hour window. Legal review does not replace stage two human approval. Both steps are required for flagged items. The client has confirmed the two flagged items are in the next batch.
body.zh: 僅為虛構規則。提及受規管健康聲明的項目，必須在發布前轉交法律審核。沒有此類聲明的項目，可在第二階段人手審批後繼續。法律審核員可於4小時時段內審核該兩項。法律審核不取代第二階段人手審批。被標示項目必須完成兩項步驟。客戶已確認該兩項被標示項目在下一批之內。

label.en: Which approval path is correct for the two flagged items?
label.zh: 該兩項被標示項目的正確審批路徑是甚麼？

label.en: Stage two human approval and legal review
label.zh: 第二階段人手審批及法律審核

label.en: Can one reviewer complete all 30 items within the client window?
label.zh: 一名審核員能否在客戶時限內完成全部30項？
可以，一名審核員已足夠

label.en: No, one reviewer is not enough
label.zh: 不可以，一名審核員不足

label.en: What is the total cost of adding the second reviewer for 2 hours?
label.zh: 增派第二名審核員2小時的總費用是多少？

label.en: How many items can one reviewer complete in 3 hours?
label.zh: 一名審核員3小時可完成多少項？

label.en: What is the best next step for the next batch?
label.zh: 下一批的最佳下一步是甚麼？

label.en: Add the second reviewer and route flagged items to legal
label.zh: 增派第二名審核員並把被標示項目轉交法律

label.en: Delay the batch without any capacity change
label.zh: 不作任何容量調整並延遲批次

label.en: Skip legal review to save time
label.zh: 跳過法律審核以節省時間

exemplar.en: Evidence: Source one shows 12 items passed stage one and 9 passed stage two, with two items mentioning a regulated health claim. Source three states flagged items need both stage two human approval and legal review. Source two states one reviewer completes 6 items per hour and the batch has 30 items. Decision and calculations: One reviewer completes 18 items in 3 hours, which is below 30. Adding the second reviewer for 2 hours adds 12 items, reaching 30. The cost is HKD 900 times 2, which equals HKD 1800. Risks: Skipping legal review would breach the client brand rule. Next steps: Add the second reviewer, route the two flagged items to legal, and confirm both steps are complete before publishing.

Decide which attribution window the report should use, calculate the corrected attributed conversions and the revised cost per attributed conversion, and choose the next experiment. Write a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese covering evidence, decisions, uncertainty and next steps. All figures are fictional learning data. title.zh: Aurora Home 活動摘要（合成）

body.en: Synthetic record. Campaign AUR-14 ran on two paid channels. Channel P reported 1,200 clicks and 96 platform conversions. Channel Q reported 800 clicks and 40 platform conversions. Total media spend was HKD 54,000, split evenly between the two channels. The client report currently uses a 30 day click window. Platform conversions are counted by each channel separately and may overlap. No other channels ran.
body.zh: 合成記錄。活動 AUR-14 在兩個付費渠道運行。渠道 P 報告 1,200 次點擊及 96 次平台轉換。渠道 Q 報告 800 次點擊及 40 次平台轉換。媒體總支出為 HKD 54,000，兩個渠道平均分配。客戶報告目前採用30天點擊窗口。平台轉換由各渠道分別計算，可能重疊。沒有其他渠道運行。

body.en: Synthetic policy. The agreed client reporting window is 7 days after click. Under the 7 day window, Channel P attributed conversions are 72 and Channel Q attributed conversions are 30. These figures already remove cross channel overlap. The 30 day window figures in the campaign summary are not deduplicated. Any change to the reporting window must be stated in the handover. Attribution figures are estimates, not confirmed sales.
body.zh: 合成政策。與客戶協定的報告窗口為點擊後7天。在7天窗口下，渠道 P 歸因轉換為72，渠道 Q 歸因轉換為30。此等數字已移除跨渠道重疊。活動摘要中的30天窗口數字未經去重。任何報告窗口變更必須在交接中說明。歸因數字為估算，並非確認銷售。

body.en: Synthetic constraints. A follow up test must cost no more than HKD 8,000 and must not change the agreed 7 day reporting window. Option X tests new creative on Channel P, estimated cost HKD 7,500. Option Y tests a landing page on Channel Q, estimated cost HKD 9,000. Option Z tests both channels with new creative, estimated cost HKD 12,000. Only one option can run. Human approval is required before any spend.
body.zh: 合成限制。後續測試成本不得超過 HKD 8,000，且不得更改協定的7天報告窗口。選項 X 在渠道 P 測試新創意，估計成本 HKD 7,500。選項 Y 在渠道 Q 測試登陸頁，估計成本 HKD 9,000。選項 Z 在兩個渠道測試新創意，估計成本 HKD 12,000。只能運行一個選項。任何支出前須經人手審批。

title.en: HKTVmall Shopping Assistant: Invented Accessibility Details Diagnosis
title.zh: HKTVmall 購物助理：虛構無障礙資料診斷

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on a fictional HKTVmall shopping-assistant simulation. Customers report the assistant stated accessibility details for a product that do not appear in any product record. Diagnose the root cause using the three fictional sources, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. State the faulty configuration, the version and log evidence, the corrected setting, and a regression test plan. Policies, staff and records here are invented for learning. This independent demo is not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 你是 HKTVmall 購物助理模擬（虛構）的 AI 工程師。顧客反映助理就某產品陳述了產品記錄中沒有的無障礙資料。請根據三份虛構文件診斷根本原因，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔證據交接。說明錯誤設定、版本與日誌證據、修正設定及回歸測試計劃。此處政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此獨立示範未獲 HKTV 集團認可。

body.en: Fictional register for the HKTVmall shopping assistant. Config v3.2 (active since 2026-09-01) sets accessibility_claims to 'infer_from_category'. Config v3.1 set it to 'record_only'. Config v3.0 set it to 'record_only'. The product record for SKU-4471 lists no accessibility fields. Category 'home-kitchen' has a template note 'may suit limited mobility' that is not a product attribute. The register states product records are the only approved source for accessibility claims.
body.zh: HKTVmall 購物助理的虛構設定登記冊。設定 v3.2（自2026-09-01起生效）將 accessibility_claims 設為 'infer_from_category'。設定 v3.1 設為 'record_only'。設定 v3.0 設為 'record_only'。SKU-4471 的產品記錄沒有列出任何無障礙欄位。類別 'home-kitchen' 有模板備註「或適合行動不便人士」，但這不是產品屬性。登記冊列明產品記錄是無障礙聲明的唯一認可來源。

title.zh: 助理對話日誌摘錄（虛構）

body.en: Fictional log extract. 2026-09-05 10:12, config v3.2, SKU-4471, customer asked about accessibility. Assistant replied 'This item is suitable for limited mobility.' 2026-09-05 10:20, config v3.2, SKU-4471, assistant repeated the same claim. 2026-08-20 09:40, config v3.1, SKU-4471, assistant replied 'No accessibility information is recorded for this item.' No other config versions appear in the log. The log shows the claim text matches the category template note wording.
body.zh: 虛構日誌摘錄。2026-09-05 10:12，設定 v3.2，SKU-4471，顧客查詢無障礙資料。助理回覆「此商品適合行動不便人士。」2026-09-05 10:20，設定 v3.2，SKU-4471，助理重複相同聲明。2026-08-20 09:40，設定 v3.1，SKU-4471，助理回覆「此商品沒有記錄無障礙資料。」日誌沒有其他設定版本。日誌顯示該聲明文字與類別模板備註措辭一致。

title.zh: 回歸測試計劃備註（虛構）

body.en: Fictional test notes. A regression test must confirm that with accessibility_claims set to 'record_only', SKU-4471 returns 'No accessibility information is recorded for this item.' The test must also confirm that a product record containing an accessibility field returns that field value. The test must run against config v3.3. Test evidence must include the config version, SKU and exact assistant reply. The notes state the fix is to change accessibility_claims from 'infer_from_category' to 'record_only'.
body.zh: 虛構測試備註。回歸測試必須確認當 accessibility_claims 設為 'record_only' 時，SKU-4471 回覆「此商品沒有記錄無障礙資料。」測試亦必須確認含有無障礙欄位的產品記錄會回傳該欄位值。測試須針對設定 v3.3 執行。測試證據必須包括設定版本、SKU 及助理確切回覆。備註列明修正方法是將 accessibility_claims 由 'infer_from_category' 改為 'record_only'。

label.zh: 虛構無障礙聲明的根本原因是甚麼？

label.en: Config v3.2 uses infer_from_category, which pulls the category template note
label.zh: 設定 v3.2 使用 infer_from_category，抽取了類別模板備註

label.en: Which sources are approved for accessibility claims?
label.zh: 哪些來源獲認可用於無障礙聲明？

exemplar.en: Evidence: Config v3.2 (active 2026-09-01) sets accessibility_claims to 'infer_from_category'. The 2026-09-05 log shows SKU-4471 replies matching the 'home-kitchen' category template note 'may suit limited mobility'. The SKU-4471 product record lists no accessibility fields, and the register states product records are the only approved source. Config v3.1 returned 'No accessibility information is recorded for this item.' Decision: change accessibility_claims to 'record_only'. Risk: the log shows only two SKU-4471 entries under v3.2, so other SKUs or categories may be affected. Next steps: run regression tests on config v3.3, confirm SKU-4471 returns the no-information reply, confirm a record with an accessibility field returns that value, and log config version, SKU and exact reply.
exemplar.zh: 證據：設定 v3.2（2026-09-01 起生效）將 accessibility_claims 設為 'infer_from_category'。2026-09-05 日誌顯示 SKU-4471 的回覆與 'home-kitchen' 類別模板備註「或適合行動不便人士」一致。SKU-4471 產品記錄沒有無障礙欄位，登記冊列明產品記錄是唯一認可來源。設定 v3.1 回覆「此商品沒有記錄無障礙資料。」決策：將 accessibility_claims 改為 'record_only'。風險：日誌在 v3.2 下只有兩筆 SKU-4471 記錄，其他 SKU 或類別或受影響。下一步：針對設定 v3.3 執行回歸測試，確認 SKU-4471 回覆無資料訊息，確認含無障礙欄位的記錄回傳該值，並記錄設定版本、SKU 及確切回覆。

title.en: HKTVmall Availability Assistant: Correcting a Fulfilment Record Mix-Up
title.zh: HKTVmall 貨品供應助理：修正履約記錄混用

brief.en: You support the fictional HKTVmall availability assistant demo. A fix draft mixed warehouse and store fulfilment records, so the bot reported wrong stock and pickup promises. Review the three fictional sources, answer the questions, then write a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. State the corrected rule, the evidence, the calculation method and a regression test plan. Policies, staff and records are invented for learning. This independent demo is not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 你支援虛構的 HKTVmall 貨品供應助理示範。修正草稿混用了倉庫與門店履約記錄，令機械人報錯庫存及自取承諾。請閱讀三份虛構文件，回答問題，然後撰寫約100至180英文字或相若中文的簡潔交接。說明修正規則、證據、計算方法及回歸測試計劃。政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此獨立示範未獲 HKTV 集團認可。

body.en: Fictional policy AV-7 governs the demo availability assistant. Only records with channel code WH (warehouse) may set the online stock figure. Records with channel code ST (store) may set the store pickup figure only. A record is usable only when its status field is CONFIRMED. Records with status PENDING or VOID must be ignored. The online stock figure and the store pickup figure are separate fields and must never be merged. Each usable record states one channel code, one status and one unit count.
body.zh: 虛構政策 AV-7 規管示範供應助理。只有渠道代碼 WH（倉庫）的記錄可設定網上庫存數字。渠道代碼 ST（門店）的記錄只可設定門店自取數字。記錄只有在狀態欄為 CONFIRMED 時才可使用。狀態為 PENDING 或 VOID 的記錄必須忽略。網上庫存數字與門店自取數字屬不同欄位，絕不可合併。每條可用記錄列明一個渠道代碼、一個狀態及一個單位數量。

title.zh: 虛構履約記錄，批次 F-22

body.en: Fictional batch F-22 for demo product P-100. Record R1: channel WH, status CONFIRMED, 40 units. Record R2: channel WH, status PENDING, 25 units. Record R3: channel ST, status CONFIRMED, 12 units. Record R4: channel ST, status VOID, 9 units. Record R5: channel WH, status CONFIRMED, 15 units. Record R6: channel ST, status CONFIRMED, 6 units. The draft fix merged all six records into one figure of 107 units and promised 107 units for store pickup.
body.zh: 虛構批次 F-22，示範產品 P-100。記錄 R1：渠道 WH，狀態 CONFIRMED，40 件。記錄 R2：渠道 WH，狀態 PENDING，25 件。記錄 R3：渠道 ST，狀態 CONFIRMED，12 件。記錄 R4：渠道 ST，狀態 VOID，9 件。記錄 R5：渠道 WH，狀態 CONFIRMED，15 件。記錄 R6：渠道 ST，狀態 CONFIRMED，6 件。修正草稿把六條記錄合併為一個 107 件數字，並承諾門店自取 107 件。

title.zh: 虛構回歸測試備註 RT-3

body.en: Fictional note RT-3 requires the corrected demo to be checked with three test cases. Case A: one WH CONFIRMED record of 30 units and one ST CONFIRMED record of 8 units. Case B: one WH PENDING record of 50 units and one ST CONFIRMED record of 4 units. Case C: one WH CONFIRMED record of 20 units and one ST VOID record of 7 units. For each case the note requires the online stock figure and the store pickup figure to be reported separately. The note states that a test passes only when both figures match policy AV-7.
body.zh: 虛構備註 RT-3 要求以三個測試案例檢查修正後的示範。案例 A：一條 WH CONFIRMED 記錄 30 件及一條 ST CONFIRMED 記錄 8 件。案例 B：一條 WH PENDING 記錄 50 件及一條 ST CONFIRMED 記錄 4 件。案例 C：一條 WH CONFIRMED 記錄 20 件及一條 ST VOID 記錄 7 件。每個案例均須分別報告網上庫存數字及門店自取數字。備註指出，只有兩個數字均符合政策 AV-7 時，測試才算通過。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Policy AV-7 says only WH CONFIRMED records set online stock, only ST CONFIRMED records set store pickup, and PENDING or VOID records are ignored. Batch F-22 has R1 WH CONFIRMED 40, R5 WH CONFIRMED 15, R3 ST CONFIRMED 12 and R6 ST CONFIRMED 6. R2 is PENDING and R4 is VOID. Decision and calculations: online stock is 40 plus 15, which is 55 units. Store pickup is 12 plus 6, which is 18 units. The draft figure of 107 came from merging both channels and counting PENDING and VOID records. Risks: the two fields could be merged again, and only supplied fictional records were checked. Next steps: apply the corrected rule, then run regression cases A, B and C. Case A should report online 30 and pickup 8. Case B should report online 0 and pickup 4. Case C should report online 20 and pickup 0. A case passes only when both figures match AV-7.
exemplar.zh: 證據：政策 AV-7 指出，只有 WH CONFIRMED 記錄設定網上庫存，只有 ST CONFIRMED 記錄設定門店自取，PENDING 或 VOID 記錄一律忽略。批次 F-22 有 R1 WH CONFIRMED 40、R5 WH CONFIRMED 15、R3 ST CONFIRMED 12 及 R6 ST CONFIRMED 6。R2 為 PENDING，R4 為 VOID。決策與計算：網上庫存為 40 加 15，即 55 件。門店自取為 12 加 6，即 18 件。草稿的 107 件來自合併兩個渠道並計入 PENDING 及 VOID 記錄。風險：兩個欄位可能再次被合併，而且只檢查了提供的虛構記錄。下一步：套用修正規則，然後執行回歸案例 A、B 及 C。案例 A 應報告網上 30、自取 8。案例 B 應報告網上 0、自取 4。案例 C 應報告網上 20、自取 0。只有兩個數字均符合 AV-7 時，案例才通過。

title.en: HKTVmall Shopping Assistant: Repairing Invented Accessibility Details
title.zh: HKTVmall 購物助理：修正虛構無障礙資料

brief.en: You are the AI engineer for a fictional HKTVmall shopping assistant demo. The assistant invented accessibility details for three product listings. All policies, staff, records and version identifiers in the sources are invented for learning. Repair the configuration so replies cite only recorded accessibility fields, then write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese (around 100 to 180 words) covering evidence, corrected settings, a regression test plan and residual uncertainty.
brief.zh: 你是虛構 HKTVmall 購物助理示範的 AI 工程師。助理為三個產品頁面虛構了無障礙資料。文件內所有政策、職員、記錄及版本編號均為學習而虛構。請修正設定，使回覆只引用已記錄的無障礙欄位，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔交接，涵蓋證據、修正設定、回歸測試計劃及剩餘不確定性。

body.en: Fictional record. Assistant version v4.2. Field policy: accessibility replies may cite only the recorded accessibility_note field. When accessibility_note is empty, the assistant must reply that no accessibility information is recorded and offer a human support handover. v4.2 instead generated plausible details from product titles. Three listings were affected: SKU-101, SKU-204 and SKU-317. Only SKU-204 has a non-empty accessibility_note. The approved fix is version v4.3.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。助理版本 v4.2。欄位政策：無障礙回覆只可引用已記錄的 accessibility_note 欄位。當 accessibility_note 為空時，助理必須回覆沒有記錄無障礙資料，並提供人工支援交接。v4.2 改為從產品標題生成看似合理的資料。受影響頁面三個：SKU-101、SKU-204 及 SKU-317。只有 SKU-204 的 accessibility_note 非空。核准修正版本為 v4.3。

body.en: Fictional log. Test run T-88 used assistant v4.2 on 12 scripted listing prompts. Result: 3 unsupported accessibility claims, all on SKU-101, SKU-204 and SKU-317. Test run T-89 used assistant v4.3 on the same 12 prompts. Result: 0 unsupported accessibility claims. T-89 also recorded 2 replies that omitted the human support handover when accessibility_note was empty. The team treats unsupported claims as the release blocker.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。測試 T-88 以助理 v4.2 執行12個預設產品提示。結果：3項無根據無障礙聲稱，全部在 SKU-101、SKU-204 及 SKU-317。測試 T-89 以助理 v4.3 執行相同12個提示。結果：0項無根據無障礙聲稱。T-89 亦記錄2個回覆在 accessibility_note 為空時遺漏人工支援交接。團隊視無根據聲稱為發布阻礙。

body.en: Fictional policy. Any accessibility question about a listing with an empty accessibility_note must end with the standard human support handover. The handover text is fixed and must not be paraphrased. Escalations are logged with the SKU identifier and the assistant version. A listing with a non-empty accessibility_note may be answered from that field only. No other field may be quoted as accessibility evidence.
body.zh: 虛構政策。任何關於 accessibility_note 為空頁面的無障礙問題，必須以標準人工支援交接作結。交接文字固定，不得改寫。升級記錄須包含 SKU 編號及助理版本。accessibility_note 非空的頁面只可依該欄位作答。任何其他欄位不得引述為無障礙證據。

label.en: Which assistant version is the approved repair?
label.zh: 哪個助理版本是核准修正？

label.en: What must the assistant do when accessibility_note is empty?
label.zh: 當 accessibility_note 為空時，助理必須怎樣做？

label.en: Infer details from the product title
State that no accessibility information is recorded and give the fixed human support handover
label.zh: 說明沒有記錄無障礙資料，並給出固定人工支援交接

label.en: Quote other listing fields as accessibility evidence
label.zh: 引述其他頁面欄位作為無障礙證據

label.en: How many unsupported accessibility claims did test run T-88 record?
label.zh: 測試 T-88 記錄了多少項無根據無障礙聲稱？

label.en: Which outcome does the team treat as the release blocker?

expectedEvidence.zh: 以 v4.3 重跑相同12個預設產品提示，要求0項無根據無障礙聲稱作為發布阻礙，並加入檢查每個 accessibility_note 為空的回覆均以固定交接作結，因 T-89 記錄2個遺漏交接。

description.en: Flags residual uncertainty and communicates the handover clearly for a support audience.
description.zh: 指出剩餘不確定性，並為支援團隊清晰傳達交接。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that T-89 covered only 12 scripted prompts, so unseen listings may still fail, and that the 2 missing handovers show the handover rule needs monitoring. Handover is concise, structured and readable in English or Traditional Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 T-89 只涵蓋12個預設提示，未見頁面仍可能出錯，而2個遺漏交接顯示交接規則需持續監察。交接簡潔、有結構，以英文或香港繁體中文清晰可讀。

description.en: Keeps the repair within the recorded policy and avoids inventing extra rules or approvals.
description.zh: 修正保持在已記錄政策範圍內，不虛構額外規則或審批。

expectedEvidence.en: Does not invent new fields, thresholds, approvers or policies beyond the three sources, and does not claim the demo is endorsed by or affiliated with HKTVmall.
expectedEvidence.zh: 不超出三份文件虛構新欄位、門檻、審批人或政策，亦不聲稱示範獲 HKTVmall 認可或有關聯。

exemplar.en: Evidence: assistant v4.2 generated unsupported accessibility details for SKU-101, SKU-204 and SKU-317. Only SKU-204 has a non-empty accessibility_note. Test T-88 recorded 3 unsupported claims on v4.2. Test T-89 recorded 0 unsupported claims on v4.3 but 2 missing human support handovers. Decision: adopt v4.3 as the approved repair. Corrected settings: accessibility replies may cite only accessibility_note. When it is empty, reply that no accessibility information is recorded and append the fixed human support handover verbatim. No other field counts as accessibility evidence. Escalations log the SKU identifier and assistant version. Regression plan: rerun the same 12 scripted listing prompts on v4.3, require 0 unsupported claims as the release blocker, and add a check that every empty accessibility_note reply ends with the fixed handover. Risks: T-89 covered only 12 prompts, so unseen listings may still fail, and the 2 missing handovers need monitoring. Next steps: run the rerun, review handover coverage, then report results to the support team.
exemplar.zh: 證據：助理 v4.2 為 SKU-101、SKU-204 及 SKU-317 生成無根據無障礙資料。只有 SKU-204 的 accessibility_note 非空。測試 T-88 在 v4.2 記錄3項無根據聲稱。測試 T-89 在 v4.3 記錄0項無根據聲稱，但有2個遺漏人工支援交接。決策：採用 v4.3 為核准修正。修正設定：無障礙回覆只可引用 accessibility_note。當它為空時，回覆沒有記錄無障礙資料，並原文照用固定人工支援交接。任何其他欄位不計為無障礙證據。升級記錄須包含 SKU 編號及助理版本。回歸計劃：以 v4.3 重跑相同12個預設產品提示，要求0項無根據聲稱作為發布阻礙，並加入檢查每個 accessibility_note 為空的回覆均以固定交接作結。風險：T-89 只涵蓋12個提示，未見頁面仍可能出錯，而2個遺漏交接需持續監察。下一步：執行重跑，檢視交接覆蓋率，然後向支援團隊報告結果。

title.en: HKTVmall Availability Assistant: Fulfilment Record Mix-Up Handover
title.zh: HKTVmall 存貨助理：履約記錄混雜交接

brief.en: You are reviewing a fictional HKTVmall availability assistant that mixes fulfilment records. Read the three invented sources. Answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. Explain the cause, the corrected configuration, the regression test plan and one uncertainty. All policies, staff and records are invented for this independent learning simulation and are not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 你正審視一個虛構的 HKTVmall 存貨助理，它把履約記錄混雜。請閱讀三份虛構文件，回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔證據交接，說明成因、修正設定、回歸測試計劃及一項不確定性。所有政策、職員及記錄均為此獨立學習模擬而虛構，未獲 HKTV 集團認可。

body.en: Fictional record. Assistant version AV-7.2 answers stock questions. Setting stock_source is set to warehouse_ledger. Setting storefront_source is set to web_catalogue. The assistant reads only stock_source for availability replies. Warehouse ledger rows carry status reserved, which means units are held for an existing order and are not sellable. Web catalogue rows carry status listed. Policy P-3 states availability replies must count only sellable units.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。助理版本 AV-7.2 回答存貨問題。設定 stock_source 為 warehouse_ledger。設定 storefront_source 為 web_catalogue。助理只讀取 stock_source 以回答存貨。倉庫帳目列帶有狀態 reserved，即單位已被現有訂單保留，不可售。網店目錄列帶有狀態 listed。政策 P-3 規定存貨回覆只可計算可售單位。

body.en: Fictional log. Product SKU-441 has 12 warehouse ledger units, all status reserved. The same SKU has 9 web catalogue units, all status listed. Product SKU-552 has 5 warehouse ledger units, all status reserved, and 4 web catalogue units, all status listed. The assistant replied to a customer that SKU-441 had 12 units available and SKU-552 had 5 units available. No other stock rows exist for these two SKUs.
body.zh: 虛構日誌。產品 SKU-441 有12個倉庫帳目單位，全部狀態為 reserved。同一 SKU 有9個網店目錄單位，全部狀態為 listed。產品 SKU-552 有5個倉庫帳目單位，全部狀態為 reserved，另有4個網店目錄單位，全部狀態為 listed。助理回覆顧客指 SKU-441 有12個單位可售，SKU-552 有5個單位可售。這兩個 SKU 並無其他存貨列。

body.en: Fictional note. A fix must change one setting only. The approved fix is to point stock_source at web_catalogue, because web catalogue rows carry status listed and policy P-3 counts only sellable units. Regression test T-1 must recheck SKU-441 and SKU-552 availability replies against policy P-3. Test T-2 must confirm reserved warehouse rows are excluded. The change window is one release. No contingency budget is approved.
body.zh: 虛構備註。修正只可更改一項設定。已批准的修正是把 stock_source 指向 web_catalogue，因為網店目錄列帶有狀態 listed，而政策 P-3 只計算可售單位。回歸測試 T-1 必須按政策 P-3 重新檢查 SKU-441 及 SKU-552 的存貨回覆。測試 T-2 必須確認 reserved 倉庫列被排除。變更窗口為一個版本。並無批准任何應急預算。

label.en: Which single setting caused the mix-up?
Which approved fix matches the change note?
label.zh: 哪項已批准修正符合變更備註？

label.en: Which test set matches the change note?
label.zh: 哪組測試符合變更備註？

label.en: T-2 confirms reserved warehouse rows are excluded

label.en: T-3 adds a new contingency budget

title.en: HKTVmall Availability Assistant: Adapting to Mixed Fulfilment Records
title.zh: HKTVmall 貨存助理：適應混合履約記錄

brief.en: You support the fictional HKTVmall availability assistant. A new fulfilment feed now mixes merchant stock, warehouse stock and preorder records, so the old single-source rule no longer holds. Review the three fictional sources, choose the corrected configuration, answer the questions, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. All policies, staff and records are invented for this independent learning demo and are not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 你支援虛構的 HKTVmall 貨存助理。新的履約數據源現時混合商戶存貨、倉庫存貨及預購記錄，舊有的單一來源規則不再適用。請審閱三份虛構文件，選出修正後的設定，回答問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔證據為本交接說明。所有政策、職員及記錄均為此獨立學習示範而虛構，並不獲 HKTV 集團認可。

title.zh: 虛構貨存助理設定 v3

body.en: This fictional configuration v3 states one rule. The assistant may show a product as available only when the fulfilment record type is warehouse. Merchant stock and preorder records must not be shown as available. The confidence threshold for showing availability is 0.80 inclusive. Records below 0.80 must show the message Check availability with the seller. Version v3 was written before the mixed feed existed.
body.zh: 此虛構設定 v3 載有一項規則。助理只有在履約記錄類型為倉庫時，才可顯示產品為有貨。商戶存貨及預購記錄不得顯示為有貨。顯示有貨的置信度門檻為 0.80，包含 0.80。低於 0.80 的記錄必須顯示訊息「請向賣家查詢貨存」。版本 v3 在混合數據源出現前撰寫。

title.zh: 虛構混合履約數據源樣本

body.en: This fictional feed sample lists four records. Record R1 is warehouse stock with confidence 0.91. Record R2 is merchant stock with confidence 0.95. Record R3 is preorder with confidence 0.88. Record R4 is warehouse stock with confidence 0.74. The feed does not state delivery dates. The feed does not state seller names. Only record type and confidence are supplied.
body.zh: 此虛構數據源樣本列出四筆記錄。記錄 R1 為倉庫存貨，置信度 0.91。記錄 R2 為商戶存貨，置信度 0.95。記錄 R3 為預購，置信度 0.88。記錄 R4 為倉庫存貨，置信度 0.74。數據源不載列送貨日期。數據源不載列賣家名稱。只提供記錄類型及置信度。

body.en: This fictional change request CR-14 changes one constraint. From now on, warehouse stock and merchant stock may both be shown as available when confidence is at least 0.80. Preorder records must never be shown as available. The message for all other cases is Check availability with the seller. The confidence threshold stays at 0.80 inclusive. No other rule changes.
body.zh: 此虛構變更請求 CR-14 更改一項限制。由現在起，倉庫存貨及商戶存貨在置信度至少 0.80 時均可顯示為有貨。預購記錄一律不得顯示為有貨。其他情況的訊息為「請向賣家查詢貨存」。置信度門檻維持 0.80，包含 0.80。其他規則不變。

label.zh: 根據 CR-14，哪些記錄類型可顯示為有貨？

label.zh: 根據 CR-14，哪些記錄必須顯示訊息「請向賣家查詢貨存」？

exemplar.en: Evidence: Source one v3 allowed warehouse stock only. CR-14 now allows warehouse stock and merchant stock when confidence is at least 0.80 inclusive. Preorder records must never be shown as available. Source two lists R1 warehouse 0.91, R2 merchant 0.95, R3 preorder 0.88 and R4 warehouse 0.74. Decision: R1 and R2 may be shown as available, so two records qualify. R3 and R4 must show Check availability with the seller, so two records show the message. Risks: the feed gives no delivery dates and no seller names, so the assistant cannot promise timing or identify sellers. Next steps: update the configuration to CR-14, keep the 0.80 inclusive threshold, and retest all four records before release.
exemplar.zh: 證據：文件一 v3 只允許倉庫存貨。CR-14 現允許倉庫存貨及商戶存貨在置信度至少 0.80（包含 0.80）時顯示。預購記錄一律不得顯示為有貨。文件二列出 R1 倉庫 0.91、R2 商戶 0.95、R3 預購 0.88、R4 倉庫 0.74。決策：R1 及 R2 可顯示為有貨，即兩筆記錄符合。R3 及 R4 必須顯示「請向賣家查詢貨存」，即兩筆記錄顯示訊息。風險：數據源沒有送貨日期及賣家名稱，助理不能承諾時間或識別賣家。下一步：把設定更新至 CR-14，維持 0.80 包含門檻，並在發佈前重新測試全部四筆記錄。

title.en: Synthetic Sample-Label Reconciliation for a Fictional Batch
title.zh: 虛構批次之合成樣本標籤核對

brief.en: You support the sample reception desk in a fictional paper exercise. A synthetic batch of 12 samples arrived with labels, a log sheet and a label-printing note. Reconcile the records, decide which samples can proceed to fictional paper review, and identify one label defect. All records are fictional learning assumptions, not real STC policies or results. This is an independent demo, not endorsed, and not a job opening. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 你在虛構文件練習中支援樣本接收櫃檯。一個合成批次共 12 個樣本，附有標籤、紀錄表及標籤打印說明。請核對紀錄，決定哪些樣本可進入虛構的文件審閱，並指出一項標籤缺陷。所有紀錄均為虛構學習假設，並非真實 STC 政策或結果。此為獨立示範，未獲認可，亦非招聘職位。請提交約 100 至 180 英文字或相若篇幅香港繁體中文、以證據為本的簡潔交接說明。

body.en: Synthetic batch B-204 has 12 samples. Log entries: S01 to S08 received 09:00 with intact seals. S09 received 09:40, seal intact. S10 received 10:05, seal intact. S11 received 10:20, seal broken on arrival. S12 received 10:35, seal intact. The log states that a broken seal means the sample cannot proceed to paper review. All 12 samples are fictional.
body.zh: 合成批次 B-204 共 12 個樣本。紀錄：S01 至 S08 於 09:00 收到，封條完整。S09 於 09:40 收到，封條完整。S10 於 10:05 收到，封條完整。S11 於 10:20 收到，封條於送達時已破損。S12 於 10:35 收到，封條完整。紀錄表列明封條破損的樣本不可進入文件審閱。全部 12 個樣本均為虛構。

body.en: Synthetic label rule for batch B-204. Each label must show the batch code B-204 and a two-digit sample number from 01 to 12. The printer log shows labels printed for 01 to 10 and 12. Label 11 was printed with the batch code B-024. The note states that a wrong batch code is a label defect and the sample must be relabelled before paper review. All entries are fictional.
body.zh: 批次 B-204 的合成標籤規則。每個標籤須顯示批次代碼 B-204 及由 01 至 12 的兩位數字樣本編號。打印紀錄顯示已打印 01 至 10 及 12 的標籤。標籤 11 打印的批次代碼為 B-024。說明列明批次代碼錯誤屬標籤缺陷，該樣本須重新貼標後方可進入文件審閱。全部紀錄均為虛構。

body.en: Synthetic criteria for batch B-204. A sample may proceed to paper review only when its seal is intact and its label shows the correct batch code B-204. Samples that fail either condition are held. The hold list is reported to the fictional team lead. No chemical, biological or certification decision is made. All criteria are fictional learning assumptions.
body.zh: 批次 B-204 的合成準則。樣本只在封條完整且標籤顯示正確批次代碼 B-204 時，方可進入文件審閱。任何一項條件不符的樣本均會被暫緩。暫緩清單須向虛構團隊主管報告。過程中不作出任何化學、生物或認證決定。全部準則均為虛構學習假設。
