exemplar.en: Evidence: batch B-204 has 12 synthetic samples. The log shows S01 to S10 and S12 with intact seals, while S11 arrived with a broken seal. The label note shows label 11 printed with batch code B-024 instead of B-204. Decision and calculations: 12 samples minus S11 equals 11 samples that meet both conditions, so 11 may proceed to paper review. S11 is held for a broken seal and a wrong batch code. Risks: the log and printer note are assumed complete, and other label fields are unverified. Next steps: report the hold list containing S11 to the fictional team lead and arrange relabelling before any paper review. This is a fictional exercise with no certification decision.
exemplar.zh: 證據：批次 B-204 有 12 個合成樣本。紀錄顯示 S01 至 S10 及 S12 封條完整，S11 送達時封條破損。標籤說明顯示標籤 11 打印的批次代碼為 B-024 而非 B-204。決策與計算：12 個樣本減去 S11 等於 11 個同時符合兩項條件的樣本，故 11 個可進入文件審閱。S11 因封條破損及批次代碼錯誤而被暫緩。風險：假設紀錄表及打印說明完整，其他標籤欄位尚未核實。下一步：向虛構團隊主管報告包含 S11 的暫緩清單，並在文件審閱前安排重新貼標。此為虛構練習，不涉及認證決定。

feedback.en: Your reconciliation is accurate. You correctly note S01 to S10 and S12 have intact seals while S11 has a broken seal, and you subtract S11 from the 12 samples to reach 11 that may proceed. You also tie S11 to both failing conditions, which matches the log sheet and label note.
feedback.zh: 你的核對準確。你正確指出 S01 至 S10 及 S12 封條完整，而 S11 封條破損，並從 12 個樣本中減去 S11 得出 11 個可進入審閱。你亦把 S11 連結至兩項不符條件，與紀錄表及標籤說明一致。

feedback.en: You name the specific defect, label 11 showing batch code B-024 instead of B-204, and link it to the label-printing note. This is the exact defect the note defines as a label defect requiring relabelling.
feedback.zh: 你指出具體缺陷，即標籤 11 顯示批次代碼 B-024 而非 B-204，並連結至標籤打印說明。這正是說明所指、須重新貼標的標籤缺陷。

feedback.en: You clearly separate what is known from what is assumed, noting the log and printer note are assumed complete and that other label fields remain unverified. That is the appropriate caveat because the note only covers batch code and sample number.
feedback.zh: 你清楚區分已知與假設內容，指出假設紀錄表及打印說明完整，以及其他標籤欄位尚未核實。此保留恰當，因說明只涵蓋批次代碼及樣本編號。

feedback.en: Your handover is 116 English words, within the 100 to 180 guidance, and is structured with evidence, decision, risks and next steps. It names S11, the count of 11, the defect and the report action clearly for a reader.
feedback.zh: 你的交接為 116 個英文字，符合 100 至 180 的指引，並以證據、決策、風險及下一步編排。內容清晰列明 S11、數目 11、缺陷及報告行動，方便讀者理解。

feedback.en: You state this is a fictional exercise with no certification decision, keeping the work on paper as the scenario requires. No real laboratory or certification claim is made.
feedback.zh: 你說明此為虛構練習，不涉及認證決定，符合情境要求的文件層面處理。文中並無作出真實化驗或認證聲稱。

summary.en: All four structured answers are correct and your written handover is accurate, well evidenced and within the suggested length. The reconciliation, defect identification, uncertainty caveat and boundary statement all match the supplied fictional sources.
summary.zh: 四項結構化答案全部正確，書面交接準確、證據充分且符合建議篇幅。紀錄核對、缺陷識別、不確定性保留及界線說明均與提供的虛構資料相符。

nextSteps.en: No corrections are needed. For further practice, you could briefly state what evidence would confirm the unverified label fields, such as a full label inspection record for all 12 samples.
nextSteps.zh: 無須修正。若進一步練習，可簡述哪些證據能確認尚未核實的標籤欄位，例如全部 12 個樣本的完整標籤檢查紀錄。

title.en: foodpanda preparation-time records with missing measurements
title.zh: foodpanda 備餐時間紀錄與缺失測量值

brief.en: You are an independent data analyst reviewing a synthetic sample of foodpanda restaurant preparation-time records. Three source documents describe the sample, the logging rules and a completeness note. Identify how many records are usable, choose the correct handling rule for a missing measurement, and compute the average preparation time of the usable records. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, explaining your cleaning decision, the calculation and the uncertainty. This is a fictional learning scenario, not foodpanda operational data.
brief.zh: 你是獨立數據分析師，正審閱一批合成的 foodpanda 餐廳備餐時間紀錄樣本。三份文件說明樣本內容、記錄規則及完整性備註。請判斷有多少筆紀錄可用、選出處理缺失測量值的正確規則，並計算可用紀錄的平均備餐時間。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫一份簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，英文約 100 至 180 字或相若中文篇幅，解釋你的清理決定、計算方法及不確定性。此為虛構學習情境，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。

managerRole.zh: 團隊主管，合成數據審閱

body.en: This fictional sample contains 8 restaurant preparation-time records. Preparation time is measured in whole minutes from order confirmation to handover to the rider. Record A is 12 minutes. Record B is 18 minutes. Record C is 15 minutes. Record D is 20 minutes. Record E is 14 minutes. Record F is 16 minutes. Record G is 11 minutes. Record H is 19 minutes. All eight records were logged in the same synthetic week. No record is duplicated.
body.zh: 此虛構樣本包含 8 筆餐廳備餐時間紀錄。備餐時間以整數分鐘計算，由確認訂單至交付騎手為止。紀錄 A 為 12 分鐘。紀錄 B 為 18 分鐘。紀錄 C 為 15 分鐘。紀錄 D 為 20 分鐘。紀錄 E 為 14 分鐘。紀錄 F 為 16 分鐘。紀錄 G 為 11 分鐘。紀錄 H 為 19 分鐘。八筆紀錄均記錄於同一合成星期內。沒有紀錄重複。

body.en: This fictional rule set applies to the sample. A record is usable only when its preparation time is present and is 10 minutes or more. A record with a missing preparation time is not usable and must be excluded. A record below 10 minutes is not usable and must be excluded. The usable-record average is the sum of usable preparation times divided by the count of usable records. Round the average to one decimal place.
body.zh: 此虛構規則適用於該樣本。只有備餐時間存在且為 10 分鐘或以上，該紀錄方為可用。備餐時間缺失的紀錄不可用，必須剔除。低於 10 分鐘的紀錄不可用，必須剔除。可用紀錄平均值為可用備餐時間總和除以可用紀錄數目。平均值四捨五入至一位小數。

body.en: This fictional note records data-quality observations. Record C has a missing preparation time in the source system and its 15 minutes shown in the sample log is a placeholder that must not be used. Record G was logged during a synthetic system restart and its 11 minutes is confirmed as a valid measurement. No other record has a missing or placeholder value.
body.zh: 此虛構備註記錄數據質素觀察。紀錄 C 在來源系統中備餐時間缺失，樣本紀錄所示的 15 分鐘為佔位值，不得使用。紀錄 G 於一次合成系統重啟期間記錄，其 11 分鐘確認為有效測量值。其他紀錄均無缺失或佔位值。

label.en: How many records are usable under the synthetic logging rules?
label.zh: 根據合成記錄規則，有多少筆紀錄可用？

label.en: Which handling rule applies to a record with a missing preparation time?
label.zh: 備餐時間缺失的紀錄應適用哪項處理規則？

label.en: Exclude the record from the usable set
label.zh: 把該紀錄從可用集合中剔除

label.en: Use the placeholder value shown in the sample log
label.zh: 採用樣本紀錄所示的佔位值

label.en: Replace the missing value with the sample average
label.zh: 以樣本平均值取代缺失值

label.en: Keep the record and flag it as usable
label.zh: 保留該紀錄並標示為可用

label.en: What is the average preparation time of the usable records, in minutes, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 可用紀錄的平均備餐時間為多少分鐘，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: Which statement best describes the uncertainty of this synthetic sample?
label.zh: 哪項陳述最能描述此合成樣本的不確定性？

label.en: The sample is small and covers one synthetic week, so the average is an estimate and not a stable platform-wide figure
label.zh: 樣本規模小且只涵蓋一個合成星期，因此平均值僅屬估算，並非穩定的全平台數字

label.en: The average is the exact platform-wide preparation time because all records were logged
label.zh: 由於所有紀錄均已記錄，該平均值即全平台準確備餐時間

label.en: The average proves that system restarts cause longer preparation times
label.zh: 該平均值證明系統重啟會導致備餐時間延長

label.en: There is no uncertainty because the rules are clearly written
label.zh: 由於規則清楚列明，因此不存在不確定性

description.en: Describes the limits of the synthetic sample and avoids causal or platform-wide claims
description.zh: 說明合成樣本的局限，避免因果或全平台結論

expectedEvidence.en: Selects small-sample. The sample has 7 usable records from one synthetic week, so the average is an estimate. The sources do not support platform-wide exactness, causal claims about restarts, or a claim of no uncertainty.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇 small-sample。樣本只有一個合成星期的 7 筆可用紀錄，平均值僅屬估算。文件不支持全平台準確性、重啟因果結論或不存在不確定性的說法。

description.en: Writes a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, covering decision, calculation and uncertainty
description.zh: 以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，英文約 100 至 180 字或相若中文篇幅，涵蓋決定、計算及不確定性

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states 7 usable records, excludes record C for a missing placeholder value, shows sum 110 divided by 7 equals 15.7 minutes, and notes the small one-week sample limits confidence. Target is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, judged on completeness and clarity rather than an exact count.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明指出 7 筆可用紀錄，因缺失佔位值而剔除紀錄 C，展示 110 除以 7 等於 15.7 分鐘，並指出單一星期小樣本限制信心。目標為英文約 100 至 180 字或相若中文篇幅，以完整性及清晰度評核，而非精確字數。

description.en: References the specific synthetic documents and rules rather than general assumptions
description.zh: 引用具體合成文件及規則，而非一般假設

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the synthetic sample log for the eight values, the synthetic logging rules for the 10-minute inclusive threshold and exclusion of missing values, and the completeness note for record C placeholder and record G validity.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用合成樣本紀錄的八個數值、合成記錄規則的 10 分鐘包含門檻及缺失值剔除，以及完整性備註中紀錄 C 佔位值與紀錄 G 有效性的說明。

exemplar.en: Handover for the synthetic foodpanda preparation-time review. I treated a record as usable only when its preparation time was present and at least 10 minutes, per the synthetic logging rules. Record C is excluded because its preparation time is missing and the 15 minutes in the sample log is a placeholder. Record G stays because the completeness note confirms its 11 minutes is valid. That leaves 7 usable records with values 12, 18, 20, 14, 16, 11 and 19 minutes. The sum is 110 minutes, and 110 divided by 7 is 15.714, which rounds to 15.7 minutes. The main uncertainty is sample size. Seven records from one synthetic week give an estimate only, so I would not treat 15.7 minutes as a stable platform-wide figure or infer causes from it.
exemplar.zh: 合成 foodpanda 備餐時間審閱交接說明。根據合成記錄規則，我僅在備餐時間存在且至少 10 分鐘時，視該紀錄為可用。紀錄 C 因備餐時間缺失而被剔除，樣本紀錄所示的 15 分鐘為佔位值。紀錄 G 獲保留，因完整性備註確認其 11 分鐘有效。可用紀錄共 7 筆，數值為 12、18、20、14、16、11 及 19 分鐘。總和為 110 分鐘，110 除以 7 為 15.714，四捨五入至 15.7 分鐘。主要不確定性在於樣本規模。單一合成星期的 7 筆紀錄只提供估算，因此我不會把 15.7 分鐘視為穩定的全平台數字，亦不會由此推斷成因。

brief.en: You are helping a fictional analytics team at a Hong Kong delivery platform. Review the synthetic event-log extract and the capture-semantics note, then answer the questions and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Aim for roughly 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. All records, teams and figures are fictional learning assumptions, not foodpanda operational data. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by the company and is not endorsed by it. No current job opening is implied.
brief.zh: 你正協助香港一個配送平台的虛構分析團隊。請覆核合成事件日誌摘錄及擷取語意說明，回答問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、有理據的交接說明。建議約100至180英文字或相應中文。所有記錄、團隊及數字均為虛構學習假設，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。此為受該公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦不暗示任何現有職位空缺。

title.zh: 合成事件日誌摘錄（一個晚上）

body.en: Fictional records for learning only. Each row is one captured event. Order events: 120 captured. Pickup events: 95 captured rows in total. Within those 95 pickup rows, exactly 12 are redundant extra rows for the same order and stage, forming 12 duplicate groups of one extra row each. No other duplicates exist. Delivered events: 88 captured. Of the 88 delivered events, 80 have a matching pickup event in the same order. Timestamps are captured in Hong Kong time. Capture is automatic and no manual edits were applied.
body.zh: 僅供學習的虛構記錄。每行代表一個已擷取事件。下單事件：擷取120宗。取餐事件：合共擷取95行。該95行取餐記錄中，恰好有12行為同一訂單同一階段的多餘重複行，構成12個各含一行多餘記錄的重複組。並無其他重複。送達事件：擷取88宗。88宗送達事件中，80宗在同一訂單內有對應取餐事件。時間戳以香港時間擷取。擷取為自動進行，並無人手修改。

body.en: Fictional internal note for this exercise. A captured event means the platform wrote one timestamp row. A unique event means one order and one stage counted once. Duplicate capture rows are removed before counting unique events. A completed order requires one unique pickup event and one unique delivered event for the same order. A strict threshold means strictly greater than the stated value. An inclusive threshold means greater than or equal to the stated value.
body.zh: 本練習的虛構內部說明。已擷取事件指平台寫入一行時間戳。唯一事件指一個訂單及一個階段只計一次。計算唯一事件前會移除重複擷取行。完成訂單須同一訂單有一個唯一取餐事件及一個唯一送達事件。嚴格門檻指嚴格大於所述數值。包含門檻指大於或等於所述數值。

label.en: They reflect repeated automatic capture for the same order and stage.

label.zh: 以唯一取餐事件計算，數目是否嚴格大於80？

label.en: Yes, it is strictly greater than 80.
No, it is not strictly greater than 80.

exemplar.en: Evidence. The synthetic extract shows 120 order events, 95 captured pickup rows and 88 captured delivered events. The semantics note says duplicate capture rows are removed before counting unique events. Calculation. Pickup: 95 captured rows minus 12 redundant extra rows equals 83 unique pickup events. Completed orders: 80 delivered events have a matching pickup event in the same order, so 80 completed orders are supported. Threshold: 83 is strictly greater than 80, so the strict check passes. Next steps. Confirm capture rules with the data owner and recheck unique counts before any reporting.

title.en: Promotion Conversion Review with Attribution Limits
title.zh: 推廣轉換檢視與歸因限制

brief.en: You are helping a fictional foodpanda-style delivery analytics team review a synthetic promotion pilot. Read the three fictional source documents. Answer the questions using only stated counts, denominators and event definitions. Then write a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words (or comparable Traditional Chinese) explaining your decisions, calculations, uncertainty and next steps. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by foodpanda, not endorsed by it, and no real promotion records are used.
brief.zh: 你正協助一個虛構的 foodpanda 風格配送分析團隊，檢視一項合成推廣試行。請閱讀三份虛構文件，只根據已列明的數量、分母及事件定義回答問題。然後撰寫約 100 至 180 英文字（或相若中文）的精簡證據為本交接說明，交代你的決策、計算、不確定性及下一步。這是受 foodpanda 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦不使用真實推廣紀錄。

body.en: A fictional two-week promotion pilot ran in two Hong Kong districts. Stage A (banner shown) had 4,000 unique sessions. Stage B (banner clicked) had 900 unique sessions. Stage C (order placed in the same session as a click) had 180 unique sessions. Stages are counted independently, so a session may appear in more than one stage. The pilot budget was HKD 30,000. Total pilot spend was HKD 24,000. Baseline orders without the banner were 150. All figures are synthetic learning assumptions.
body.zh: 一項虛構的兩星期推廣試行在兩個香港地區進行。階段甲（顯示橫幅）有 4,000 個不重複工作階段。階段乙（點擊橫幅）有 900 個不重複工作階段。階段丙（在點擊的同一工作階段內下單）有 180 個不重複工作階段。各階段獨立計算，同一工作階段可出現於多於一個階段。試行預算為 30,000 港元。試行總支出為 24,000 港元。沒有橫幅的基準訂單為 150。所有數字均為合成學習假設。

body.en: The fictional team states that banner exposure and order placement occurred in the same session, but this does not prove the banner caused the order. A separate synthetic survey of 200 customers found 60 said the banner influenced their choice. The remaining 140 gave other reasons. The team defines a strict conversion as an order placed in the same session as a click. An inclusive conversion counts any order in a session where the banner was shown, whether or not it was clicked. All notes are fictional learning assumptions.
body.zh: 虛構團隊指出，橫幅曝光與下單在同一工作階段發生，但這不證明橫幅導致下單。另一項 200 名顧客的合成調查發現，60 人表示橫幅影響其選擇，其餘 140 人提出其他原因。團隊把嚴格轉換定義為：在點擊的同一工作階段內下單。寬鬆轉換則計算任何在顯示橫幅的工作階段內下單，不論有否點擊。所有備註均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: The fictional team applies these rules. Cost per strict conversion equals total pilot spend divided by strict conversions. A promotion is called efficient only if cost per strict conversion is at or below HKD 150. A promotion is called budget-safe only if total pilot spend is strictly below the pilot budget. The team treats survey influence as self-reported and not as proof of causation. All rules are synthetic learning assumptions.
body.zh: 虛構團隊採用以下規則。每次嚴格轉換成本等於試行總支出除以嚴格轉換次數。只有當每次嚴格轉換成本等於或低於 150 港元，推廣才稱為有效率。只有當試行總支出嚴格低於試行預算，推廣才稱為預算安全。團隊把調查影響視為自我報告，並非因果證明。所有規則均為合成學習假設。

label.zh: 列明的嚴格轉換次數是多少？

label.en: What is the cost per strict conversion in HKD?
label.zh: 每次嚴格轉換成本是多少港元？

label.en: Under the stated rules, which label applies to cost per strict conversion?
label.zh: 根據列明規則，每次嚴格轉換成本應獲哪個標籤？

label.en: Efficient, because cost per strict conversion is at or below HKD 150
label.zh: 有效率，因為每次嚴格轉換成本等於或低於 150 港元

label.en: Not efficient, because cost per strict conversion is above HKD 150
label.zh: 無效率，因為每次嚴格轉換成本高於 150 港元

label.en: Cannot tell from the stated rules
label.zh: 根據列明規則無法判斷

label.zh: 根據列明規則，應獲哪個預算標籤？

label.en: Budget-safe, because total spend is strictly below the pilot budget
label.zh: 預算安全，因為總支出嚴格低於試行預算

label.en: Not budget-safe, because total spend is not strictly below the pilot budget
label.zh: 預算不安全，因為總支出並非嚴格低於試行預算

label.en: Cannot tell from the stated rules
label.zh: 根據列明規則無法判斷

label.zh: 哪項陳述最符合合成歸因備註？

label.en: The banner caused the orders because exposure and orders were in the same session
label.zh: 橫幅導致下單，因為曝光與下單在同一工作階段

label.en: Exposure and orders were associated, but causation is not proven
label.zh: 曝光與下單有關聯，但未證明因果

label.en: The 60 survey responses prove the banner caused all orders
label.zh: 60 份調查回覆證明橫幅導致所有下單

exemplar.en:
Evidence. Source one states Stage C had 180 unique sessions with an order in the same session as a click, total pilot spend was HKD 24,000 and the pilot budget was HKD 30,000. Source two defines strict conversion as an order in the same session as a click, and states exposure and orders do not prove causation. Source three sets the efficiency threshold at HKD 150 and budget safety as spend strictly below budget.

Decision and calculations. Strict conversions are 180. Cost per strict conversion is 24,000 divided by 180, about HKD 133.33, which is at or below HKD 150, so the promotion is efficient. Spend of HKD 24,000 is strictly below HKD 30,000, so it is budget-safe.

Risks. Same-session exposure and orders show association only. The 60 of 200 survey responses are self-reported, not proof.

Next steps. Run a controlled test and track strict conversions separately.
exemplar.zh:
證據。文件一列明階段丙有 180 個不重複工作階段在點擊的同一工作階段內下單，試行總支出為 24,000 港元，試行預算為 30,000 港元。文件二把嚴格轉換定義為在點擊的同一工作階段內下單，並指出曝光與下單不證明因果。文件三把效率門檻設為 150 港元，預算安全則為支出嚴格低於預算。

決策與計算。嚴格轉換為 180。每次嚴格轉換成本為 24,000 除以 180，約 133.33 港元，等於或低於 150 港元，因此推廣有效率。支出 24,000 港元嚴格低於 30,000 港元，因此預算安全。

風險。同一工作階段的曝光與下單只顯示關聯。200 份中的 60 份調查回覆屬自我報告，並非證明。

下一步。進行對照測試，並分開追蹤嚴格轉換。

title.en: MTR Passenger Notification Preferences: Critical Update Coverage
title.zh: 港鐵乘客通知偏好：關鍵更新覆蓋

brief.en: You are a UX designer on a fictional MTR passenger-app study. Review the supplied synthetic research notes and design requirements. Choose the notification setting combination that gives the greatest estimated reduction in non-critical alerts while keeping every mandatory critical update enabled within the stated budget. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decision, calculations, risks and next steps. A helpful target is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. All records are fictional learning assumptions. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by MTR Corporation, and no real job opening is implied.
brief.zh: 你是虛構港鐵乘客應用程式研究項目的用戶體驗設計師。請審閱提供的模擬研究筆記及設計要求，選出能在既定預算內保持所有強制關鍵更新開啟，同時令非關鍵提示估計減幅最大的通知設定組合。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，涵蓋證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步。建議目標約為100至180英文字或相若篇幅的繁體中文。所有記錄均為虛構學習假設。此為獨立示範，未獲港鐵公司認可，亦不暗示任何真實職位空缺。

managerRole.zh: 團隊主管，乘客數碼體驗（虛構）

title.en: Synthetic research notes: alert volumes and preferences
title.zh: 模擬研究筆記：提示量與偏好

body.en: Fictional internal study. Weekly average per active passenger: 42 non-critical alerts and 6 critical alerts. Critical alerts are defined as service disruption, safety-related station notice and accessibility lift outage. All three critical categories must remain enabled at all times. Non-critical categories are: nearby offers, loyalty reminders, weather tips and event suggestions. Participants rated nearby offers as least useful. Estimated weekly reduction per disabled non-critical category: nearby offers 14, loyalty reminders 9, weather tips 7, event suggestions 5. Reductions are independent and can stack.
body.zh: 虛構內部研究。每名活躍乘客每週平均：42個非關鍵提示及6個關鍵提示。關鍵提示定義為服務事故、安全相關車站通知及無障礙升降機故障。此三個關鍵類別必須時刻保持開啟。非關鍵類別為：附近優惠、會員提醒、天氣提示及活動建議。參加者認為附近優惠最無用。每停用一個非關鍵類別，估計每週減幅：附近優惠14、會員提醒9、天氣提示7、活動建議5。各項減幅獨立並可疊加。

body.en: Fictional internal design requirements. The team may disable at most two non-critical categories in this cycle. The hard budget is a maximum estimated weekly reduction of 20 non-critical alerts. A reduction of exactly 20 is allowed. Any combination exceeding 20 is rejected. Critical categories must never be disabled. Accessibility requirement: the accessibility lift outage alert must stay enabled and must not be grouped with any non-critical alert. The team prefers the combination with the largest estimated reduction that stays within budget.
body.zh: 虛構內部設計要求。本週期團隊最多可停用兩個非關鍵類別。硬性預算為每週非關鍵提示估計減幅上限20個。減幅剛好20個屬允許。任何超過20的組合均被否決。關鍵類別絕不可停用。無障礙要求：無障礙升降機故障提示必須保持開啟，且不得與任何非關鍵提示合併。團隊偏好在不超預算下估計減幅最大的組合。

body.en: Fictional usability sessions with 8 participants. Participants wanted fewer non-critical alerts but insisted critical alerts remain visible. Two participants missed a lift outage notice when it appeared inside a grouped non-critical digest. Participants did not object to disabling nearby offers. No participant asked to disable weather tips or event suggestions. The study did not test loyalty reminders separately. These findings are synthetic and are not official MTR policy.
body.zh: 虛構易用性測試，8名參加者。參加者希望減少非關鍵提示，但堅持關鍵提示須保持可見。兩名參加者在關鍵提示被放入非關鍵摘要群組時錯過了升降機故障通知。參加者不反對停用附近優惠。沒有參加者要求停用天氣提示或活動建議。研究未單獨測試會員提醒。此等發現屬模擬，並非港鐵官方政策。

expectedEvidence.en: Two participants missed a lift outage notice when grouped with a non-critical digest. Participants did not object to disabling nearby offers. Loyalty reminders were not separately tested, so that evidence is uncertain.

exemplar.en: Evidence: the synthetic study shows 42 non-critical alerts weekly. Critical categories are service disruption, safety-related station notice and accessibility lift outage, and all three must stay enabled. Two participants missed a lift outage notice when grouped with a non-critical digest, so the lift alert must not be grouped. Decision: disable nearby offers and event suggestions. Calculations: 14 plus 5 equals 19, within the hard budget of 20. Offers plus loyalty gives 23, which exceeds the budget. Offers plus weather gives 21, also rejected. Loyalty plus weather gives 16. Risk: loyalty reminders were not separately tested, so that evidence is uncertain. Next step: run a follow-up session on loyalty reminders and confirm the lift alert stays ungrouped.
exemplar.zh: 證據：模擬研究顯示每週42個非關鍵提示。關鍵類別為服務事故、安全相關車站通知及無障礙升降機故障，三者必須保持開啟。兩名參加者在升降機故障通知被併入非關鍵摘要時錯過該通知，故升降機提示不得合併。決策：停用附近優惠及活動建議。計算：14加5等於19，在硬性預算20之內。附近優惠加會員提醒得23，超出預算。附近優惠加天氣提示得21，亦被否決。會員提醒加天氣提示得16。風險：會員提醒未獲單獨測試，該證據存在不確定性。下一步：就會員提醒進行跟進測試，並確認升降機提示保持不合併。

title.en: HKTVmall delivery ETA assistant: unsupported guarantees
title.zh: HKTVmall 送貨預計時間助理：無依據保證

brief.en: You are an AI engineer in an independent learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall, not endorsed by it. The customer ETA assistant (bot build eta-bot-3.2) sometimes promises guaranteed delivery windows that no policy supports. Review the fictional policy extract, config log and test log. Answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, explaining the cause, the corrected configuration and a regression test plan. All policies, staff and records are invented for learning.
brief.zh: 你是一名 AI 工程師，參與一個受 HKTVmall 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非獲 HKTVmall 認可。客戶預計時間助理（機械人版本 eta-bot-3.2）有時承諾政策並不支持的保證送貨時段。請審閱虛構的政策摘錄、設定日誌及測試日誌。回答問題後，以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文，解釋成因、修正後的設定及回歸測試計劃。所有政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。

title.zh: 虛構預計時間用語政策摘錄

body.en: Fictional policy ETA-P7. The assistant may state an estimated window for any order status. The word guaranteed may appear only when status is out-for-delivery and the courier has scanned the parcel. For every other status, including unknown ETA, the assistant must say the window is an estimate and may change. Policy ETA-P7 applies to all channels. No policy allows a guaranteed window before courier scan.
body.zh: 虛構政策 ETA-P7。助理可為任何訂單狀態提供預計時段。只有在狀態為派送中且速遞員已掃描包裹時，才可使用「保證」一詞。其他所有狀態（包括預計時間未知）下，助理必須說明時段僅為估算，或會變動。政策 ETA-P7 適用於所有渠道。任何政策均不允許在速遞員掃描前提供保證時段。

body.en: Fictional config log for build eta-bot-3.2. Rule R1: if status is packed or in transit, reply with estimated window. Rule R2: if status is out-for-delivery and courier scan is true, reply with guaranteed window. Rule R3: if status is out-for-delivery and courier scan is false, reply with estimated window. Rule R4: for all other statuses, reply with guaranteed window. Rule R4 conflicts with policy ETA-P7. Rule R4 was added in build eta-bot-3.2. Build eta-bot-3.1 had no Rule R4.
body.zh: 虛構設定日誌，版本 eta-bot-3.2。規則 R1：若狀態為已包裝或運送中，回覆預計時段。規則 R2：若狀態為派送中且速遞員掃描為真，回覆保證時段。規則 R3：若狀態為派送中且速遞員掃描為假，回覆預計時段。規則 R4：其他所有狀態，回覆保證時段。規則 R4 與政策 ETA-P7 衝突。規則 R4 於版本 eta-bot-3.2 加入。版本 eta-bot-3.1 沒有規則 R4。

body.en: Fictional test log. Case T1 status packed, scan false: reply estimated window, pass. Case T2 status in transit, scan false: reply estimated window, pass. Case T3 status out-for-delivery, scan true: reply guaranteed window, pass. Case T4 status out-for-delivery, scan false: reply estimated window, pass. Case T5 status awaiting stock, scan false: reply guaranteed window, fail against policy ETA-P7. Case T6 status cancelled, scan false: reply guaranteed window, fail against policy ETA-P7. Cases T5 and T6 were not run on build eta-bot-3.1.
body.zh: 虛構測試日誌。個案 T1 狀態已包裝，掃描為假：回覆預計時段，通過。個案 T2 狀態運送中，掃描為假：回覆預計時段，通過。個案 T3 狀態派送中，掃描為真：回覆保證時段，通過。個案 T4 狀態派送中，掃描為假：回覆預計時段，通過。個案 T5 狀態待補貨，掃描為假：回覆保證時段，不符合政策 ETA-P7，失敗。個案 T6 狀態已取消，掃描為假：回覆保證時段，不符合政策 ETA-P7，失敗。個案 T5 及 T6 未在版本 eta-bot-3.1 上執行。

label.en: Which configuration rule causes the unsupported guarantees?
label.zh: 哪條設定規則導致無依據保證？

label.en: What should Rule R4 be changed to?
label.zh: 規則 R4 應改為甚麼？

label.en: Which test cases fail against policy ETA-P7? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些測試個案不符合政策 ETA-P7？選出所有適用者。

label.en: How many of the six test cases currently receive a guaranteed window reply?
label.zh: 六個測試個案中，目前有多少個收到保證時段回覆？

label.en: After the fix, how many of the six test cases should receive an estimated window reply?
label.zh: 修正後，六個測試個案中應有多少個收到預計時段回覆？

description.zh: 指出衝突規則並連結具體文件事實。

expectedEvidence.en: Rule R4 in build eta-bot-3.2 sends a guaranteed window for all other statuses, conflicting with policy ETA-P7. Acceptable alternatives: names Rule R4, cites config log and policy extract, notes Rule R4 absent in build eta-bot-3.1.
expectedEvidence.zh: 版本 eta-bot-3.2 的規則 R4 對其他所有狀態發出保證時段，與政策 ETA-P7 衝突。可接受替代：指出規則 R4、引用設定日誌及政策摘錄、說明版本 eta-bot-3.1 沒有規則 R4。

description.en: States the corrected Rule R4 and the policy condition it must satisfy.
description.zh: 說明修正後的規則 R4 及其須符合的政策條件。

expectedEvidence.en: Rule R4 should reply with estimated window for all other statuses, matching policy ETA-P7. Acceptable alternatives: states estimated window wording, notes guaranteed only after courier scan and out-for-delivery status.
expectedEvidence.zh: 規則 R4 應對其他所有狀態回覆預計時段，符合政策 ETA-P7。可接受替代：說明使用預計時段用語、指出只有派送中且速遞員掃描後才可保證。

description.en: Proposes rerunning the failing cases and checking the corrected rule.
description.zh: 建議重跑失敗個案並檢查修正規則。

expectedEvidence.en: Rerun cases T5 and T6 and confirm estimated window replies. Acceptable alternatives: rerun all six cases, add cases for other statuses, compare build eta-bot-3.1 and eta-bot-3.2 behaviour.
expectedEvidence.zh: 重跑個案 T5 及 T6，確認回覆預計時段。可接受替代：重跑全部六個個案、為其他狀態新增個案、比較版本 eta-bot-3.1 與 eta-bot-3.2 行為。

description.en: Acknowledges what the logs do not show and avoids overclaiming.
description.zh: 承認日誌未顯示的內容，避免過度斷言。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that logs are fictional and do not cover every status or channel. Acceptable alternatives: states T5 and T6 were not run on build eta-bot-3.1, flags missing statuses, avoids claiming the fix is proven until retested.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出日誌為虛構，未涵蓋所有狀態或渠道。可接受替代：說明 T5 及 T6 未在版本 eta-bot-3.1 上執行、指出缺少的狀態、避免在重測前聲稱修正已證實。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with evidence and next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰的約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若繁體中文交接，包含證據及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, names build eta-bot-3.2, Rule R4, policy ETA-P7, cases T5 and T6, and gives next steps. Acceptable alternatives: equivalent Traditional Chinese length, clear structure, source references.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若繁體中文，指出版本 eta-bot-3.2、規則 R4、政策 ETA-P7、個案 T5 及 T6，並提供下一步。可接受替代：相若繁體中文長度、清晰結構、文件引用。

exemplar.en: Cause: build eta-bot-3.2 added Rule R4, which replies with a guaranteed window for all other statuses. This conflicts with policy ETA-P7, which allows guaranteed wording only when status is out-for-delivery and the courier has scanned the parcel. Test cases T5 and T6 fail for this reason. Fix: change Rule R4 to reply with an estimated window for all other statuses, matching policy ETA-P7. Regression plan: rerun cases T5 and T6 and confirm estimated window replies, then rerun all six cases to check no earlier rule broke. After the fix, five of the six cases should receive an estimated window reply, since only case T3 keeps a guaranteed window. Note that the logs are fictional and do not cover every status or channel, so the fix is not proven until retested. Next step: update the config log and record the retest results.
exemplar.zh: 成因：版本 eta-bot-3.2 加入規則 R4，對其他所有狀態回覆保證時段。這與政策 ETA-P7 衝突，該政策只允許在狀態為派送中且速遞員已掃描包裹時使用保證用語。測試個案 T5 及 T6 因此失敗。修正：把規則 R4 改為對其他所有狀態回覆預計時段，符合政策 ETA-P7。回歸計劃：重跑個案 T5 及 T6，確認回覆預計時段，然後重跑全部六個個案，檢查沒有破壞先前規則。修正後，六個個案中應有五個收到預計時段回覆，因為只有個案 T3 保留保證時段。注意日誌為虛構，未涵蓋所有狀態或渠道，故修正須重測後方可證實。下一步：更新設定日誌並記錄重測結果。

feedback.en: You correctly name Rule R4 in build eta-bot-3.2 as the cause and tie it to policy ETA-P7, noting that guaranteed wording is only allowed when status is out-for-delivery and the courier has scanned the parcel. Cases T5 and T6 are properly linked to this conflict.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出成因是版本 eta-bot-3.2 的規則 R4，並連結政策 ETA-P7，說明只有狀態為派送中且速遞員已掃描包裹時才可使用保證用語。個案 T5 及 T6 亦正確連繫到此衝突。

feedback.en: Your corrected Rule R4 uses the estimated window for all other statuses, which satisfies policy ETA-P7. You also restate the guarantee condition clearly, so the fix is traceable to the policy.
feedback.zh: 你修正後的規則 R4 對其他所有狀態回覆預計時段，符合政策 ETA-P7。你亦清楚重述保證條件，使修正可追溯至政策。

feedback.en: Your plan reruns cases T5 and T6 then all six cases, which covers the failing cases and guards against regressions in earlier rules. The expected five estimated-window replies are stated accurately.
feedback.zh: 你的計劃先重跑個案 T5 及 T6，再重跑全部六個個案，既覆蓋失敗個案亦可防止先前規則出現回歸。你亦準確指出預期有五個預計時段回覆。

feedback.en: You note the logs are fictional and do not cover every status or channel, and you avoid claiming the fix is proven before retesting. This is an appropriate caveat.
feedback.zh: 你指出日誌為虛構且未涵蓋所有狀態或渠道，並避免在重測前聲稱修正已證實。此保留恰當。

feedback.en: Your handover is clear and well structured at 142 English words, within the 100 to 180 guidance, and it names build eta-bot-3.2, Rule R4, policy ETA-P7, cases T5 and T6 with next steps. Evidence and actions are easy to follow.
feedback.zh: 你的交接清晰且結構良好，共 142 個英文詞，符合 100 至 180 的指引，並指出版本 eta-bot-3.2、規則 R4、政策 ETA-P7、個案 T5 及 T6，以及下一步。證據與行動易於跟進。

summary.en: All five decision fields are correct and your written handover matches the evidence base: Rule R4 in build eta-bot-3.2 causes the unsupported guarantees, the fix is an estimated window for other statuses, and cases T5 and T6 must be rerun. The work is complete, accurate and appropriately caveated about fictional and partial logs.
summary.zh: 五個決策欄位全部正確，書面交接亦與證據基礎一致：版本 eta-bot-3.2 的規則 R4 導致無依據保證，修正為對其他狀態回覆預計時段，並須重跑個案 T5 及 T6。整體完整準確，且對日誌屬虛構及涵蓋有限作出恰當保留。

nextSteps.en: Update the config log to record the corrected Rule R4 and log the T5 and T6 retest results so the change is auditable. Consider adding coverage for any status or channel the current six cases miss.
nextSteps.zh: 更新設定日誌以記錄修正後的規則 R4，並記下 T5 及 T6 的重測結果，令變更可審核。可考慮為現有六個個案未涵蓋的狀態或渠道補充測試。

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent learning simulation, not endorsed, no current vacancy). A customer asks about cancelling a booked experience and what personal data is kept. Read the two fictional source documents. Answer the four questions, then write a handover of around 100 to 180 English words (or comparable Traditional Chinese) covering the case identifier, the confirmed condition, the refund decision, the data-minimisation point and the next step. All policies here are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（獨立學習模擬，未經認可，亦非現有職位空缺）。一名客戶查詢取消已預訂的體驗，並想了解會保留哪些個人資料。請閱讀兩份虛構文件，回答四條問題，然後撰寫約 100 至 180 個英文詞（或相若中文）的交接說明，涵蓋個案編號、已確認條件、退款決定、資料最小化要點及下一步。此處所有政策均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional policy for this demo only. Case KL-2041 is a standard flexible booking. The booking was confirmed 30 hours before the experience start time. The customer has not yet confirmed cancellation, and 20 hours remain until the start time. Under the fictional rule, a cancellation confirmed at least 24 hours before start time qualifies for a full refund of HKD 800. A cancellation confirmed less than 24 hours before start time qualifies for no refund. The 24-hour threshold is inclusive, so exactly 24 hours qualifies. No goodwill credit applies.
body.zh: 此政策僅為本示範而虛構。個案 KL-2041 屬標準彈性預訂。預訂於體驗開始時間前 30 小時確認。客戶尚未確認取消，距離開始時間尚餘 20 小時。根據虛構規則，在開始時間前至少 24 小時確認取消可獲全額退款 HKD 800；在開始時間前少於 24 小時確認取消則不獲退款。24 小時門檻為包含式，即剛好 24 小時亦符合。不適用任何善意補償。

body.en: Fictional note for this demo only. After a cancellation is confirmed, the booking record keeps only the case identifier, the refund amount and the cancellation timestamp. The customer's full name, email address and payment card details are deleted within 7 days of the confirmed cancellation. The customer's stated accessibility request is stored only while the booking is active and is deleted at the same time. Staff must not record any health details in the case log.
body.zh: 此備註僅為本示範而虛構。取消一經確認後，預訂紀錄只保留個案編號、退款金額及取消時間戳。客戶全名、電郵地址及付款卡資料會在取消確認後 7 天內刪除。客戶所述的無障礙需求只在預訂生效期間儲存，並於同一時間刪除。員工不得在個案紀錄中記下任何健康資料。

label.en: Case KL-2041 has 20 hours remaining until start time. If the customer confirms cancellation now, which refund outcome applies?
label.zh: 個案 KL-2041 距離開始時間尚餘 20 小時。若客戶現在確認取消，適用哪項退款結果？

label.en: A second fictional case KL-2042 had its cancellation confirmed exactly 24 hours before start time. Which statement is correct?
label.zh: 第二個虛構個案 KL-2042 的取消在開始時間前剛好 24 小時確認。哪項陳述正確？

label.en: It qualifies because the 24-hour threshold is inclusive
label.zh: 符合資格，因 24 小時門檻為包含式

label.en: It fails because the threshold is exclusive
label.zh: 不符合，因門檻為排除式

label.en: It needs manager approval before any refund
label.zh: 任何退款前須主管批准

label.en: After a cancellation is confirmed, which items remain in the booking record?
label.zh: 取消確認後，預訂紀錄會保留哪些項目？

label.en: Within how many days of a confirmed cancellation are the customer's full name, email address and payment card details deleted?
label.zh: 取消確認後多少天內會刪除客戶全名、電郵地址及付款卡資料？

about.en: Klook offers activity and travel experiences. Its public company page emphasises simplicity, authenticity and curiosity.
about.zh: Klook 提供活動及旅遊體驗，其公司公開頁面強調簡單、真實及好奇心。

simulationStyle.en: Simulate booking support with clear explanations, supplied cancellation rules and an escalation handover. The booking policies are fictional.
simulationStyle.zh: 按虛構預訂政策模擬客戶支援，提供清晰說明、取消規則判斷及轉交紀錄。

description.zh: 準確引述文件中的個案編號及已確認時間條件。

expectedEvidence.en: Case KL-2041, standard flexible booking, booking confirmed 30 hours before start time, 20 hours remaining until start time, cancellation not yet confirmed.
expectedEvidence.zh: 個案 KL-2041，標準彈性預訂，預訂於開始時間前 30 小時確認，距離開始時間尚餘 20 小時，取消尚未確認。

description.en: Applies the 24-hour inclusive threshold to reach a defensible refund outcome and shows the comparison.

expectedEvidence.zh: 尚餘 20 小時少於 24 小時，故客戶現在確認取消不獲退款。剛好 24 小時亦符合，因門檻為包含式。

description.en: Writes a concise handover of around 100 to 180 English words (or comparable Traditional Chinese) with a clear next step and no unsupported promises.
description.zh: 撰寫約 100 至 180 個英文詞（或相若中文）的簡潔交接，下一步清晰，且不作無依據承諾。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states case KL-2041, the 20-hour remaining condition, the no-refund outcome if cancellation is confirmed now, the 7-day deletion of name, email and card details, and the next step of obtaining the customer's cancellation confirmation.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明個案 KL-2041、尚餘 20 小時的條件、若現在確認取消則不獲退款、7 天內刪除姓名、電郵及卡資料，以及下一步為取得客戶取消確認。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes the cancellation is not yet confirmed so the refund is not yet triggered, and that no health details may be logged and no capability should be inferred from the accessibility request.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出取消尚未確認，故退款尚未觸發；不得記錄健康資料，亦不得從無障礙需求推斷能力。

exemplar.en: Case KL-2041 is a standard flexible booking confirmed 30 hours before the experience start time. The customer has not yet confirmed cancellation, and 20 hours remain until start time. Under the fictional policy, a cancellation confirmed at least 24 hours before start time qualifies for a full refund of HKD 800, and the 24-hour threshold is inclusive. Because only 20 hours remain, which is less than 24 hours, no refund applies if the customer confirms cancellation now. For data minimisation, the booking record keeps only the case identifier, the refund amount and the cancellation timestamp. The customer's full name, email address and payment card details are deleted within 7 days of the confirmed cancellation, and the accessibility request is deleted when the booking ends. No health details are recorded. Next step: obtain the customer's cancellation confirmation, then confirm the no-refund outcome and the deletion timeline.
exemplar.zh: 個案 KL-2041 屬標準彈性預訂，於體驗開始時間前 30 小時確認。客戶尚未確認取消，距離開始時間尚餘 20 小時。根據虛構政策，在開始時間前至少 24 小時確認取消可獲全額退款 HKD 800，而 24 小時門檻為包含式。由於尚餘僅 20 小時，少於 24 小時，若客戶現在確認取消則不獲退款。資料最小化方面，預訂紀錄只保留個案編號、退款金額及取消時間戳。客戶全名、電郵地址及付款卡資料會在取消確認後 7 天內刪除，無障礙需求則於預訂結束時刪除。不得記錄健康資料。下一步：取得客戶取消確認，然後確認不獲退款結果及刪除時間表。

title.en: Review a fictional Atlas API empty-input bug and propose a patch
title.zh: 審查虛構 Atlas API 空白輸入錯誤並提出修補

brief.en: You are a fictional teammate in an independent learning simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by it and not a job opening. A fictional internal service, Atlas API v2.3.1, returns HTTP 500 when a required text field is empty or whitespace only. Review the synthetic records, choose the most likely cause, propose a safe patch and tests, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Do not run code. All policies, logs, code and identifiers are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是獨立學習模擬中的虛構同事，靈感來自 Oursky，但並非其認可，亦非招聘職位。虛構內部服務 Atlas API v2.3.1 在必填文字欄位為空或只有空白時回傳 HTTP 500。請審閱合成紀錄，選出最可能成因，提出安全修補與測試，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、有證據支持的交接說明。請勿執行程式碼。所有政策、日誌、程式碼及識別碼均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional log, Atlas API v2.3.1. Request A: field name = "Ada", HTTP 200. Request B: field name = "", HTTP 500, error code VAL-EMPTY. Request C: field name absent, HTTP 400, error code VAL-MISSING. Request D: field name = "   ", HTTP 500, error code VAL-EMPTY. All four requests used the same endpoint and the same synthetic test account. No database write occurred in any request. The log shows no timeout and no authentication failure.
body.zh: 虛構日誌，Atlas API v2.3.1。請求 A：欄位 name = "Ada"，HTTP 200。請求 B：欄位 name = ""，HTTP 500，錯誤碼 VAL-EMPTY。請求 C：欄位 name 缺失，HTTP 400，錯誤碼 VAL-MISSING。請求 D：欄位 name = "   "，HTTP 500，錯誤碼 VAL-EMPTY。四個請求使用同一端點及同一合成測試帳戶。所有請求均無資料庫寫入。日誌顯示沒有逾時，亦沒有認證失敗。

title.en: Synthetic code review note with snippet
title.zh: 合成程式碼審查備註（含程式碼片段）

body.en: Fictional constraints. The patch must not change the response for a valid name. Regression tests must cover four cases: valid name, empty string, whitespace only, and absent field. The release budget is HKD 8000. Each regression test case costs HKD 1500. A code review costs HKD 2000 and is required once. The team can run at most six test cases in this release window. The patch must keep the existing VAL-MISSING behaviour for an absent field.
body.zh: 虛構限制。修補不得改變有效名稱的回應。回歸測試必須涵蓋四個情況：有效名稱、空字串、只有空白，以及欄位缺失。發佈預算為 8000 港元。每個回歸測試個案成本 1500 港元。程式碼審查成本 2000 港元，並須進行一次。團隊在此發佈窗口最多可執行六個測試個案。修補須為欄位缺失保留現有 VAL-MISSING 行為。

label.en: Which cause best matches the synthetic records?
label.zh: 哪個成因最符合合成紀錄？

label.en: The validator never checks for empty or whitespace-only values
label.zh: 驗證器從不檢查空值或只有空白

label.en: The synthetic test account fails authentication
label.zh: 合成測試帳戶認證失敗

label.en: The formatter times out on short input
label.zh: 格式化器在短輸入時逾時

label.en: A database write rejects the empty value
Which patch is the safest first fix?
label.zh: 哪個修補是最安全的首個修正？

label.en: Add an empty and whitespace check before formatName and return HTTP 400 with VAL-EMPTY
label.zh: 在 formatName 之前加入空值及空白檢查，並回傳 HTTP 400 及 VAL-EMPTY

label.en: Change the endpoint path for all clients
label.zh: 為所有客戶端更改端點路徑

label.en: How many regression test cases are required by the synthetic constraints?
label.zh: 合成限制要求多少個回歸測試個案？

label.en: What is the total cost in HKD of the required regression tests plus one code review?

Review the synthetic records, choose the safest fallback rule, answer the numeric questions, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese for the next reviewer. A target of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese is a helpful guide, not a strict graded limit. All records are fictional learning assumptions, not real company code or policy. This is an independent demo and not an endorsement or a current job opening.

body.en: Fictional record only. Flag atlas-banner-v3 has three stages: stage-a (internal testers, 20 users), stage-b (beta partners, 200 users), stage-c (public checkout, 5000 users). The flag service returns one of three states: on, off, unknown. The current fallback rule is: if state is unknown, treat as on. A teammate proposes changing it to: if state is unknown, treat as off. The service timeout is 300 milliseconds. A timeout produces state unknown. The banner is non-critical and must never block checkout.
body.zh: 僅為虛構紀錄。旗標 atlas-banner-v3 有三個階段：stage-a（內部測試者，20 位用戶）、stage-b（測試合作夥伴，200 位用戶）、stage-c（公開結帳，5000 位用戶）。旗標服務回傳三種狀態之一：on、off、unknown。現行回退規則為：若狀態為 unknown，視為 on。同事建議改為：若狀態為 unknown，視為 off。服務逾時為 300 毫秒。逾時會產生狀態 unknown。橫幅並非關鍵功能，且不得阻擋結帳。

body.en: Fictional record only. Incident log: on 2026-09-02, during stage-b, the flag service timed out 40 times in 1000 checkout requests. With the current rule, the banner rendered in all 40 cases and checkout still completed. A separate synthetic load test shows that rendering the banner adds 120 milliseconds per checkout request. The team budget for added banner render time is a hard maximum of 150 milliseconds per request. The proposed off rule was tested in stage-a only, with 20 requests and no timeouts. No test has covered stage-c.
body.zh: 僅為虛構紀錄。事故紀錄：2026-09-02 於 stage-b 期間，旗標服務在 1000 次結帳請求中逾時 40 次。按現行規則，橫幅在全部 40 次均有顯示，結帳仍能完成。另一項合成壓力測試顯示，顯示橫幅會為每次結帳請求增加 120 毫秒。團隊對新增橫幅顯示時間的預算為每次請求硬性上限 150 毫秒。建議的 off 規則僅在 stage-a 測試，共 20 次請求且無逾時。尚未有測試覆蓋 stage-c。

exemplar.en:
Handover for atlas-banner-v3. Evidence: the banner is non-critical and must never block checkout. A timeout produces unknown, and the current on rule rendered the banner in all 40 timeout cases during stage-b while checkout still completed. The code returns true for every state, so resolveBanner("off") and resolveBanner("unknown") both wrongly render the banner. Decision: change unknown to off. Corrected code:
```ts
export function resolveBanner(state: "on" | "off" | "unknown"): boolean {
  return state === "on"
}
```
This returns true only for on and false for off and unknown, so the banner never blocks checkout. The banner adds 120 milliseconds per request against a hard maximum of 150 milliseconds, leaving only 30 milliseconds of budget. Risks: the off rule was tested only in stage-a with 20 requests and no timeouts, and stage-c has no fallback test coverage. Next steps: test the chosen rule in stage-b and stage-c, confirm checkout is never blocked, and record timeout counts before wider rollout.
exemplar.zh:
atlas-banner-v3 交接紀錄。證據：橫幅並非關鍵且不得阻擋結帳。逾時會產生 unknown，而現行 on 規則在 stage-b 期間全部 40 次逾時個案均顯示橫幅，結帳仍完成。程式碼對每個狀態都回傳 true，因此 resolveBanner("off") 及 resolveBanner("unknown") 均錯誤顯示橫幅。決策：改為 unknown 視為 off。修正程式碼：
```ts
export function resolveBanner(state: "on" | "off" | "unknown"): boolean {
  return state === "on"
}
```
此版本僅對 on 回傳 true，對 off 及 unknown 回傳 false，因此橫幅不會阻擋結帳。橫幅每次請求增加 120 毫秒，而硬性上限為 150 毫秒，僅餘 30 毫秒預算。風險：off 規則僅在 stage-a 以 20 次請求及無逾時測試，且 stage-c 沒有回退測試覆蓋。下一步：在 stage-b 及 stage-c 測試所選規則，確認結帳從不被阻擋，並在擴大推行前記錄逾時次數。

brief.en: You are an independent demo participant, not a SHOPLINE employee, and this is not a job opening. A fictional merchant reports duplicate orders when the checkout button is tapped once but the network retries. Review the simulated frontend snippet, API contract and log extract. title.en: Silkscreen Legibility Review for a Fictional Sensor Board

brief.en: You are an independent PCB design reviewer in a fictional simulation, not an ASMPT employee and not endorsed by ASMPT. A fictional low-voltage sensor board package, revision S3, is supplied. Review it against the simulated silkscreen rules in the sources and hand over the issues for engineering review. Deliverables: answers to the questions plus a concise evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese. Do not certify any real board.
brief.zh: 你是虛構模擬中的獨立 PCB 設計審查員，並非 ASMPT 員工，亦不獲 ASMPT 認可。現提供虛構低電壓感測板文件，版本 S3。請按文件中的模擬絲印規則審查，並把問題交予工程審核。交付項目：問題答案，以及約 100 至 180 英文詞的簡潔證據交接說明，或相若中文。不得認證任何真實電路板。

title.en: Simulated Silkscreen Rules and Board Data
title.zh: 模擬絲印規則與電路板資料

body.en: Fictional rules for revision S3. Minimum silkscreen text height is 0.80 mm. Minimum stroke width is 0.12 mm. Text must sit at least 0.25 mm from any pad edge. Reference designators must be unique on the board. Board data: R1 height 0.75 mm, stroke 0.15 mm, pad clearance 0.40 mm. R2 height 0.90 mm, stroke 0.10 mm, pad clearance 0.30 mm. R3 height 0.85 mm, stroke 0.13 mm, pad clearance 0.20 mm. R4 height 0.80 mm, stroke 0.12 mm, pad clearance 0.25 mm. R5 repeats the designator R4. All values are simulated.
body.zh: 版本 S3 的虛構規則。絲印文字最小高度為 0.80 毫米。最小線寬為 0.12 毫米。文字須距任何焊盤邊緣至少 0.25 毫米。參考標號在板上必須唯一。電路板資料：R1 高度 0.75 毫米，線寬 0.15 毫米，焊盤間距 0.40 毫米。R2 高度 0.90 毫米，線寬 0.10 毫米，焊盤間距 0.30 毫米。R3 高度 0.85 毫米，線寬 0.13 毫米，焊盤間距 0.20 毫米。R4 高度 0.80 毫米，線寬 0.12 毫米，焊盤間距 0.25 毫米。R5 重複使用標號 R4。所有數值均為模擬。

title.en: Simulated Review Scope and Handover Requirements
title.zh: 模擬審查範圍與交接要求

body.en: This fictional review covers silkscreen legibility only. A rule is met when the measured value equals or exceeds the stated minimum. A rule is failed when the measured value is below the minimum. Pad clearance is measured from the text edge to the nearest pad edge. The handover must name each failed designator, state the failed rule, give the measured value, and state one corrective action. The handover must also state one uncertainty about the simulated data. No real fabrication, testing or certification is performed.
body.zh: 本虛構審查僅涵蓋絲印可讀性。當量測值等於或高於所述最小值，即符合規則。當量測值低於最小值，即不符合規則。焊盤間距由文字邊緣量至最近焊盤邊緣。交接須列出每個不合格標號、說明不合格規則、給出量測值，並提出一項修正行動。交接亦須說明一項關於模擬資料的不確定性。不進行任何真實製造、測試或認證。

body.en: This fictional clarification defines counting scope. A numeric failure is a designator whose measured height, stroke or clearance is below the stated minimum. A duplicate designator is a uniqueness violation, not a numeric failure. The count of designators failing at least one rule includes both numeric failures and designators involved in a uniqueness violation. Each designator is counted once even if it fails more than one rule. R4 itself meets all three numeric rules. R5 is a duplicate entry, not a separate designator.
body.zh: 本虛構澄清界定計數範圍。數值不合格指標號的量測高度、線寬或間距低於所述最小值。重複標號屬唯一性違規，並非數值不合格。至少違反一項規則的標號數目，包括數值不合格及涉及唯一性違規的標號。每個標號只計一次，即使違反多於一項規則。R4 本身符合三項數值規則。R5 屬重複項目，並非獨立標號。

label.en: How many designators fail at least one simulated silkscreen rule, counting both numeric failures and designators involved in a uniqueness violation?

expectedEvidence.en: R1 fails height (0.75 mm below 0.80 mm). R2 fails stroke (0.10 mm below 0.12 mm). R3 fails clearance (0.20 mm below 0.25 mm). R4 and R5 share the designator R4, breaking uniqueness. R4 itself meets all three numeric rules. Accept equivalent wording.

description.en: States the number of designators failing at least one simulated rule, counting both numeric failures and designators involved in a uniqueness violation, and shows how the count was reached.

expectedEvidence.en: Four designators fail at least one rule: R1, R2, R3 and R4. R1, R2 and R3 are numeric failures. R4 is counted once because it is involved in the uniqueness violation with R5. R5 is a duplicate entry, not a separate designator. Accept four with correct reasoning.
expectedEvidence.zh: 四個標號至少違反一項規則：R1、R2、R3 及 R4。R1、R2 及 R3 屬數值不合格。R4 因與 R5 涉及唯一性違規而計一次。R5 屬重複項目，並非獨立標號。接受數目四並附正確推理。

expectedEvidence.en: R1 raise text height to at least 0.80 mm. R2 widen stroke to at least 0.12 mm. R3 move text so clearance is at least 0.25 mm. Rename R5 to a unique designator. Accept equivalent actions.
expectedEvidence.zh: R1 把文字高度提高至至少 0.80 毫米。R2 把線寬加寬至至少 0.12 毫米。R3 移動文字使間距至少 0.25 毫米。把 R5 改為唯一標號。接受等同行動。

description.en: States one uncertainty about the simulated data and notes that this review does not certify a real board.

expectedEvidence.en: Any one reasonable uncertainty, for example whether the measured values reflect the final revision S3 artwork, or whether pad clearance was measured from the text edge. Also states no real fabrication or certification is performed.
expectedEvidence.zh: 任何一項合理不確定性，例如量測值是否反映最終版本 S3 圖稿，或焊盤間距是否由文字邊緣量起。亦指出不進行真實製造或認證。

description.en: Writes a clear evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, naming failures, measured values and next steps.

expectedEvidence.en: Handover within the suggested length, organised by designator, with measured values, corrective actions and a clear next step such as returning revision S3 for recheck. Accept comparable Chinese length.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接符合建議長度，按標號組織，含量測值、修正行動及清晰下一步，例如把版本 S3 退回重檢。接受相若中文長度。

exemplar.en: Review of fictional sensor board revision S3 against the simulated silkscreen rules found four designators failing at least one rule. R1 fails minimum text height, measuring 0.75 mm against the 0.80 mm minimum, so raise the text height to at least 0.80 mm. R2 fails minimum stroke width, measuring 0.10 mm against the 0.12 mm minimum, so widen the stroke to at least 0.12 mm. R3 fails pad clearance, measuring 0.20 mm against the 0.25 mm minimum, so move the text until clearance is at least 0.25 mm. R4 and R5 share the designator R4, breaking the uniqueness rule, so rename R5. R4 itself meets all three numeric rules and is counted once because of the uniqueness violation. R5 is a duplicate entry, not a separate designator. One uncertainty is whether the measured values reflect the final revision S3 artwork. This review does not certify a real board. Next step is to return revision S3 for recheck.
exemplar.zh: 按模擬絲印規則審查虛構感測板版本 S3，發現四個標號至少違反一項規則。R1 違反最小文字高度，量測值 0.75 毫米，低於 0.80 毫米下限，故把文字高度提高至至少 0.80 毫米。R2 違反最小線寬，量測值 0.10 毫米，低於 0.12 毫米下限，故把線寬加寬至至少 0.12 毫米。R3 違反焊盤間距，量測值 0.20 毫米，低於 0.25 毫米下限，故移動文字使間距至少 0.25 毫米。R4 與 R5 共用標號 R4，違反唯一性規則，故把 R5 改名。R4 本身符合三項數值規則，並因唯一性違規而計一次。R5 屬重複項目，並非獨立標號。一項不確定性是量測值是否反映最終版本 S3 圖稿。本審查不認證真實電路板。下一步是把版本 S3 退回重檢。

title.zh: 低電壓 PCB 間距審查交接

brief.en: You are a junior PCB designer at a fictional electronics firm. Review the fictional design package for board LV-204 against the simulated clearance rules in the sources. Identify which net pairs breach the rules, calculate the total clearance shortfall, and write a concise evidence-based handover for the engineering review. All company details, records and rules are fictional learning assumptions. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by ASMPT, and is not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你是虛構電子公司的初級 PCB 設計師。請按文件中的模擬間距規則，審查電路板 LV-204 的虛構設計文件。找出違反規則的網絡對，計算總間距不足量，並為工程審核撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。所有公司資料、記錄及規則均為虛構學習假設。此為獨立示範，未獲 ASMPT 認可，亦非招聘職位。

body.en: Fictional rules for board LV-204, a low-voltage control board. Rule R1: signal-to-signal clearance must be at least 0.20 mm. Rule R2: signal-to-power clearance must be at least 0.30 mm. Rule R3: power-to-power clearance must be at least 0.40 mm. A net pair breaches a rule only when its measured clearance is below the stated minimum. Measured clearances are recorded once per net pair. No other rules apply. All values are simulated.
body.zh: 電路板 LV-204 為低電壓控制板，以下為虛構規則。規則 R1：訊號對訊號間距最少 0.20 毫米。規則 R2：訊號對電源間距最少 0.30 毫米。規則 R3：電源對電源間距最少 0.40 毫米。只有量測間距低於所列最低值時，該網絡對才算違規。每個網絡對只記錄一次量測間距。不適用其他規則。所有數值均為模擬。

body.en: Fictional measured clearances for board LV-204. Net pair N1 to N2 is signal to signal, measured 0.16 mm. Net pair N3 to N4 is signal to power, measured 0.27 mm. Net pair N5 to N6 is power to power, measured 0.35 mm. Net pair N7 to N8 is signal to signal, measured 0.22 mm. Net pair N9 to N10 is signal to power, measured 0.31 mm. Each pair appears once. No other pairs were measured.
body.zh: 電路板 LV-204 的虛構量測間距。網絡對 N1 對 N2 為訊號對訊號，量測 0.16 毫米。網絡對 N3 對 N4 為訊號對電源，量測 0.27 毫米。網絡對 N5 對 N6 為電源對電源，量測 0.35 毫米。網絡對 N7 對 N8 為訊號對訊號，量測 0.22 毫米。網絡對 N9 對 N10 為訊號對電源，量測 0.31 毫米。每個網絡對只出現一次。沒有量測其他網絡對。

body.en: Fictional notes for the LV-204 review. The design package is complete and all five net pairs were measured. No net pair is exempt. A breach is confirmed only when the measured clearance is below the rule minimum. The total shortfall is the sum of each breaching pair's rule minimum minus its measured clearance. The review covers only these five pairs. The handover must state the breaching pairs, the total shortfall and one next step.
body.zh: LV-204 審查的虛構備註。設計文件完整，五個網絡對均已量測。沒有網絡對獲豁免。只有量測間距低於規則最低值時，才確認違規。總不足量為各違規網絡對的規則最低值減量測間距之總和。審查只涵蓋這五個網絡對。交接須列明違規網絡對、總不足量及一項下一步。

label.en: How many net pairs breach the simulated rules?
label.zh: 多少個網絡對違反模擬規則？

label.en: What is the total clearance shortfall in mm?
label.zh: 總間距不足量為多少毫米？

label.en: Which net pair has the largest single shortfall?
label.zh: 哪個網絡對的單一不足量最大？

label.en: Which next step best fits the simulated review notes?
label.zh: 哪項下一步最符合模擬審查備註？

label.en: Hand the breaching pairs and total shortfall to engineering review
label.zh: 把違規網絡對及總不足量交予工程審核

label.en: Ignore pairs that are only slightly below the minimum
label.zh: 忽略僅略低於最低值的網絡對

label.en: Remeasure all five pairs before any handover
label.zh: 交接前重新量測全部五個網絡對

label.en: Change the simulated rules to match the measured values
label.zh: 修改模擬規則以配合量測值

exemplar.en: Review of fictional board LV-204 against the simulated rules. Three net pairs breach. N1 to N2 is signal to signal at 0.16 mm against rule R1 minimum 0.20 mm, shortfall 0.04 mm. N3 to N4 is signal to power at 0.27 mm against rule R2 minimum 0.30 mm, shortfall 0.03 mm. N5 to N6 is power to power at 0.35 mm against rule R3 minimum 0.40 mm, shortfall 0.05 mm. N7 to N8 at 0.22 mm and N9 to N10 at 0.31 mm meet their rules. Total shortfall is 0.04 plus 0.03 plus 0.05, equal to 0.12 mm. All five pairs were measured and none is exempt, so the three breaches are confirmed. The review covers only these five pairs. Next step: hand the breaching pairs and total shortfall to engineering review. This is a fictional simulation and does not certify a real board.
exemplar.zh: 按模擬規則審查虛構電路板 LV-204。三個網絡對違規。N1 對 N2 為訊號對訊號，量測 0.16 毫米，低於規則 R1 最低值 0.20 毫米，不足 0.04 毫米。N3 對 N4 為訊號對電源，量測 0.27 毫米，低於規則 R2 最低值 0.30 毫米，不足 0.03 毫米。N5 對 N6 為電源對電源，量測 0.35 毫米，低於規則 R3 最低值 0.40 毫米，不足 0.05 毫米。N7 對 N8 量測 0.22 毫米及 N9 對 N10 量測 0.31 毫米符合所屬規則。總不足量為 0.04 加 0.03 加 0.05，等於 0.12 毫米。五個網絡對均已量測且無豁免，故三項違規已確認。審查只涵蓋這五個網絡對。下一步：把違規網絡對及總不足量交予工程審核。此為虛構模擬，不認證真實電路板。

feedback.en: You clearly name the three breaching pairs N1 to N2, N3 to N4 and N5 to N6 and tie each to its rule and measured value, such as 0.16 mm against R1 minimum 0.20 mm. You also correctly note that N7 to N8 and N9 to N10 meet their rules. Keep citing the specific source figures this way in future reviews.
feedback.zh: 你清楚列明三個違規網絡對 N1 對 N2、N3 對 N4 及 N5 對 N6，並把每對連繫到所屬規則及量測值，例如 0.16 毫米對 R1 最低值 0.20 毫米。你亦正確指出 N7 對 N8 及 N9 對 N10 符合規則。日後審查可繼續這樣引用具體文件數據。

feedback.en: Your arithmetic is fully correct, showing 0.04 mm, 0.03 mm and 0.05 mm then summing to 0.12 mm, and the selected total-shortfall answer of 0.12 matches. The method is transparent and easy to check.
feedback.zh: 你的運算完全正確，展示 0.04 毫米、0.03 毫米及 0.05 毫米並加總為 0.12 毫米，所選總不足量 0.12 亦一致。方法清晰易於覆核。

feedback.en: You state that all five pairs were measured and none is exempt, so the three breaches are confirmed, and you correctly limit the review to these five pairs. This is the right balance of confirmed scope and known limits. Adding a brief note that no other pairs were measured would strengthen it slightly.
feedback.zh: 你指出五個網絡對均已量測且無豁免，故三項違規已確認，並正確把審查限於這五個網絡對。這是已確認範圍與已知限制的良好平衡。若再補一句沒有量測其他網絡對會更完整。

feedback.en: Your handover is 159 English words, within the 100 to 180 guidance, and it names the breaching pairs, the 0.12 mm total shortfall and the next step of handing the findings to engineering review. The structure and sequence are practical for a review audience.
feedback.zh: 你的交接為 159 個英文詞，符合 100 至 180 的建議範圍，並列明違規網絡對、0.12 毫米總不足量及把結果交予工程審核的下一步。結構與次序對審核讀者實用。

feedback.en: You correctly state that this is a fictional simulation that does not certify a real board, keeping the work inside the simulated low-voltage records. No real lab or certification claims appear. Well bounded.
feedback.zh: 你正確說明此為虛構模擬，不認證真實電路板，把工作限於模擬低電壓記錄之內。文中沒有真實實驗或認證的聲稱。範圍界定良好。

summary.en: All four structured answers are correct, including the breach count of 3, the 0.12 mm total shortfall and N5 to N6 as the worst single shortfall. The written handover is evidence-based, complete and within the suggested length, and it flags the fictional scope appropriately. No material gap was found against the simulated rules and records.
summary.zh: 四個結構化答案全部正確，包括違規數目 3、總不足量 0.12 毫米，以及單一不足量最大的 N5 對 N6。書面交接以證據為本、內容完整且符合建議長度，並適當標明虛構範圍。對照模擬規則及記錄未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: You can now move to more complex reviews with multiple rule sets or conflicting measurements. Practise stating explicitly that no other pairs were measured, and consider adding a short risk line on what rework or remeasurement the breaches may trigger before engineering review.
nextSteps.zh: 你可轉向更複雜的審查，例如多套規則或量測結果有衝突的情況。可練習明確說明沒有量測其他網絡對，並考慮加一句簡短風險說明，指出違規在工程審核前可能引發的重工或重新量測。

title.en: Test-Point Traceability Review for a Fictional Sensor Board
title.zh: 虛構感測板測試點追溯審查

brief.en: You are an independent PCB design reviewer at a fictional Hong Kong electronics firm. A simulated low-voltage sensor board package, revision S3, must be checked against the fictional design rules in the sources before engineering review. All records are synthetic learning assumptions, not ASMPT policies or real designs. Identify which test points fail traceability, calculate the total cost of the fixes that resolve ALL mandatory failures, and write a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. Do not certify any real board.
brief.zh: 你是虛構香港電子公司的獨立 PCB 設計審查員。模擬低電壓感測板文件修訂版 S3 須按文件中的虛構設計規則檢查，然後交工程審核。所有記錄均為虛構學習假設，並非 ASMPT 政策或真實設計。找出哪些測試點不符追溯要求，計算能解決所有強制不符項的修正總成本，並撰寫約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若繁體中文、以證據為本的簡潔交接說明。不得認證任何真實電路板。

title.en: Fictional Design Rules and Test-Point Log
title.zh: 虛構設計規則與測試點記錄

body.en: Fictional rules for revision S3. Rule T1: every test point must link to a net name and a schematic sheet. Rule T2: every test point must have a unique identifier. Rule T3: a test point is traceable only when T1 and T2 both pass. Log: TP-01 links to net VCC-3V3 on sheet 2, identifier unique. TP-02 links to net SENS-A on sheet 4, identifier unique. TP-03 links to net GND on sheet 1, identifier duplicated with TP-07. TP-04 has no net name, identifier unique. TP-05 links to net SENS-B on sheet 5, identifier unique. TP-06 links to net GND on sheet 1, identifier unique. TP-07 links to net GND on sheet 1, identifier duplicated with TP-03.
body.zh: 修訂版 S3 的虛構規則。規則 T1：每個測試點須連繫網絡名稱及原理圖頁。規則 T2：每個測試點須有唯一識別碼。規則 T3：只有 T1 及 T2 同時通過，測試點才可追溯。記錄：TP-01 連繫第 2 頁網絡 VCC-3V3，識別碼唯一。TP-02 連繫第 4 頁網絡 SENS-A，識別碼唯一。TP-03 連繫第 1 頁網絡 GND，識別碼與 TP-07 重複。TP-04 無網絡名稱，識別碼唯一。TP-05 連繫第 5 頁網絡 SENS-B，識別碼唯一。TP-06 連繫第 1 頁網絡 GND，識別碼唯一。TP-07 連繫第 1 頁網絡 GND，識別碼與 TP-03 重複。

title.en: Fictional Rework Cost and Hard Budget
title.zh: 虛構返工成本與硬性預算

body.en: Fictional simulated costs per test point. Adding a missing net name costs 40 HKD. Making a duplicated identifier unique costs 25 HKD. Re-routing a trace costs 90 HKD. The hard budget for this review is 100 HKD and must not be exceeded. Only traceability fixes count toward the reduction target. Baseline rework estimate is 260 HKD. Estimated reduction equals baseline minus the cost of selected fixes. A fix is selected only if it removes a traceability failure. All mandatory traceability failures must be resolved before any reduction is counted.
body.zh: 虛構模擬成本，以每個測試點計。補回缺失網絡名稱成本 40 港元。把重複識別碼改為唯一成本 25 港元。重新佈線成本 90 港元。本次審查硬性預算為 100 港元，不得超出。只有追溯修正計入減省目標。基線返工估算為 260 港元。估計減省等於基線減去所選修正成本。只有能消除追溯失敗的修正才可選取。所有強制追溯不符項必須全部解決，方可計算任何減省。

body.en: Fictional handover requirements. The handover must state the failing test points, the rule each one breaks, the selected fixes and their total cost, the estimated reduction, and one uncertainty. The handover should be around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. Do not include any real ASMPT design data. State that this is a simulation and not an endorsement.
body.zh: 虛構交接要求。交接須列出不符要求的測試點、各自違反的規則、所選修正及總成本、估計減省，以及一項不確定性。交接宜約為 100 至 180 英文詞或相若繁體中文。不得包含任何真實 ASMPT 設計資料。須說明此為模擬，並非認可。

label.en: Which test points are traceable under rule T3?
label.zh: 按規則 T3，哪些測試點可追溯？

label.en: What is the total cost of the fixes needed to resolve ALL mandatory traceability failures within the hard budget?
label.zh: 在硬性預算內解決所有強制追溯不符項所需的修正總成本是多少？

label.en: What is the estimated reduction once all mandatory traceability failures are resolved within the hard budget?
label.zh: 在硬性預算內解決所有強制追溯不符項後的估計減省是多少？

description.en: Writes a clear evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with the required elements.

description.en: Identifies the traceable and failing test points with reference to rules T1, T2 and T3.

expectedEvidence.en: Traceable points are TP-01, TP-02, TP-05 and TP-06. Failing points are TP-03, TP-04 and TP-07. TP-03 and TP-07 break T2 through duplicated identifiers. TP-04 breaks T1 through a missing net name. Accept any answer that names these points and rules correctly.

description.en: Calculates the total fix cost for all mandatory failures and the resulting estimated reduction within the hard budget.
description.zh: 在硬性預算內計算所有強制不符項的修正總成本及相應估計減省。

expectedEvidence.en: All mandatory failures must be resolved before any reduction counts. Fixes needed are one missing net name at 40 HKD and one duplicated identifier at 25 HKD, total 65 HKD, within the 100 HKD hard budget. Estimated reduction is 260 minus 65 equals 195 HKD. Accept 65 and 195 with correct method shown.
expectedEvidence.zh: 所有強制不符項必須全部解決，方可計算任何減省。所需修正為一個缺失網絡名稱 40 港元及一個重複識別碼 25 港元，合共 65 港元，在 100 港元硬性預算內。估計減省為 260 減 65 等於 195 港元。正確展示方法並得出 65 及 195 均可接受。

description.en: States one clear uncertainty about the simulated records or assumptions.
description.zh: 就模擬記錄或假設說明一項明確不確定性。

expectedEvidence.en: Accept any one relevant uncertainty, such as whether TP-03 or TP-07 should keep the identifier, whether other sheets contain further duplicates, or whether the baseline estimate is complete.
expectedEvidence.zh: 任何一項相關不確定性均可接受，例如 TP-03 或 TP-07 應保留識別碼、其他頁是否另有重複，或基線估算是否完整。

description.en: Writes a clear evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with the required elements.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰、以證據為本、約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若繁體中文的交接，並包含所需元素。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states failing points, rules broken, selected fixes and total cost, estimated reduction, one uncertainty, and that this is a simulation not an endorsement. Around 100 to 180 English words is a helpful target, not a strict graded limit.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接列出不符點、違反規則、所選修正及總成本、估計減省、一項不確定性，並說明此為模擬而非認可。約 100 至 180 英文詞為有用目標，並非嚴格評分限制。

description.en: Keeps all statements within the fictional simulation and avoids claiming real certification.
description.zh: 所有陳述限於虛構模擬，不聲稱真實認證。

expectedEvidence.en: No claim of real board certification, no real ASMPT design data, and an explicit statement that this is a simulation and not an endorsement.
expectedEvidence.zh: 不聲稱真實電路板認證，不含真實 ASMPT 設計資料，並明確說明此為模擬而非認可。

exemplar.en: This simulation reviews fictional sensor board revision S3 against rules T1, T2 and T3. TP-01, TP-02, TP-05 and TP-06 are traceable because each links to a net name and a schematic sheet and has a unique identifier. TP-03 and TP-07 break T2 because their identifiers are duplicated with each other. TP-04 breaks T1 because it has no net name. All mandatory failures must be resolved before any reduction counts. The selected fixes are one missing net name at 40 HKD and one duplicated identifier at 25 HKD, total 65 HKD, which is within the 100 HKD hard budget. Estimated reduction is the 260 HKD baseline minus 65 HKD, which equals 195 HKD. One uncertainty is whether TP-03 or TP-07 should keep the identifier. This is a simulation and not an endorsement.
exemplar.zh: 本模擬按規則 T1、T2 及 T3 審查虛構感測板修訂版 S3。TP-01、TP-02、TP-05 及 TP-06 可追溯，因為每個測試點均連繫網絡名稱及原理圖頁，並有唯一識別碼。TP-03 及 TP-07 因彼此識別碼重複而違反 T2。TP-04 因無網絡名稱而違反 T1。所有強制不符項必須全部解決，方可計算任何減省。所選修正為一個缺失網絡名稱 40 港元及一個重複識別碼 25 港元，合共 65 港元，在 100 港元硬性預算內。估計減省為基線 260 港元減 65 港元，等於 195 港元。一項不確定性是 TP-03 或 TP-07 應保留識別碼。此為模擬，並非認可。

brief.en: You are a laboratory analyst at STC. A client has raised a paper chain-of-custody query on a synthetic water sample batch. Review the two fictional records and the fictional intake policy, then answer the questions and write a concise evidence-based handover for the team lead. Aim for around 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese. Completeness and clarity matter more than an exact count. Use only the supplied documents. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by STC, and no real testing is involved.
brief.zh: 你是STC的化驗分析員。客戶就一批合成水樣本的紙本監管鏈提出查詢。請檢視兩份虛構紀錄及虛構收樣政策，回答問題，並為團隊主管撰寫一份簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。目標約100至180英文字，或相應中文。完整與清晰比精確字數更重要。只可使用提供的文件。此為獨立示範，未獲STC認可，不涉及真實測試。

body.en: Synthetic record COC-2214. Batch W-88, three water samples. Sample W-88-01: collected 09:10, sealed 09:25, received 11:40, seal intact. Sample W-88-02: collected 09:20, sealed 09:35, received 11:40, seal intact. Sample W-88-03: collected 09:30, sealed 09:50, received 11:40, seal intact. All three logged as one batch. No temperature reading recorded for W-88-03.
body.zh: 合成紀錄 COC-2214。批次W-88，三個水樣本。樣本W-88-01：09:10採集，09:25封存，11:40接收，封條完整。樣本W-88-02：09:20採集，09:35封存，11:40接收，封條完整。樣本W-88-03：09:30採集，09:50封存，11:40接收，封條完整。三個樣本記錄為同一批次。W-88-03沒有記錄溫度讀數。

body.en: Synthetic policy. A batch is accepted only if every sample is sealed within 30 minutes of collection and received within 4 hours of collection. A missing temperature reading is a minor deviation. A minor deviation does not reject a batch but must be recorded in the handover. A batch with any seal not intact is rejected. Acceptance is confirmed only when all conditions are met.
body.zh: 合成政策。批次只會在每個樣本於採集後30分鐘內封存，並於採集後4小時內接收時獲接納。缺少溫度讀數屬輕微偏差。輕微偏差不會令批次被拒，但必須在交接說明中記錄。任何封條不完整的批次會被拒。只有全部條件符合時，才確認接納。

title.zh: 虛構客戶查詢備註 QN-14

body.en: Synthetic note. The client asks whether batch W-88 was accepted under IP-07 and whether any deviation was recorded. The client states the courier caused no delay and all samples arrived together at 11:40. The client needs a written handover naming the batch, the acceptance outcome and any deviation.
body.zh: 合成備註。客戶詢問批次W-88是否按IP-07獲接納，以及有否記錄任何偏差。客戶表示速遞公司沒有造成延誤，所有樣本於11:40一同送達。客戶需要一份書面交接，列明批次、接納結果及任何偏差。

label.en: Which sample, if any, breaches the 30-minute sealing rule?
label.zh: 哪個樣本（如有）違反30分鐘封存規則？

label.en: Which sample, if any, breaches the 4-hour receipt rule?
label.zh: 哪個樣本（如有）違反4小時接收規則？

label.en: How many minor deviations does batch W-88 have under IP-07?
label.zh: 按IP-07，批次W-88有多少項輕微偏差？

label.en: What is the acceptance outcome for batch W-88 under IP-07?
label.zh: 按IP-07，批次W-88的接納結果是甚麼？

label.en: Accepted, with one minor deviation recorded
label.zh: 接納，並記錄一項輕微偏差

label.en: Rejected because a seal was not intact
Rejected because a sample was received late
label.zh: 因樣本延遲接收而被拒

expectedEvidence.zh: 批次W-88獲接納並記錄一項輕微偏差，因所有封條完整、所有封存及接收時間符合IP-07，唯一問題是缺少溫度讀數。

description.en: Writes a clear, complete handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, naming the batch, outcome and deviation, and stating uncertainty.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰完整的交接，約100至180英文字或相應中文，列明批次、結果及偏差，並說明不確定性。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover names batch W-88, states accepted with one minor deviation, records the missing temperature reading for W-88-03, notes no courier delay, and flags that the missing reading is the only uncertainty. Length is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接列明批次W-88，說明獲接納並有一項輕微偏差，記錄W-88-03缺少溫度讀數，註明速遞沒有延誤，並指出缺少讀數是唯一不確定性。長度約100至180英文字或相應中文。

description.en: Separates confirmed facts from assumptions and avoids claiming real certification or testing.
description.zh: 區分已確認事實與假設，避免聲稱真實認證或測試。

expectedEvidence.en: States that all facts come from synthetic records, that no real testing or certification decision is made, and that the missing temperature reading is a recorded deviation rather than a rejection.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明所有事實來自合成紀錄，沒有作出真實測試或認證決定，缺少溫度讀數是已記錄偏差而非拒收理由。

exemplar.en: Handover for batch W-88. Records COC-2214 and policy IP-07 were reviewed. All three samples were sealed within 30 minutes of collection: W-88-01 at 15 minutes, W-88-02 at 15 minutes, W-88-03 at 20 minutes. All were received at 11:40, within 4 hours of collection. All seals were intact. One minor deviation is recorded: W-88-03 has no temperature reading. Under IP-07 this does not reject the batch. Outcome: batch W-88 is accepted with one minor deviation recorded. The client confirmed the courier caused no delay. Uncertainty: the missing temperature reading is the only open item and should be noted for the client. This is a synthetic review and no real testing or certification decision was made.
exemplar.zh: 批次W-88交接說明。已檢視紀錄COC-2214及政策IP-07。三個樣本均於採集後30分鐘內封存：W-88-01為15分鐘，W-88-02為15分鐘，W-88-03為20分鐘。全部於11:40接收，在採集後4小時內。所有封條完整。記錄一項輕微偏差：W-88-03沒有溫度讀數。按IP-07，此項不會令批次被拒。結果：批次W-88獲接納，並記錄一項輕微偏差。客戶確認速遞沒有造成延誤。不確定性：缺少溫度讀數是唯一未結項目，應向客戶註明。此為合成覆核，沒有作出真實測試或認證決定。

title.zh: Lalamove 虛構服務水平指標定義

brief.en: You are a business analyst in an independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove, not endorsed by it. A fictional merchant pilot, code MP-07, needs one service-level metric defined before a fictional review. Read the three synthetic documents. Choose the metric definition, answer the numeric questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. A helpful target is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. All figures are fictional learning assumptions, not real platform or driver performance.
brief.zh: 你是一名商業分析師，參與一個受 Lalamove 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非獲 Lalamove 認可。虛構商戶試點代號 MP-07 需要在虛構檢討前定義一項服務水平指標。閱讀三份合成文件，選出指標定義，回答數字題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接說明。建議目標約為 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文。所有數字均為虛構學習假設，並非真實平台或司機表現。

body.en: Fictional learning assumption. Pilot MP-07 covers 40 confirmed orders in one week. 32 orders arrived within the 30-minute target. 8 orders arrived after 30 minutes. Of those 8, 5 were caused by merchant packing delay and 3 by courier-caused delay. The merchant wants a metric that measures only courier-caused delay. Target: at least 90 percent of confirmed orders must arrive within 30 minutes. No order is counted twice.
body.zh: 虛構學習假設。試點 MP-07 於一週內涵蓋 40 張已確認訂單。32 張於 30 分鐘目標內送達，8 張超過 30 分鐘。該 8 張中，5 張由商戶包裝延誤造成，3 張由速遞員造成延誤。商戶希望指標只量度速遞員造成的延誤。目標：至少 90% 已確認訂單須於 30 分鐘內送達。每張訂單不重複計算。

body.en: Fictional learning assumption. Option A counts all 40 confirmed orders, so courier-caused delay still lowers the score. Option B counts only the 35 orders without merchant-caused delay, so courier-caused delay still lowers the score. Option C counts only the 37 orders without courier-caused delay, so merchant-caused delay still lowers the score. The merchant states the metric must exclude merchant-caused delay. The hard improvement budget is HKD 8,000. Option A costs HKD 4,000. Option B costs HKD 6,500. Option C costs HKD 9,200.
body.zh: 虛構學習假設。選項 A 計算全部 40 張已確認訂單，速遞員造成的延誤仍會拉低分數。選項 B 只計算 35 張沒有商戶造成延誤的訂單，速遞員造成的延誤仍會拉低分數。選項 C 只計算 37 張沒有速遞員造成延誤的訂單，商戶造成的延誤仍會拉低分數。商戶表明指標必須排除商戶造成的延誤。硬性改善預算為 8,000 港元。選項 A 成本 4,000 港元。選項 B 成本 6,500 港元。選項 C 成本 9,200 港元。

title.zh: 合成檢討限制與不確定性

body.en: Fictional learning assumption. The review covers one week only, so the sample is small. Delay causes were recorded by the merchant and were not independently verified. The 30-minute target is a single threshold with no tolerance band. The merchant confirms the metric must exclude merchant-caused delay and must stay within the HKD 8,000 hard budget. No contingency or approval is assumed.
body.zh: 虛構學習假設。檢討只涵蓋一週，樣本較小。延誤原因由商戶記錄，未經獨立核實。30 分鐘目標為單一門檻，沒有容差範圍。商戶確認指標必須排除商戶造成的延誤，並須在 8,000 港元硬性預算之內。不假設任何應急費用或審批。

label.en: Which metric definition meets the merchant requirement within the hard budget?
label.zh: 哪項指標定義符合商戶要求並在硬性預算之內？

label.en: Option A: count all 40 confirmed orders, cost HKD 4,000
label.zh: 選項 A：計算全部 40 張已確認訂單，成本 4,000 港元

label.en: Option B: count the 35 orders without merchant-caused delay, cost HKD 6,500
label.zh: 選項 B：計算 35 張沒有商戶造成延誤的訂單，成本 6,500 港元

label.en: Option C: count the 37 orders without courier-caused delay, cost HKD 9,200
label.zh: 選項 C：計算 37 張沒有速遞員造成延誤的訂單，成本 9,200 港元

label.en: No option meets both the merchant requirement and the hard budget
label.zh: 沒有選項同時符合商戶要求及硬性預算

label.en: Under the chosen metric, how many confirmed orders are counted?
label.zh: 在所選指標下，計算多少張已確認訂單？

label.en: Under the chosen metric, what is the on-time rate as a percentage, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 在所選指標下，準時率為百分之多少，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: After the chosen option, how much of the HKD 8,000 hard budget remains?
label.zh: 選用所選選項後，8,000 港元硬性預算尚餘多少？
