about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.
about.zh: Lalamove 介紹其為 2013 年於香港創立的即時配送平台，連結個人、企業及配送車輛。

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse a fictional merchant workflow, prioritise requirements and propose a measurable service improvement without making promises about actual driver or platform performance.
simulationStyle.zh: 分析虛構商戶流程，排列需求優先次序，並提出可量度的服務改善，不對真實司機或平台表現作出承諾。

description.en: Selects the metric that excludes merchant-caused delay and stays within the hard budget, citing source facts.
description.zh: 選出排除商戶造成延誤並在硬性預算之內的指標，並引用文件事實。

description.en: States the counted orders, on-time rate and remaining budget with correct arithmetic from the sources.
description.zh: 根據文件以正確運算列出計算訂單數、準時率及剩餘預算。

description.en: Identifies at least one limitation or uncertainty in the fictional pilot data and explains how it affects the metric.
description.zh: 指出虛構試點數據至少一項限制或不確定性，並解釋其如何影響指標。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, with decision, figures and next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文的清晰交接，包含決策、數字及下一步。

description.en: Uses only the supplied synthetic documents and labels figures as fictional learning assumptions.
description.zh: 只使用所提供的合成文件，並標明數字為虛構學習假設。

description.en: Selects the metric that excludes merchant-caused delay and stays within the hard budget, citing source facts.
description.zh: 選出排除商戶造成延誤並在硬性預算之內的指標，並引用文件事實。

expectedEvidence.en: Option B. It counts the 35 orders without merchant-caused delay and costs HKD 6,500, within the HKD 8,000 hard budget. Option A does not exclude merchant-caused delay. Option C excludes courier-caused delay instead and costs HKD 9,200, above budget. The none option is wrong because Option B satisfies both conditions.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選項 B。它計算 35 張沒有商戶造成延誤的訂單，成本 6,500 港元，在 8,000 港元硬性預算之內。選項 A 不排除商戶造成的延誤。選項 C 排除的是速遞員造成的延誤，且成本 9,200 港元，超出預算。全不符合選項錯誤，因選項 B 同時滿足兩項條件。

description.en: States the counted orders, on-time rate and remaining budget with correct arithmetic from the sources.
description.zh: 根據文件以正確運算列出計算訂單數、準時率及剩餘預算。

expectedEvidence.en: Counted orders 35. On-time rate 32 divided by 35 equals 0.914285, which rounds to 91.4 percent at one decimal place. Remaining budget 8,000 minus 6,500 equals HKD 1,500. Accept 91.4 percent. A learner who writes 91.42 percent without rounding has not followed the stated one-decimal instruction.
expectedEvidence.zh: 計算訂單 35 張。準時率為 32 除以 35，等於 0.914285，四捨五入至一位小數為 91.4%。剩餘預算 8,000 減 6,500，等於 1,500 港元。接受 91.4%。若學員寫 91.42% 而沒有按指示四捨五入至一位小數，則未符合要求。

description.en: Identifies at least one limitation or uncertainty in the fictional pilot data and explains how it affects the metric.
description.zh: 指出虛構試點數據至少一項限制或不確定性，並解釋其如何影響指標。

expectedEvidence.en: Any defensible limitation, for example one week and 40 orders is a small sample, the 30-minute target is a single threshold, or delay-cause classification was recorded by the merchant and not independently verified. Explains the effect on confidence in the metric.
expectedEvidence.zh: 任何合理限制，例如一週及 40 張訂單屬小樣本、30 分鐘目標為單一門檻，或延誤原因由商戶記錄且未經獨立核實。解釋其對指標可信度的影響。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, with decision, figures and next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文的清晰交接，包含決策、數字及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states Option B, 35 counted orders, 91.4 percent on-time rate, HKD 1,500 remaining, one limitation and a next step such as extending the pilot or confirming delay causes. Around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese length.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明選項 B、35 張計算訂單、91.4% 準時率、剩餘 1,500 港元、一項限制，以及下一步如延長試點或確認延誤原因。約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文長度。

description.en: Uses only the supplied synthetic documents and labels figures as fictional learning assumptions.
description.zh: 只使用所提供的合成文件，並標明數字為虛構學習假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Refers to MP-07, the 40 confirmed orders, the 30-minute target, the HKD 8,000 hard budget and the fictional status. Does not claim real Lalamove performance or endorsement.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提及 MP-07、40 張已確認訂單、30 分鐘目標、8,000 港元硬性預算及虛構性質。不聲稱真實 Lalamove 表現或認可。

exemplar.en: Decision: Option B is the only metric that excludes merchant-caused delay and fits the HKD 8,000 hard budget at HKD 6,500. Option A does not exclude merchant-caused delay. Option C excludes courier-caused delay instead and costs HKD 9,200, above budget. Calculations: 35 confirmed orders are counted, being 40 minus the 5 merchant-caused delays. The on-time rate is 32 divided by 35, which equals 0.914285 and rounds to 91.4 percent at one decimal place, above the 90 percent target. Remaining budget is 8,000 minus 6,500, equal to HKD 1,500. Limitation: one week and 40 orders is a small sample, so confidence is limited. Next step: extend the fictional pilot and confirm delay causes before any wider use. All figures are fictional learning assumptions.
exemplar.zh: 決策：選項 B 是唯一排除商戶造成延誤並符合 8,000 港元硬性預算的指標，成本 6,500 港元。選項 A 不排除商戶造成的延誤。選項 C 排除的是速遞員造成的延誤，且成本 9,200 港元，超出預算。計算：計算 35 張已確認訂單，即 40 減去 5 張商戶造成的延誤。準時率為 32 除以 35，等於 0.914285，四捨五入至一位小數為 91.4%，高於 90% 目標。剩餘預算為 8,000 減 6,500，等於 1,500 港元。限制：一週及 40 張訂單屬小樣本，可信度有限。下一步：延長虛構試點並確認延誤原因，之後才考慮擴大使用。所有數字均為虛構學習假設。

title.en: Pagination boundary review for a fictional product list
title.zh: 虛構產品清單的分頁邊界審查

brief.en: You are helping a fictional product team at Oursky review a small pagination change before release. Read the two fictional source documents. Identify the boundary defect in the code, choose the safest fix within the stated budget, and write a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese for the next teammate. Include the corrected code or exact replacement lines plus proposed test cases. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Oursky, not Oursky code, not an actual hiring exercise, and not endorsed by Oursky.
brief.zh: 你正協助 Oursky 一個虛構產品團隊，在發佈前審查一項小型分頁改動。請閱讀兩份虛構文件，找出程式碼中的邊界缺陷，在既定預算內選擇最安全的修正，並為下一位同事撰寫約 100 至 180 英文字或相若中文、有證據支持的簡潔交接說明。內容須包括修正後程式碼或確切替換行，以及建議測試個案。此為受 Oursky 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非 Oursky 程式碼、真實招聘測試或獲 Oursky 認可。

title.en: Fictional source code, contract and test log
title.zh: 虛構程式碼、合約及測試記錄

body.en: Fictional fix budget is 6 hours. Option A rewrites the boundary condition and adds one boundary test, estimated 5 hours. Option B adds only a boundary test without changing code, estimated 2 hours. Option C rewrites the boundary condition without tests, estimated 3 hours. Option D adds logging only, estimated 1 hour. The team requires a code fix plus at least one boundary test before release. Boundary tests must cover the last full page and the first partial page.
body.zh: 虛構修正預算為 6 小時。選項 A 重寫邊界條件並加入一項邊界測試，估計 5 小時。選項 B 只加入邊界測試而不改程式，估計 2 小時。選項 C 重寫邊界條件但不加測試，估計 3 小時。選項 D 只加記錄，估計 1 小時。團隊要求發佈前必須有程式修正及至少一項邊界測試。邊界測試須覆蓋最後一個完整頁及首個不完整頁。

label.zh: CR-204 含有哪項邊界缺陷？

label.zh: 上界使用小於或等於，因此下一頁首個項目被包含

label.zh: 選項 A，重寫邊界條件並加入一項邊界測試

label.en: Option B, add only a boundary test
label.zh: 選項 B，只加入一項邊界測試

label.en: Option C, rewrite the boundary condition without tests
label.zh: 選項 C，重寫邊界條件但不加測試

第 3 頁，最後一個完整頁

description.en: Names the specific boundary defect in CR-204 and links it to the stated condition.

expectedEvidence.en: The upper bound uses less than or equal to, so the first item of the next page is included. Accept references to the condition i > page * size && i <= (page + 1) * size.

expectedEvidence.en: Option A at 5 hours, because it includes both a code fix and a boundary test as required. Option B lacks a code fix. Option C lacks tests. Option D lacks both.

brief.en: You support a fictional SHOPLINE merchant integration team. A simulated admin console sends profile updates to a simulated customer API. Review the source documents, decide the outcome for each logged request, and propose a concrete patch spanning client behaviour and server validation plus test cases. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. All records, tools and policies are fictional learning assumptions. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE, not endorsed by it, and not a current job opening.
brief.zh: 你支援一個虛構的 SHOPLINE 商戶整合團隊。一個模擬管理主控台向模擬客戶 API 發出檔案更新。請閱讀來源文件，決定每個已記錄請求的結果，並提出涵蓋客戶端行為與伺服器驗證的具體修正及測試個案。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文長度。此處所有記錄、工具及政策均為虛構學習假設。此為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦非現時職位空缺。

Request R-103: caller A-2003, record C-5503, role none, key K-3. Request R-104: caller A-2001, record C-5501, role owner, key K-1, a retry of the same physical request as R-101. Tests include a retry with the same key expecting one accepted write, and a new physical request with a new key expecting a separate accepted write.

exemplar.en: Handover for the customer record ownership review. R-101 is accepted with code 200 because caller A-2001 matches owner A-2001 for record C-5501. R-102 is held with code 409 because A-2002 holds editor but not owner. R-103 is rejected with code 403 because A-2003 holds no role. R-104 is accepted with code 200 because A-2001 matches owner A-2001 for C-5501, and it reuses key K-1, so it is a retry of the same physical request as R-101 rather than a second distinct write. The client defect is generating a fresh key on retry. The patch keeps key in scope and calls updateProfile(recordId, body, key) again. Tests: retry with the same key expects one accepted write, and a new physical request with a new key expects a separate accepted write. The cycle has four logged requests, so accepted is 2 and not accepted is 2. The sources do not state what happens after a 409 hold, so I have not assumed an approval step. Next step is to confirm the hold process with the team lead.
exemplar.zh: 客戶記錄擁有權檢視交接說明。R-101 被接受並回傳代碼 200，因呼叫者 A-2001 與記錄 C-5501 的擁有者 A-2001 相符。R-102 保留待審並回傳代碼 409，因 A-2002 持有編輯者但非擁有者。R-103 被拒絕並回傳代碼 403，因 A-2003 不持有任何角色。R-104 被接受並回傳代碼 200，因 A-2001 與 C-5501 的擁有者 A-2001 相符，且重用鍵 K-1，故屬與 R-101 同一實際請求的重試，而非第二次獨立寫入。客戶端缺陷是在重試時產生新鍵。修正把 key 保留在作用域並再次呼叫 updateProfile(recordId, body, key)。測試：以同一鍵重試預期只有一次接受寫入，以新鍵發出新實際請求預期另一次接受寫入。週期有四個已記錄請求，故接受為 2，不被接受為 2。來源文件未說明 409 保留待審之後的處理，因此我沒有假設批准步驟。下一步是與團隊主管確認保留待審流程。

title.zh: 個人資料記錄修正審查

brief.en: You are helping a fictional Oursky product team review a small logging change before release. All documents are synthetic learning material, not Oursky code or policy. Read the change note, the logging rule, the code contract and the test log. Answer the questions, then write a handover of about 100 to 180 English words (or comparable Traditional Chinese) covering evidence, decisions, risks and next steps. Do not run any code.
brief.zh: 你正協助一個虛構的 Oursky 產品團隊，在發布前審查一項小型記錄改動。所有文件均為虛構學習材料，並非 Oursky 程式碼或政策。請閱讀改動說明、記錄規則、程式碼合約及測試日誌，回答問題，然後撰寫約 100 至 180 英文字（或相若繁體中文）的交接紀錄，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。請勿執行任何程式碼。

body.en: Fictional change CN-14 adds a debug log line to the checkout service. The line writes the full customer email address at INFO level. The team rule says personal data must not appear in INFO logs. CN-14 is the only change in release R-7. The service version is 2.4.0. The change author is fictional. No customer data was used in testing.
body.zh: 虛構改動 CN-14 為結帳服務新增一行除錯記錄，在 INFO 級別寫入完整客戶電郵地址。團隊規則訂明個人資料不得出現在 INFO 記錄中。CN-14 是版本 R-7 中唯一改動。服務版本為 2.4.0。改動作者為虛構人物。測試中沒有使用客戶資料。

body.en: Fictional rule LR-3: INFO logs may contain event names, counts and durations. Personal data such as email addresses must be masked before logging. Masking means replacing the local part with three asterisks, for example ***@example.com. Masked values may be logged at INFO. Unmasked personal data may only be logged at DEBUG, and DEBUG logging is disabled in release builds.
body.zh: 虛構規則 LR-3：INFO 記錄可包含事件名稱、數量及時長。電郵地址等個人資料必須先遮蔽才可記錄。遮蔽指把本地部分替換為三個星號，例如 ***@example.com。已遮蔽的值可在 INFO 級別記錄。未遮蔽的個人資料只可在 DEBUG 級別記錄，而發布版本已停用 DEBUG 記錄。

body.en:
Fictional checkout logging code for CN-14. Contract: logCheckout(email) returns the string written to the INFO log. Input is the customer email as a string. Output must be a masked email such as ***@example.com. The current code below writes the raw email.

```ts
export function logCheckout(email: string): string {
  const line = `checkout email=${email}`
  return line
}
```

Test observations from TL-9: logCheckout("alice@example.com") returned "checkout email=alice@example.com". logCheckout("bob@example.com") returned "checkout email=bob@example.com". logCheckout("") returned "checkout email=". No masking was applied in any test.
body.zh:
虛構結帳記錄程式碼，對應 CN-14。合約：logCheckout(email) 回傳寫入 INFO 記錄的字串。輸入為客戶電郵字串。輸出必須為已遮蔽電郵，例如 ***@example.com。以下現行程式碼寫入原始電郵。

```ts
export function logCheckout(email: string): string {
  const line = `checkout email=${email}`
  return line
}
```

測試日誌 TL-9 觀察：logCheckout("alice@example.com") 回傳 "checkout email=alice@example.com"。logCheckout("bob@example.com") 回傳 "checkout email=bob@example.com"。logCheckout("") 回傳 "checkout email="。所有測試均無套用遮蔽。

body.en: Fictional test log TL-9 for CN-14. Test A: checkout with email alice@example.com, INFO line shows alice@example.com. Test B: checkout with email bob@example.com, INFO line shows bob@example.com. Test C: checkout with empty email, INFO line shows empty value. No masking was applied in any test. All three tests passed the build.
body.zh: 虛構測試日誌 TL-9 對應 CN-14。測試 A：以電郵 alice@example.com 結帳，INFO 行顯示 alice@example.com。測試 B：以電郵 bob@example.com 結帳，INFO 行顯示 bob@example.com。測試 C：以空電郵結帳，INFO 行顯示空值。所有測試均無套用遮蔽。三項測試均通過建置。

label.zh: 哪一項陳述符合規則 LR-3？

expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 CN-14 在 INFO 寫入完整電郵、LR-3 要求遮蔽、logCheckout 程式碼回傳原始電郵，以及 TL-9 顯示 alice@example.com 及 bob@example.com 未遮蔽。

description.en: States the rule breach count and release scope correctly and links the chosen fix to the rule.
description.zh: 正確指出違規數目及發布範圍，並把所選修正連結至規則。

expectedEvidence.en: Two of three tests breach LR-3, R-7 has one change, and the fix masks the email before the INFO line.
expectedEvidence.zh: 三項測試中兩項違反 LR-3，R-7 有一項改動，修正為在 INFO 行前遮蔽電郵。

description.en: Names a concrete residual risk or unknown and says how to check it.
description.zh: 指出具體餘下風險或未知事項，並說明如何檢查。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that TL-9 Test C only covers the current unmasked empty-email path, so the corrected masking behaviour for empty email is untested, and proposes a targeted test. Other personal-data fields are also untested.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 TL-9 測試 C 只涵蓋現時未遮蔽的空電郵路徑，修正後空電郵的遮蔽行為未經測試，並提出針對性測試。其他個人資料欄位亦未經測試。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese with evidence, decisions, risks and next steps.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接紀錄，約 100 至 180 英文字或相若繁體中文，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is complete and clear, structured under the four starter headings, and readable by a teammate.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接紀錄完整清晰，按四個起始標題分段，同事可讀。

description.en: Keeps the review to paper analysis and does not claim to run code or use real customer data.
description.zh: 審查限於紙本分析，不聲稱執行程式碼或使用真實客戶資料。

expectedEvidence.en: States no code was executed and all data is fictional, consistent with the brief.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明沒有執行程式碼，所有資料均為虛構，與簡介一致。

title.en: Synthetic QC Trend Review for Fictional Batch B-204
title.zh: 虛構批次 B-204 的合成品質控制趨勢檢視

brief.en: STC is an independent not-for-profit testing organisation. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by STC, not endorsed by it, and not a current job opening. You are a fictional laboratory analyst reviewing synthetic paper records only. No chemicals, organisms or real certification decisions are involved. Review the fictional batch records and QC trend note. Identify the most likely cause of the out-of-trend day 14 results, state the corrected review setting, count samples below the acceptance criterion, and write a concise evidence-based handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. All internal policies, records, results, personnel and practices are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: STC 是獨立非牟利測試機構。此為受 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦非現時職位空缺。你是虛構化驗分析員，只檢視合成紙本紀錄，不涉及化學品、生物或真實認證決策。請檢視虛構批次紀錄及品質控制趨勢備註，找出最可能導致第 14 天趨勢異常結果的原因，指出修正檢視設定，計算低於接受標準的樣本數目，並撰寫約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文、以證據為本的簡潔交接說明。所有內部政策、紀錄、結果、人員及做法均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional batch B-204 has 12 synthetic samples. S-01 to S-04 were stored at 4C. S-05 to S-08 were stored at 25C. S-09 to S-12 were stored at 40C. All samples were tested on day 0 and day 14. The fictional acceptance criterion is a result from 90 to 110 inclusive. Day 0 results for all 12 samples were 96 to 104. Day 14 results: S-01 97, S-02 99, S-03 101, S-04 103, S-05 88, S-06 89, S-07 91, S-08 92, S-09 70, S-10 73, S-11 76, S-12 78. No sample was missing. No retest was recorded.
body.zh: 虛構批次 B-204 有 12 個合成樣本。S-01 至 S-04 儲存於 4C。S-05 至 S-08 儲存於 25C。S-09 至 S-12 儲存於 40C。所有樣本於第 0 天及第 14 天測試。虛構接受標準為結果介乎 90 至 110（含首尾）。全部 12 個樣本第 0 天結果為 96 至 104。第 14 天結果：S-01 97、S-02 99、S-03 101、S-04 103、S-05 88、S-06 89、S-07 91、S-08 92、S-09 70、S-10 73、S-11 76、S-12 78。沒有樣本缺失。沒有重測紀錄。

title.zh: 虛構品質控制趨勢檢視備註

body.en: Fictional review note for batch B-204. The trend review compares day 14 results against day 0 results. A drop of more than 10 units from day 0 to day 14 is flagged as out-of-trend. The note states that storage temperature is the only recorded variable changed between groups. The note also states that the current review setting for flagging is a drop of more than 10 units. A proposed corrected review setting is a drop of more than 5 units. The note does not contain any solved learner response.
body.zh: 批次 B-204 的虛構檢視備註。趨勢檢視比較第 14 天與第 0 天結果。由第 0 天至第 14 天下降超過 10 個單位即標示為趨勢異常。備註指出儲存溫度是組別之間唯一有紀錄的變動變數。備註亦指出目前標示的檢視設定為下降超過 10 個單位。建議修正檢視設定為下降超過 5 個單位。備註不包含任何已解答的學員回應。

body.en: Fictional handover requirements for this simulation. The handover is a required deliverable of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. It must state the most likely cause of the out-of-trend result, cite at least two specific sample identifiers or result values from the sources, state the proposed corrected review setting, and note one uncertainty. No real certification decision is made.
body.zh: 此模擬的虛構交接要求。交接說明為必要交付項目，約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文。必須指出趨勢異常結果的最可能原因，引用至少兩個具體樣本識別碼或結果數值，指出建議修正檢視設定，並註明一項不確定性。不作出真實認證決策。

label.en: Which factor is the most likely cause of the out-of-trend day 14 results?
label.zh: 哪項因素最可能導致第 14 天趨勢異常結果？

label.en: What is the proposed corrected review setting for flagging a drop?
label.zh: 建議修正的下降標示檢視設定是甚麼？

label.en: A drop of more than 5 units
A drop of more than 10 units
A drop of more than 15 units
A drop of more than 20 units
How many samples had a day 14 result below the fictional acceptance criterion of 90?

label.en: Which two sample groups best support the storage temperature explanation?
label.zh: 哪兩個樣本組最能支持儲存溫度的解釋？

description.en: Identifies the most likely cause of the out-of-trend result using source facts.
description.zh: 運用文件事實指出趨勢異常結果的最可能原因。

expectedEvidence.en: Storage temperature is the only recorded variable changed between groups. Day 14 results fall as storage temperature rises: S-01 to S-04 at 4C remain 97 to 103, S-05 to S-08 at 25C fall to 88 to 92, S-09 to S-12 at 40C fall to 70 to 78.
expectedEvidence.zh: 儲存溫度是組別之間唯一有紀錄的變動變數。第 14 天結果隨儲存溫度上升而下降：S-01 至 S-04 於 4C 維持 97 至 103，S-05 至 S-08 於 25C 降至 88 至 92，S-09 至 S-12 於 40C 降至 70 至 78。

description.en: States the proposed corrected review setting for flagging a drop.
description.zh: 指出建議修正的下降標示檢視設定。

expectedEvidence.en: The proposed corrected review setting is a drop of more than 5 units, replacing the current setting of a drop of more than 10 units.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議修正檢視設定為下降超過 5 個單位，取代目前下降超過 10 個單位的設定。

description.en: Cites specific sample identifiers or result values and shows a correct count.
description.zh: 引用具體樣本識別碼或結果數值，並展示正確計數。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites at least two specific sample identifiers or result values, for example S-09 or 70. Correctly counts 6 samples below 90 at day 14: S-05 88, S-06 89, S-09 70, S-10 73, S-11 76, S-12 78. Note S-07 91 and S-08 92 are at or above 90.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用至少兩個具體樣本識別碼或結果數值，例如 S-09 或 70。正確計算第 14 天有 6 個樣本低於 90：S-05 88、S-06 89、S-09 70、S-10 73、S-11 76、S-12 78。注意 S-07 91 及 S-08 92 為 90 或以上。

description.en: Notes at least one uncertainty about the synthetic records.
description.zh: 註明至少一項關於合成紀錄的不確定性。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes an uncertainty such as no retest was recorded, only storage temperature was recorded as a changed variable, or the records are synthetic and no real certification decision is made.
expectedEvidence.zh: 註明一項不確定性，例如沒有重測紀錄、只有儲存溫度記錄為變動變數，或紀錄屬合成且不作出真實認證決策。

description.en: Writes a clear handover of around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
description.zh: 撰寫清晰交接說明，約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, states the cause, cites evidence, states the corrected setting, and notes one uncertainty.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文，指出原因、引用證據、指出修正設定，並註明一項不確定性。

exemplar.en: This fictional review covers batch B-204. Day 0 results for all 12 samples were 96 to 104. Day 14 results for S-01 to S-04 at 4C stayed at 97 to 103. S-05 to S-08 at 25C fell to 88 to 92. S-09 to S-12 at 40C fell to 70 to 78. Storage temperature is the only recorded variable changed between groups, so it is the most likely cause of the out-of-trend result. Six samples fell below the fictional acceptance criterion of 90 at day 14: S-05 88, S-06 89, S-09 70, S-10 73, S-11 76, S-12 78. S-07 91 and S-08 92 are at or above 90. The proposed corrected review setting is a drop of more than 5 units, replacing the current drop of more than 10 units. One uncertainty is that no retest was recorded, so the trend cannot be confirmed by repeat testing. No real certification decision is made.
exemplar.zh: 此虛構檢視涵蓋批次 B-204。全部 12 個樣本第 0 天結果為 96 至 104。S-01 至 S-04 於 4C 的第 14 天結果維持 97 至 103。S-05 至 S-08 於 25C 降至 88 至 92。S-09 至 S-12 於 40C 降至 70 至 78。儲存溫度是組別之間唯一有紀錄的變動變數，因此最可能是趨勢異常結果的原因。第 14 天有 6 個樣本低於虛構接受標準 90：S-05 88、S-06 89、S-09 70、S-10 73、S-11 76、S-12 78。S-07 91 及 S-08 92 為 90 或以上。建議修正檢視設定為下降超過 5 個單位，取代目前下降超過 10 個單位。一項不確定性是沒有重測紀錄，因此無法以重複測試確認趨勢。不作出真實認證決策。

title.en: Merchant Support Escalation Review for a Fictional Delivery Pilot
title.zh: 虛構配送試點商戶支援升級檢視

brief.en: You are an independent business analyst reviewing a fictional merchant support escalation pilot for a Hong Kong delivery platform. All documents are synthetic learning assumptions, not actual company policy. Read the three sources, answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of around 100 to 180 words. Recommend the escalation rule set that gives the largest estimated monthly reduction in late merchant replies within the hard monthly coaching budget of HKD 6,000. State the rule, the calculation method, one uncertainty and one next step.
brief.zh: 你是獨立商業分析師，正檢視香港一個配送平台的虛構商戶支援升級試點。所有文件均為虛構學習假設，並非真實公司政策。請閱讀三份文件，回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔證據交接。請建議在每月硬性培訓預算6,000港元內，能帶來最大預計每月減少商戶延遲回覆的升級規則組合。說明規則、計算方法、一項不確定因素及一項下一步。

managerRole.zh: 商戶營運團隊主管（虛構）

body.en: This is a fictional pilot, not actual Lalamove policy. Pilot code MEP-07 covers 400 merchants. Rule A sends a reminder after 4 hours and costs HKD 2,000 per month. Rule B sends a reminder after 8 hours and costs HKD 1,500 per month. Rule C adds a phone call after 24 hours and costs HKD 4,500 per month. Rules may be combined. The hard monthly coaching budget is HKD 6,000 and cannot be exceeded. Estimated monthly late merchant replies are 120 in total. Rule A is estimated to reduce late replies by 30 percent. Rule B by 20 percent. Rule C by 40 percent. Each rule applies only to the late replies in its own segment, and combined reductions add together.
body.zh: 此為虛構試點，並非 Lalamove 實際政策。試點代號 MEP-07 涵蓋400間商戶。規則A於4小時後發提醒，每月成本2,000港元。規則B於8小時後發提醒，每月成本1,500港元。規則C於24小時後加設電話聯絡，每月成本4,500港元。規則可組合使用。每月硬性培訓預算為6,000港元，不可超支。預計每月商戶延遲回覆總數為120宗。規則A預計減少延遲回覆30%。規則B減少20%。規則C減少40%。每項規則只適用於所屬分群的延遲回覆，組合減幅相加。

body.en: This is a fictional learning assumption. Segment X has 150 merchants and 70 late replies per month. Segment Y has 250 merchants and 50 late replies per month. Rule A applies only to Segment X. Rule B applies only to Segment Y. Rule C applies to both segments. A rule applies to all merchants in its segment. No other constraints apply. The pilot runs for one month. No contingency or approval cost is added.
body.zh: 此為虛構學習假設。分群X有150間商戶，每月70宗延遲回覆。分群Y有250間商戶，每月50宗延遲回覆。規則A只適用於分群X。規則B只適用於分群Y。規則C適用於兩個分群。規則適用於所屬分群的全部商戶。並無其他限制。試點為期一個月。不另加應急或審批成本。

body.en: This is a fictional learning assumption. The 30, 20 and 40 percent reduction estimates come from a synthetic two-week observation of 60 merchants, not a controlled trial. Segment-level estimates are uncertain. The budget of HKD 6,000 is fixed and cannot be exceeded. Cost figures are monthly. Late reply counts are monthly. The pilot owner has not confirmed whether reminder timing affects merchant behaviour.
body.zh: 此為虛構學習假設。30%、20%及40%的減幅估算來自為期兩週、涵蓋60間商戶的合成觀察，並非對照試驗。分群層面的估算存在不確定性。6,000港元預算固定，不可超支。成本數字為每月。延遲回覆數字為每月。試點負責人尚未確認提醒時間是否影響商戶行為。

label.en: Which rule combination costs exactly HKD 6,000 per month, the full hard budget?
label.zh: 哪個規則組合每月成本剛好為6,000港元，即用盡硬性預算？

label.en: Rules A, B and C together
Which statement about rule scope is correct?
label.zh: 關於規則適用範圍，哪項陳述正確？

label.en: Rule A applies only to Segment X
Rule B applies only to Segment X
Rule C applies only to Segment Y
All three rules apply to both segments
label.zh: 三項規則均適用於兩個分群

label.en: Using the stated segment-aware additive method, what is the estimated monthly reduction in late replies for Rule A plus Rule B?
label.zh: 按所述分群相加方法，規則A加規則B的預計每月延遲回覆減幅是多少？

label.en: Using the stated segment-aware additive method, what is the estimated monthly reduction in late replies for Rule B plus Rule C?
label.zh: 按所述分群相加方法，規則B加規則C的預計每月延遲回覆減幅是多少？

label.en: Which affordable combination gives the largest estimated monthly reduction in late replies within the hard budget?
label.zh: 在硬性預算內，哪個可負擔組合帶來最大的預計每月延遲回覆減幅？

label.en: Rules A, B and C together
Which statement best reflects the evidence quality?
label.zh: 哪項陳述最能反映證據質素？

label.en: The estimates come from a controlled trial
The estimates come from a synthetic two-week observation and are uncertain
label.zh: 估算來自兩週合成觀察，存在不確定性

label.en: Reminder timing is confirmed to change merchant behaviour
label.zh: 已確認提醒時間會改變商戶行為

label.en: The budget can be exceeded if results improve
label.zh: 若成效改善，預算可以超支

about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse a fictional merchant workflow, prioritise requirements and propose a measurable service improvement without making promises about actual driver or platform performance.

description.en: Identifies a specific uncertainty from the fictional evidence notes and explains how it affects confidence in the recommendation.
description.zh: 從虛構證據說明中指出具體不確定性，並解釋其如何影響建議的可信度。

description.en: Writes a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese with a clear recommendation, calculation method and one practical next step.
description.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，包含清晰建議、計算方法及一項實用下一步。

description.en: Connects the recommendation to specific facts from the fictional sources, including costs, segment scope and reduction estimates.
description.zh: 把建議與虛構文件的具體事實連結，包括成本、分群範圍及減幅估算。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites pilot code MEP-07, the HKD 6,000 hard budget, Rule A cost HKD 2,000, Rule B cost HKD 1,500, Rule C cost HKD 4,500, Segment X 70 late replies, Segment Y 50 late replies, and the 30, 20 and 40 percent estimates. Accepts any accurate combination of these facts.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用試點代號 MEP-07、6,000港元硬性預算、規則A成本2,000港元、規則B成本1,500港元、規則C成本4,500港元、分群X 70宗延遲回覆、分群Y 50宗延遲回覆，以及30%、20%及40%估算。接受任何準確的事實組合。

description.en: Shows a correct segment-aware method for combining the stated percentage reductions and reports the resulting monthly reduction figures.
description.zh: 展示正確的分群方法組合所述百分比減幅，並報告相應每月減幅數字。

expectedEvidence.en: Rule A plus Rule B gives 70 times 30 percent plus 50 times 20 percent, which is 21 plus 10, equal to 31 replies. Rule B plus Rule C gives 50 times 20 percent plus 120 times 40 percent, which is 10 plus 48, equal to 58 replies. Rule A plus Rule C gives 70 times 30 percent plus 120 times 40 percent, which is 21 plus 48, equal to 69 replies but costs HKD 6,500 and is unaffordable. Accepts correct arithmetic with the stated segment-aware additive method.
expectedEvidence.zh: 規則A加規則B為70乘以30%加50乘以20%，即21加10，等於31宗。規則B加規則C為50乘以20%加120乘以40%，即10加48，等於58宗。規則A加規則C為70乘以30%加120乘以40%，即21加48，等於69宗，但成本6,500港元，不可負擔。接受按所述分群相加方法的正確運算。

description.en: Selects the affordable combination with the largest estimated reduction within the hard budget and explains why the alternatives are weaker or unaffordable.
description.zh: 在硬性預算內選出減幅最大且可負擔的組合，並解釋其他方案為何較弱或不可負擔。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects Rule B plus Rule C, which costs exactly HKD 6,000 and reduces 58 replies. Rule A plus Rule B costs HKD 3,500 and reduces 31 replies. Rule A plus Rule C costs HKD 6,500 and exceeds the budget. All three rules cost HKD 8,000 and exceed the budget. Accepts a clear statement that Rule B plus Rule C gives the largest estimated reduction among affordable combinations.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選出規則B加規則C，成本剛好6,000港元，減少58宗。規則A加規則B成本3,500港元，減少31宗。規則A加規則C成本6,500港元，超出預算。三項規則同時使用成本8,000港元，超出預算。接受清楚說明規則B加規則C在可負擔組合中帶來最大預計減幅。

description.en: Identifies a specific uncertainty from the fictional evidence notes and explains how it affects confidence in the recommendation.
description.zh: 從虛構證據說明中指出具體不確定性，並解釋其如何影響建議的可信度。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that the 30, 20 and 40 percent estimates come from a synthetic two-week observation of 60 merchants, not a controlled trial, and that segment-level estimates are uncertain. Also accepts noting that reminder timing effects on merchant behaviour are unconfirmed.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出30%、20%及40%估算來自為期兩週、涵蓋60間商戶的合成觀察，並非對照試驗，且分群層面估算存在不確定性。亦接受指出提醒時間對商戶行為的影響尚未確認。

description.en: Writes a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese with a clear recommendation, calculation method and one practical next step.
description.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，包含清晰建議、計算方法及一項實用下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states the recommended rule combination, shows the segment-aware additive percentage method and the monthly reply reduction, and proposes a practical next step such as running a controlled trial or confirming reminder timing effects. Accepts either language.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明建議規則組合，展示分群相加百分比方法及每月減幅，並提出實用下一步，例如進行對照試驗或確認提醒時間影響。接受任一語言。

exemplar.en: This fictional review covers pilot MEP-07 with 400 merchants and 120 monthly late replies. Rule A costs HKD 2,000 and applies only to Segment X, which has 70 late replies. Rule B costs HKD 1,500 and applies only to Segment Y, which has 50 late replies. Rule C costs HKD 4,500 and applies to both segments. The hard monthly budget is HKD 6,000. Rule A plus Rule C costs HKD 6,500, so it is unaffordable. Rule B plus Rule C costs exactly HKD 6,000 and combines 50 times 20 percent plus 120 times 40 percent, which is 10 plus 48, equal to 58 replies reduced. Rule A plus Rule B costs HKD 3,500 and reduces 70 times 30 percent plus 50 times 20 percent, which is 21 plus 10, equal to 31 replies. All three rules cost HKD 8,000 and exceed the budget. I recommend Rule B plus Rule C because it gives the largest estimated reduction among affordable combinations. The main uncertainty is that the percentage estimates come from a synthetic two-week observation of 60 merchants, not a controlled trial, so segment-level results may differ. Next step: run a controlled one-month trial to confirm the reduction before wider rollout.
exemplar.zh: 本虛構檢視涵蓋試點 MEP-07，涉及400間商戶及每月120宗延遲回覆。規則A成本2,000港元，只適用於分群X，該群有70宗延遲回覆。規則B成本1,500港元，只適用於分群Y，該群有50宗延遲回覆。規則C成本4,500港元，適用於兩個分群。每月硬性預算為6,000港元。規則A加規則C成本6,500港元，不可負擔。規則B加規則C成本剛好6,000港元，結合50乘以20%加120乘以40%，即10加48，減少58宗。規則A加規則B成本3,500港元，減少70乘以30%加50乘以20%，即21加10，減少31宗。三項規則同時使用成本8,000港元，超出預算。我建議規則B加規則C，因為它在可負擔組合中帶來最大預計減幅。主要不確定性在於百分比估算來自為期兩週、涵蓋60間商戶的合成觀察，並非對照試驗，因此分群層面結果可能不同。下一步：進行為期一個月的對照試驗，在擴大推行前確認減幅。

title.en: FIMMICK fictional bilingual campaign brand review
title.zh: FIMMICK 虛構雙語推廣活動品牌審查

brief.en: You support a fictional FIMMICK client campaign review. Read the three supplied synthetic documents. Decide which creative variant is content-eligible under the brand rules, calculate the maximum estimated reach gain within the stated hard budget, and confirm the human approval step. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. All figures, policies and records are fictional learning assumptions, not real FIMMICK or client data. This is an independent demo, not endorsed, and not a job opening.
brief.zh: 你協助一項虛構的 FIMMICK 客戶推廣活動審查。請閱讀三份提供的合成文件，判斷哪個創意版本在品牌規則下符合內容資格，計算在指定硬性預算內的最大估計觸及增幅，並確認人手審批步驟。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約100至180英文字或相若中文。所有數字、政策及記錄均為虛構學習假設，並非真實 FIMMICK 或客戶資料。此為獨立示範，未經認可，亦非招聘職位。

body.en: Synthetic client rules for this exercise only. Variant A uses the approved bilingual tagline and shows the price. Variant B uses the approved tagline but omits the price. Variant C uses an unapproved slogan and shows the price. A variant is content-eligible only if it uses the approved tagline and shows the price. Content eligibility is not launch readiness. Any launch also requires one named human approver to confirm the final creative before publishing. No automated tool may approve or publish.
body.zh: 本練習專用的合成客戶規則。版本甲使用已批准的雙語標語並顯示價格。版本乙使用已批准標語但不顯示價格。版本丙使用未批准口號並顯示價格。版本只有在使用已批准標語並顯示價格時才符合內容資格。符合內容資格不等於可推出。任何推出亦須一名具名人員在發佈前確認最終創意。任何自動工具不得審批或發佈。

body.en: Synthetic figures for this exercise only. Baseline estimated reach is 40,000 people. Each 1,000 HKD spent on the approved accessibility caption pack is estimated to increase reach by 1,200 people. The client sets a hard accessibility budget of 6,000 HKD. No other spend is allowed. Reach gain is calculated as spend divided by 1,000, then multiplied by 1,200. The maximum estimated reach gain within the hard budget is the objective.
body.zh: 本練習專用的合成數字。基準估計觸及為40,000人。每花費1,000港元於已批准的無障礙字幕組合，估計觸及增加1,200人。客戶設定無障礙硬性預算為6,000港元，不得有其他支出。觸及增幅計算方式為支出除以1,000，再乘以1,200。目標為在硬性預算內的最大估計觸及增幅。

body.en: Synthetic log for this exercise only. Case ID is FIMMICK-DEMO-04. The log confirms the approved tagline is present in variants A and B. The log confirms the price is shown in variants A and C. The log states the human approver is not yet named. The log states no publishing tool has been used. Uncertainty note: the caption pack estimate is a planning estimate, not a measured result.
body.zh: 本練習專用的合成記錄。個案編號為 FIMMICK-DEMO-04。記錄確認已批准標語見於版本甲及乙。記錄確認價格見於版本甲及丙。記錄指出尚未指定人手審批人。記錄指出未使用任何發佈工具。不確定性備註：字幕組合估算屬規劃估算，並非實測結果。

title.en: Duplicate Report Version Control at a Fictional STC Sample Desk
title.zh: 虛構STC樣本桌的報告重複版本控制

brief.en: You support a fictional STC-style sample desk. Two versions of one synthetic QC report exist and a client asks which is current. Read the three fictional documents, identify the controlling version, check the log outcome, and choose the correct action. All records, staff and policies are invented for this independent demo and are not endorsed by STC. Deliver a concise English handover, or comparable Traditional Chinese, of around 100 to 180 words covering evidence, decision, uncertainty and next steps. Length is a guide, not a strict graded limit.
brief.zh: 你支援一個虛構的STC式樣本桌。同一份合成品質控制報告存在兩個版本，客戶詢問哪一份為現行版本。閱讀三份虛構文件，找出具控制力的版本，核對紀錄結果，並選擇正確行動。所有紀錄、人員及政策均為此獨立示範而虛構，未獲STC認可。提交簡潔的英文交接說明，或相若繁體中文，約100至180字，涵蓋證據、決策、不確定性及下一步。字數僅為指引，並非嚴格評分限制。

body.en: Synthetic register only. Report R-2041 covers sample S-88. Version V1 was issued 3 May with result 12.4 units. Version V2 was issued 9 May with result 12.9 units. The register states that the highest version number is the controlling version. No version was withdrawn. Report R-2042 covers sample S-89 and is unrelated.
body.zh: 僅為合成登記冊。報告R-2041涵蓋樣本S-88。版本V1於5月3日發出，結果為12.4單位。版本V2於5月9日發出，結果為12.9單位。登記冊列明最高版本號為具控制力版本。沒有版本被撤回。報告R-2042涵蓋樣本S-89，與此無關。

body.en: Synthetic policy only. A report version is controlling when its version number is the highest recorded and its status is released. Status values are draft, released or withdrawn. A draft version never controls. If two versions share the highest number, the later issue date controls. Before answering any client query, the desk must complete exactly two checks: confirm the controlling version from the register, and confirm its status from the log.
body.zh: 僅為合成政策。當報告版本的版本號為紀錄中最高且狀態為已發布，該版本即具控制力。狀態值為草稿、已發布或已撤回。草稿版本永不具控制力。若兩個版本共享最高版本號，以較後發出日期者具控制力。在回答任何客戶查詢前，樣本桌必須完成剛好兩項核對：從登記冊確認具控制力版本，並從紀錄確認其狀態。

body.en: Synthetic log only. Entry 1: V1 status released. Entry 2: V2 status released. Entry 3: client query received about R-2041. Entry 4: desk checked register and policy. Entry 5: desk answered the client. No entry records a withdrawal, correction or reissue. The log does not state which version the desk named to the client. The log also does not record the sample identifier S-88.
body.zh: 僅為合成紀錄。第1項：V1狀態為已發布。第2項：V2狀態為已發布。第3項：收到關於R-2041的客戶查詢。第4項：桌面核對登記冊及政策。第5項：桌面回覆客戶。沒有項目記錄撤回、更正或重新發出。紀錄未說明桌面向客戶指稱哪個版本。紀錄亦未記錄樣本識別碼S-88。

description.en: Shows the result difference with correct arithmetic and unit.

expectedEvidence.en: 12.9 minus 12.4 equals 0.5 units.

description.en: Identifies remaining uncertainty and states how to resolve it.

expectedEvidence.en: The log does not confirm which version was communicated. The desk should reissue a corrected confirmation naming V2, using only the records described in the three supplied documents.

expectedEvidence.en: Handover names R-2041, V2 as controlling, the 0.5 unit difference, the log gap and a concrete next step.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接指明R-2041、V2具控制力、0.5單位差異、紀錄缺口及具體下一步。

description.en: Keeps to the fictional synthetic records and avoids inventing policy or real certification claims.
description.zh: 緊守虛構合成紀錄，避免虛構政策或真實認證聲明。

expectedEvidence.en: Refers only to the three supplied synthetic documents and labels the case as a fictional demo.
expectedEvidence.zh: 僅引用三份提供的合成文件，並標示此個案為虛構示範。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Report R-2041 has two released versions. V1 shows 12.4 units and V2 shows 12.9 units. The register states the highest version number controls, and the policy confirms a released highest version controls. Decision: V2 controls. The result difference is 12.9 minus 12.4, which equals 0.5 units. The desk log records the client query and a policy check but not which version was named to the client. It also omits the sample identifier S-88, which source-one links to R-2041. Risk: the client may have received V1, so traceability is incomplete. Next steps: reissue a corrected confirmation naming V2 and note the 0.5 unit difference. This is a fictional demo, not an STC decision.
exemplar.zh: 證據：報告R-2041有兩個已發布版本。V1顯示12.4單位，V2顯示12.9單位。登記冊列明最高版本號具控制力，政策亦確認已發布的最高版本具控制力。決策：V2具控制力。結果差異為12.9減12.4，等於0.5單位。桌面紀錄載有客戶查詢及政策核對，但未記錄向客戶指稱哪個版本。紀錄亦遺漏樣本識別碼S-88，而來源一將其連結至R-2041。風險：客戶可能收到V1，追溯性不完整。下一步：重新發出指明V2的更正確認，並註明0.5單位差異。此為虛構示範，並非STC決定。

title.en: HKTVmall Delivery ETA Assistant: Repairing Unsupported Guarantees
title.zh: HKTVmall 送貨預計到達時間助理：修正不支援的保證

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on a fictional HKTVmall demo team. The delivery ETA assistant (config eta-bot v3.2) tells customers orders will arrive by a guaranteed time, but the fulfilment policy only supports estimates. Repair the configuration so replies use supported wording, then plan a regression test. All policies, staff and records here are invented for learning. This independent demo is not endorsed by HKTV Group and is not a job opening. Write a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 你是虛構 HKTVmall 示範團隊的 AI 工程師。送貨預計到達時間助理（設定 eta-bot v3.2）向顧客表示訂單將於保證時間前送達，但履約政策只支援估算。請修正設定，使回覆使用受支援的措辭，然後規劃回歸測試。此處所有政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此獨立示範未獲 HKTV 集團認可，亦非招聘職位。請撰寫約100至180英文詞或相若中文的簡潔交接說明。

title.zh: 虛構履約預計到達時間政策（節錄）

body.en: This fictional policy governs the demo ETA assistant. Supported wording: 'estimated delivery window' and 'subject to stock and courier conditions'. Unsupported wording: 'guaranteed arrival', 'money-back if late', and any fixed clock time presented as certain. Estimates must show a window of at least two hours. The assistant may state the window only when the order status is 'packed'. If status is 'processing', it must say the window is not yet confirmed. Policy version: eta-policy 4.1, effective 2026-09-01.
body.zh: 此虛構政策規管示範預計到達時間助理。受支援措辭：「預計送貨時段」及「視乎庫存及速遞情況」。不支援措辭：「保證送達」、「遲到退款」，以及任何以確定語氣呈現的固定時刻。估算須顯示至少兩小時的時段。助理只可在訂單狀態為「已包裝」時說明時段。若狀態為「處理中」，須說明時段尚未確認。政策版本：eta-policy 4.1，2026-09-01 生效。

title.en: Fictional ETA Bot Configuration and Log (extract)
title.zh: 虛構預計到達時間機械人設定及日誌（節錄）

body.en: Config eta-bot v3.2, last edited 2026-09-20. Reply template A: 'Your order is guaranteed to arrive by 14:00.' Reply template B: 'Estimated delivery window: 14:00 to 16:00, subject to stock and courier conditions.' Template A is used for all statuses. Log for order F-2201: status 'processing', template A sent. Log for order F-2202: status 'packed', template A sent. No regression tests have run since 2026-09-19.
body.zh: 設定 eta-bot v3.2，最後編輯於 2026-09-20。回覆範本甲：「你的訂單保證於14:00前送達。」回覆範本乙：「預計送貨時段：14:00至16:00，視乎庫存及速遞情況。」範本甲用於所有狀態。訂單 F-2201 日誌：狀態「處理中」，已發送範本甲。訂單 F-2202 日誌：狀態「已包裝」，已發送範本甲。自 2026-09-19 起未執行任何回歸測試。

title.zh: 虛構回歸測試記錄（節錄）

body.en: Last regression run 2026-09-19 on eta-bot v3.1. Cases: packed order shows a two-hour window, pass. Processing order states window not confirmed, pass. Guarantee wording absent, pass. After the v3.2 edit on 2026-09-20, no tests were rerun. The demo team requires a rerun of all three cases plus one new case for the 'processing' status before release. Test environment is a fictional sandbox. No live customer messages are sent.
body.zh: 上次回歸測試於 2026-09-19 在 eta-bot v3.1 執行。案例：已包裝訂單顯示兩小時時段，通過。處理中訂單說明時段尚未確認，通過。保證措辭不存在，通過。2026-09-20 的 v3.2 編輯後，未重跑任何測試。示範團隊要求發佈前重跑全部三個案例，並新增一個「處理中」狀態案例。測試環境為虛構沙盒。不會發送任何真實顧客訊息。

exemplar.en: Evidence: eta-policy 4.1 supports 'estimated delivery window' and 'subject to stock and courier conditions', and bans 'guaranteed arrival' and 'money-back if late'. Config eta-bot v3.2 uses template A for all statuses. Logs F-2201 (processing) and F-2202 (packed) both received template A, two breaches. Decision: replace template A with template B, which shows a two-hour window, for packed orders only. For processing orders, state the window is not yet confirmed. Record the corrected version as eta-bot v3.3. Test plan: rerun the three 2026-09-19 cases and add one processing case, four in total, in the fictional sandbox before release. Risks: stale templates and untested edits. Next steps: apply the fix, run the four cases, and confirm no guarantee wording remains.
exemplar.zh: 證據：eta-policy 4.1 支援「預計送貨時段」及「視乎庫存及速遞情況」，並禁止「保證送達」及「遲到退款」。設定 eta-bot v3.2 對所有狀態使用範本甲。日誌 F-2201（處理中）及 F-2202（已包裝）均收到範本甲，屬兩項違規。決策：對已包裝訂單以顯示兩小時時段的範本乙取代範本甲。處理中訂單須說明時段尚未確認。修正版本記為 eta-bot v3.3。測試計劃：在虛構沙盒中於發佈前重跑 2026-09-19 的三個案例，另加一個處理中案例，共四個。風險：範本過時及未經測試的編輯。下一步：套用修正、執行四個案例，並確認不再出現保證措辭。

feedback.en: You correctly remove the guarantee and money-back wording, adopt template B for packed orders only, require confirmation-not-yet wording for processing, and name the corrected version eta-bot v3.3. The corrected settings and version are unambiguous.
feedback.zh: 你正確移除保證及退款措辭，只對已包裝訂單採用範本乙，處理中訂單要求說明時段尚未確認，並把修正版本命名為 eta-bot v3.3。修正設定及版本清晰明確。

feedback.en: Your plan reruns the three 2026-09-19 cases plus one new processing case, four in total, in the fictional sandbox before release, which matches the team requirement. Good to state expected results per case if you extend this.

feedback.en: You state that processing orders must say the window is not yet confirmed and that estimates remain subject to stock and courier conditions. That correctly limits the assistant's claims to supported estimates.
feedback.zh: 你說明處理中訂單須表示時段尚未確認，估算亦視乎庫存及速遞情況。這正確地把助理的聲稱限制在受支援的估算範圍。

feedback.en: The handover is ordered under evidence, decision, test plan, risks and next steps, and at 121 English words it sits comfortably in the 100 to 180 guidance. It reads as complete and concise for a reviewer.

summary.en: All four structured decisions are correct and your written handover is accurate, complete and well ordered. Every rubric criterion is met at full marks, with strong source traceability and a concrete four-case rerun plan.

work.en:
Evidence: The fictional policy (eta-policy 4.1) allows 'estimated delivery window' and 'subject to stock and courier conditions', and bans 'guaranteed arrival' and 'money-back if late'. Config eta-bot v3.2 uses Template A ('guaranteed to arrive by 14:00') for all statuses, so it breaches the policy. Logs F-2201 (processing) and F-2202 (packed) both sent Template A. The last regression run was 2026-09-19 on v3.1; no tests ran after the 2026-09-20 edit.

Decision and calculations: I will keep Template A because it gives customers a clear time, and just add 'estimated' somewhere. Template B is too vague for customers. For the processing order, I will still show the 14:00 time but add a note that it may change. I will rerun the three old test cases (packed window, processing not confirmed, guarantee wording absent) and skip adding a new case to save time, so 3 cases total.

Risks: Customers may complain if the time slips, but the wording is close enough. The main risk is the demo looking less confident.

Next steps: Edit the config, rerun the three tests, and release.
work.zh:
證據：虛構政策（eta-policy 4.1）允許「預計送貨時段」及「視乎庫存及速遞情況」，並禁止「保證送達」及「遲到退款」。設定 eta-bot v3.2 對所有狀態使用範本甲（「保證於14:00前送達」），因此違反政策。日誌 F-2201（處理中）及 F-2202（已包裝）均發送了範本甲。上次回歸測試於 2026-09-19 在 v3.1 執行；2026-09-20 編輯後未再測試。

決策與計算：我會保留範本甲，因為它給顧客清晰時間，只需在某處加上「預計」。範本乙對顧客太模糊。對於處理中訂單，我仍會顯示14:00時間，但加註可能變更。我會重跑三個舊測試案例（已包裝時段、處理中未確認、保證措辭不存在），並跳過新增案例以節省時間，共3個案例。

風險：若時間延誤，顧客可能投訴，但措辭已足夠接近。主要風險是示範看起來不夠自信。

下一步：編輯設定、重跑三個測試並發佈。

feedback.en: You correctly cite eta-policy 4.1 wording and config eta-bot v3.2, and you note F-2201 and F-2202 in the evidence. However your decisions contradict that evidence, for example you keep Template A and select only F-2201, so the repair link is not valid.
feedback.zh: 你正確引用 eta-policy 4.1 的措辭及 eta-bot v3.2 設定，並在證據部分提及 F-2201 及 F-2202。但你的決策與證據矛盾，例如保留範本甲及只選 F-2201，因此修正連結無效。

feedback.en: Your corrected configuration is not supported, as you keep Template A and only add 'estimated', and you do not state a corrected version. The policy requires Template B for packed orders and a window not confirmed for processing.
feedback.zh: 你的修正設定不獲支持，因為你保留範本甲並只加入「estimated」，亦未說明修正版本。政策要求已包裝訂單使用範本乙，處理中訂單則須說明時段尚未確認。

feedback.en: You correctly recall the three 2026-09-19 cases, but you skip the new processing case required before release. The plan should rerun all three plus one new processing case, four in total, in the sandbox.
feedback.zh: 你正確提及 2026-09-19 的三個案例，但略過了發佈前必須新增的處理中案例。計劃應在沙盒中重跑全部三個案例，另加一個處理中案例，共四個。

feedback.en: You still show 14:00 for processing orders with a note that it may change, but the policy requires saying the window is not yet confirmed. You also do not consistently apply the stock and courier condition.

title.en: HKTVmall Shopping Assistant: Invented Product Dimensions and Load Limits
title.zh: HKTVmall 購物助理：虛構產品尺寸與承重上限

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on a fictional HKTVmall shopping-assistant demo. The assistant invented product dimensions and load limits that were never in the catalogue feed. Review the three fictional sources, choose the corrected configuration, compute the weekly cost impact, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall, not endorsed by HKTV Group, and no real job is offered.
brief.zh: 你是虛構 HKTVmall 購物助理示範的 AI 工程師。助理虛構了目錄饋送中從未提供的產品尺寸與承重上限。請審閱三份虛構文件，選出修正後的設定，計算每週成本影響，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔證據交接。此為受 HKTVmall 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 HKTV 集團認可，亦不涉及真實職位空缺。

body.en: Fictional record. On 6 October the shopping assistant told customers that a listed storage rack had a handle height of 90 cm, a weight of 12 kg, a grip type of soft, and a load limit of 50 kg. The catalogue feed at that time carried no handle-height, weight, grip or load-limit field, so the assistant generated these values from marketing text. None of these attributes was ever verified for that product. The assistant must never state a product attribute that is absent from the feed.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。10月6日，購物助理向顧客表示一件已列儲物架的手柄高度為90厘米、重量為12公斤、握把類型為軟身，以及承重上限為50公斤。當時的目錄饋送並無手柄高度、重量、握把或承重上限欄位，助理是根據營銷文字生成該等數值。該產品從未經核實任何該等屬性。凡饋送中沒有的產品屬性，助理一律不得聲明。

title.zh: 虛構目錄饋送規格 v5

body.en: Fictional specification. Feed v5 adds four attribute fields: handleheight, weight, grip and loadlimit. The field is absent for 40 of 100 listed products. Rule A1: if a field is absent, the assistant must reply that the attribute is not confirmed and must not infer it from any other text. Rule A2: a value may be stated only for the exact product identifier in the feed. Rule A3: grip has exactly two permitted values, soft and hard.
body.zh: 虛構規格。饋送 v5 新增四個屬性欄位：handleheight、weight、grip 及 loadlimit。100件已列產品中有40件並無此欄位。規則 A1：若欄位不存在，助理必須回覆該屬性未經確認，且不得從任何其他文字推斷。規則 A2：只可就饋送中完全相符的產品識別碼聲明數值。規則 A3：grip 僅有兩個允許值：soft 及 hard。

body.en: Fictional note. Current configuration C-7 has no attribute guard and costs HKD 1200 per week. Proposed configuration C-8 adds the A1 and A2 guards and costs HKD 1500 per week. Configuration C-9 adds A1 only and costs HKD 1350 per week. Configuration C-10 adds A2 only and costs HKD 1400 per week. The weekly budget ceiling for this guard is HKD 1600.
body.zh: 虛構備註。現行設定 C-7 並無屬性防護，每週成本 HKD 1200。建議設定 C-8 加入 A1 及 A2 防護，每週成本 HKD 1500。設定 C-9 只加入 A1，每週成本 HKD 1350。設定 C-10 只加入 A2，每週成本 HKD 1400。此防護的每週預算上限為 HKD 1600。

label.en: C-8, adds A1 and A2 guards
label.zh: C-8，加入 A1 及 A2 防護

label.en: What must the assistant reply when an attribute field is absent?

label.en: State that the attribute is not confirmed
State a default value for the attribute

label.en: What is the weekly cost increase of C-8 over C-7, in HKD?

label.en: How many of the 100 listed products have no attribute field?
label.zh: 100件已列產品中有多少件並無屬性欄位？

expectedEvidence.en: A structured handover covering the C-8 decision, the A1 reply rule, HKD 300 weekly increase, 40 products without the field, and a regression test plan for absent fields and exact-identifier matching.
expectedEvidence.zh: 結構化交接涵蓋 C-8 決策、A1 回覆規則、每週 HKD 300 增幅、40件無欄位產品，以及針對欄位不存在及完全相符識別碼配對的回歸測試計劃。

exemplar.en:
Evidence. Source one records that on 6 October the assistant invented a handle height of 90 cm, a weight of 12 kg, a grip of soft and a load limit of 50 kg for a storage rack because the old feed had no such fields. Source two, feed v5, adds handleheight, weight, grip and loadlimit, and rule A1 requires an unconfirmed reply when a field is absent. Rule A2 allows statements only for the exact product identifier. Rule A3 permits only soft and hard for grip. Source three gives costs: C-7 HKD 1200, C-8 HKD 1500, C-9 HKD 1350, C-10 HKD 1400, ceiling HKD 1600.

Decision. Adopt C-8 because it adds both A1 and A2 and stays within the HKD 1600 ceiling. C-9 lacks A2 and C-10 lacks A1, so each leaves a gap. The weekly increase is 1500 minus 1200, that is HKD 300. Source two states 40 of 100 products have no attribute field, so those must receive the unconfirmed reply.

Risks. Absence of a value means unconfirmed, not a default, so wording must not overclaim. Next steps. Run regression tests for absent fields and exact-identifier matching, and monitor invented-attribute reports weekly.
exemplar.zh:
證據。文件一記錄10月6日助理因舊饋送並無該等欄位，為一件儲物架虛構手柄高度90厘米、重量12公斤、握把類型軟身及承重上限50公斤。文件二饋送 v5 新增 handleheight、weight、grip 及 loadlimit，規則 A1 要求當欄位不存在時回覆未經確認。規則 A2 只容許就完全相符的產品識別碼作出聲明。規則 A3 就 grip 僅允許 soft 及 hard。文件三列出成本：C-7 為 HKD 1200，C-8 為 HKD 1500，C-9 為 HKD 1350，C-10 為 HKD 1400，上限 HKD 1600。

決策。採用 C-8，因其同時加入 A1 及 A2，且低於 HKD 1600 上限。C-9 缺 A2，C-10 缺 A1，各有缺口。每週增幅為 1500 減 1200，即 HKD 300。文件二說明100件產品中有40件並無屬性欄位，該等產品必須回覆未經確認。

風險。沒有值代表未經確認，而非預設值，措辭不得過度聲明。下一步。就欄位不存在及完全相符識別碼配對執行回歸測試，並每週監察虛構屬性報告。

title.en: Paid-channel budget comparison for a fictional client campaign
title.zh: 虛構客戶推廣活動的付費渠道預算比較

brief.en: You support a fictional client campaign at FIMMICK. Review the two supplied synthetic records and recommend how to allocate a hard paid-media budget of HKD 60,000 across two channels. All figures, policies and approvals in the records are fictional learning assumptions, not real FIMMICK or client data. This is an independent demo and is not endorsed. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese.
brief.zh: 你為 FIMMICK 一個虛構客戶推廣活動提供支援。請審閱兩份提供的合成記錄，就兩個渠道之間如何分配 HKD 60,000 的硬性付費媒體預算提出建議。記錄內所有數字、政策及審批均屬虛構學習假設，並非真實 FIMMICK 或客戶資料。此為獨立示範，未獲認可。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文篇幅。

body.en: Fictional record for campaign HK-2210. Channel A: baseline spend HKD 20,000, baseline conversions 100. Channel B: baseline spend HKD 20,000, baseline conversions 80. A test added HKD 10,000 to each channel on top of its baseline. Channel A gained 40 additional conversions and Channel B gained 30 additional conversions. The test ran once and was not repeated. All conversions are counted once. No other channels are in scope. Figures are synthetic and for learning only.
body.zh: 活動 HK-2210 的虛構記錄。渠道甲：基準支出 HKD 20,000，基準轉換 100 次。渠道乙：基準支出 HKD 20,000，基準轉換 80 次。測試在各自基準之上，向每個渠道額外增加 HKD 10,000。渠道甲增加 40 次額外轉換，渠道乙增加 30 次額外轉換。測試只進行一次，並無重複。所有轉換只計算一次。沒有其他渠道在範圍內。數字屬合成，僅供學習。

title.en: Synthetic budget, approval and planning rules
title.zh: 合成預算、審批與規劃規則

body.en: Fictional rules for campaign HK-2210. Total paid-media budget is HKD 60,000 and must not be exceeded. Each channel must receive at least HKD 15,000. Any spend above HKD 40,000 on one channel needs written client approval before launch. The client has confirmed approval for Channel A up to HKD 45,000 only. Channel B has no extra approval. Brand safety review is complete for both channels. For planning only, assume additional conversions scale linearly with spend from HKD 15,000 to HKD 45,000 on Channel A, and from HKD 15,000 to HKD 40,000 on Channel B. This linear model is an assumption, not a measured result. These rules are synthetic learning assumptions.
body.zh: 活動 HK-2210 的虛構規則。付費媒體總預算為 HKD 60,000，不得超出。每個渠道最少須獲 HKD 15,000。單一渠道支出超過 HKD 40,000 須於推出前取得客戶書面批准。客戶已確認僅批准渠道甲最高 HKD 45,000。渠道乙沒有額外批准。兩個渠道的品牌安全審查均已完成。僅供規劃之用，假設額外轉換在渠道甲由 HKD 15,000 至 HKD 45,000、在渠道乙由 HKD 15,000 至 HKD 40,000 之間隨支出線性延伸。此線性模型屬假設，並非實測結果。此等規則屬合成學習假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that the test is synthetic, ran once and is small, that the linear scaling is an assumption rather than a measured result, and that extra conversions may not scale linearly. States that any spend above HKD 40,000 on one channel needs written client approval and that Channel B has no extra approval.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出測試屬合成、只進行一次且規模小，線性延伸屬假設而非實測結果，額外轉換未必線性延伸。說明單一渠道支出超過 HKD 40,000 須取得客戶書面批准，渠道乙沒有額外批准。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, structured with evidence, decision, risks and next steps, and avoids unsupported claims about real FIMMICK or client data.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文篇幅，結構包含證據、決策、風險及下一步，並避免對真實 FIMMICK 或客戶資料作出無根據陳述。

description.en: Keeps all statements within the fictional learning assumptions and does not present them as real company policy
description.zh: 所有陳述限於虛構學習假設，並不將其表述為真實公司政策

expectedEvidence.en: Labels the records as synthetic learning assumptions, states this is an independent demo not endorsed by FIMMICK, and does not claim a current job opening or real client account.
expectedEvidence.zh: 將記錄標示為合成學習假設，說明此為獨立示範且未獲 FIMMICK 認可，並不聲稱現有職位空缺或真實客戶帳戶。

exemplar.en: Evidence: In synthetic record HK-2210, Channel A gained 40 additional conversions per HKD 10,000 test spend, while Channel B gained 30. That is HKD 250 per additional conversion for Channel A and HKD 333 for Channel B, so Channel A is more efficient. The total paid-media budget is HKD 60,000 and each channel needs at least HKD 15,000. Decision: allocate Channel A HKD 45,000 and Channel B HKD 15,000. This meets the budget cap and minimum, and HKD 45,000 is within the client's confirmed approval for Channel A only. Under the stated linear planning model, Channel A HKD 45,000 gives 100 additional conversions and Channel B HKD 15,000 gives minus 15 relative to its HKD 20,000 baseline, totalling 85, the highest of the options. Risks: the test is synthetic, ran once and is small, and the linear scaling is an assumption rather than a measured result, so extra conversions may not scale linearly. Channel B has no approval above HKD 40,000. Next steps: confirm written approval for Channel A at HKD 45,000, then launch and monitor actual conversions. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by FIMMICK.
exemplar.zh: 證據：在合成記錄 HK-2210 中，渠道甲每 HKD 10,000 測試支出增加 40 次轉換，渠道乙增加 30 次。即渠道甲每次額外轉換 HKD 250，渠道乙 HKD 333，渠道甲較有效率。付費媒體總預算為 HKD 60,000，每渠道最少須 HKD 15,000。決策：分配渠道甲 HKD 45,000、渠道乙 HKD 15,000。此符合預算上限及下限，且 HKD 45,000 在客戶僅對渠道甲確認的批准範圍內。在列明的線性規劃模型下，渠道甲 HKD 45,000 帶來 100 次額外轉換，渠道乙 HKD 15,000 相對其 HKD 20,000 基準為負 15 次，合共 85 次，為各選項中最高。風險：測試屬合成、只進行一次且規模小，線性延伸屬假設而非實測結果，額外轉換未必線性延伸。渠道乙在 HKD 40,000 以上沒有批准。下一步：確認渠道甲 HKD 45,000 的書面批准，然後推出並監察實際轉換。此為獨立示範，未獲 FIMMICK 認可。

title.en: HKTVmall Delivery ETA Assistant: Unsupported Guarantee Diagnosis
title.zh: HKTVmall 送貨預計時間助理：無依據保證診斷

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on a fictional HKTVmall delivery ETA assistant simulation. Customers saw a guaranteed 30-minute arrival window the assistant cannot support. Review the three synthetic records, identify the root cause, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. State the cause, the evidence, the corrected configuration, and a regression test plan. Policies, staff and records are invented for learning. This simulation is independent and not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 你是虛構 HKTVmall 送貨預計時間助理模擬的 AI 工程師。顧客看到助理無法支持的 30 分鐘保證送達時段。請查閱三份虛構記錄，找出根本原因，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據交接說明。說明原因、證據、修正設定及回歸測試計劃。政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此模擬獨立進行，未獲 HKTV 集團認可。

title.zh: 預計時間助理設定記錄 v3.2

body.en: Fictional configuration for this simulation. Assistant build ETA-3.2. Template rule T-14 states: show a guaranteed arrival window only when the courier tracking feed reports status confirmed and the remaining stop count is 3 or fewer. Rule T-14 was changed on 2026-09-18 from advisory wording to guaranteed wording. No approval record exists for that wording change. The confidence threshold remains 0.80.
body.zh: 此為本模擬的虛構設定。助理版本 ETA-3.2。範本規則 T-14 訂明：只有當速遞追蹤資料顯示狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 3 或以下時，才顯示保證送達時段。規則 T-14 於 2026-09-18 由提示字眼改為保證字眼。該字眼改動並無審批記錄。信心門檻維持 0.80。

body.en: Fictional log for this simulation. Case C-501: customer saw guaranteed 30-minute window, parcel arrived after 95 minutes. Case C-502: customer saw guaranteed 30-minute window, parcel arrived after 70 minutes. Case C-503: customer saw advisory wording only, parcel arrived within the window. All three cases used assistant build ETA-3.2. Cases C-501 and C-502 had tracking status confirmed and remaining stop count 6. Case C-503 had remaining stop count 2.
body.zh: 此為本模擬的虛構記錄。個案 C-501：顧客看到 30 分鐘保證時段，包裹於 95 分鐘後送達。個案 C-502：顧客看到 30 分鐘保證時段，包裹於 70 分鐘後送達。個案 C-503：顧客只看到提示字眼，包裹於時段內送達。三個個案均使用助理版本 ETA-3.2。個案 C-501 及 C-502 的追蹤狀態為 confirmed，剩餘站點數為 6。個案 C-503 的剩餘站點數為 2。

body.en: Fictional plan for this simulation. Test set R-7 contains 12 synthetic cases. Each case states tracking status, remaining stop count and expected wording. Expected wording is guaranteed only when status is confirmed and remaining stop count is 3 or fewer. Advisory wording is expected in all other cases. Of the 12 cases, 5 have status confirmed and remaining stop count 3 or fewer. The other 7 cases do not meet both conditions. The plan must be rerun after any change to rule T-14. No test case may use real customer data.
body.zh: 此為本模擬的虛構計劃。測試集 R-7 包含 12 個虛構個案。每個個案列明追蹤狀態、剩餘站點數及預期字眼。只有當狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 3 或以下時，預期字眼才為保證。其他情況一律預期提示字眼。12 個個案中，5 個的狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 3 或以下。其餘 7 個個案不符合兩項條件。任何對規則 T-14 的改動後，計劃必須重跑。測試個案不得使用真實顧客資料。

label.en: What is the root cause of the unsupported guarantee?
label.zh: 無依據保證的根本原因是甚麼？

label.en: Rule T-14 wording was changed to guaranteed with no approval record and without matching the stop-count condition
label.zh: 規則 T-14 字眼改為保證，並無審批記錄，且未配合剩餘站點數條件

label.en: The confidence threshold of 0.80 is too low
The courier tracking feed was delayed
Which pair of cases best shows the guarantee appeared outside the allowed condition?

label.en: C-501 and C-502, both confirmed with remaining stop count 6
label.zh: C-501 及 C-502，兩者均為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 6

label.en: How many of the 12 test cases in R-7 should expect guaranteed wording?
label.zh: R-7 的 12 個測試個案中，有多少個應預期保證字眼？

label.zh: 在所有情況下把 T-14 還原為提示字眼

Accept any answer naming the T-14 wording change, the absence of an approval record, and the stop-count mismatch. Do not require a claim that approval was definitely absent.

exemplar.en: Evidence: Rule T-14 in build ETA-3.2 was changed on 2026-09-18 from advisory to guaranteed wording, and no approval record exists for that change. Cases C-501 and C-502 show guaranteed 30-minute windows while tracking status was confirmed and remaining stop count was 6, outside the 3-or-fewer condition. Case C-503 used advisory wording with stop count 2 and arrived within the window. Root cause: the T-14 wording change was not matched to the stop-count condition. Corrected configuration: keep guaranteed wording but enforce it only when status is confirmed and remaining stop count is 3 or fewer. Regression test plan: rerun test set R-7 after any T-14 change, check expected wording against status and stop count, and use no real customer data. Of the 12 cases, 5 meet both conditions and should expect guaranteed wording. Risks: the log covers three cases only and the wording change source is unconfirmed. Next steps: confirm the change source, rerun R-7, and monitor wording after release.
exemplar.zh: 證據：版本 ETA-3.2 的規則 T-14 於 2026-09-18 由提示字眼改為保證字眼，該改動並無審批記錄。個案 C-501 及 C-502 在追蹤狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 6 時顯示 30 分鐘保證時段，超出 3 或以下條件。個案 C-503 使用提示字眼，剩餘站點數為 2，並於時段內送達。根本原因：T-14 字眼改動未配合剩餘站點數條件。修正設定：保留保證字眼，但只在狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 3 或以下時才顯示。回歸測試計劃：任何 T-14 改動後重跑測試集 R-7，按狀態及剩餘站點數核對預期字眼，且不使用真實顧客資料。12 個個案中，5 個符合兩項條件，應預期保證字眼。風險：記錄只涵蓋三個個案，字眼改動來源未確認。下一步：確認改動來源、重跑 R-7，並於發布後監察字眼。

feedback.en: You correctly identify rule T-14's 2026-09-18 wording change to guaranteed with no approval record, and you tie it to cases C-501 and C-502 showing guaranteed windows at remaining stop count 6, outside the 3-or-fewer condition. Case C-503 is used well as the contrasting control.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出規則 T-14 於 2026-09-18 改為保證字眼且無審批記錄，並連結到個案 C-501 及 C-502 在剩餘站點數為 6 時仍顯示保證時段，超出 3 或以下條件。個案 C-503 作為對照亦運用得宜。

feedback.en: Your corrected configuration keeps guaranteed wording only when status is confirmed and remaining stop count is 3 or fewer, which matches the R-7 expected wording exactly. This is consistent and complete.
feedback.zh: 你的修正設定保留保證字眼，但只在狀態為 confirmed 且剩餘站點數為 3 或以下時才顯示，與 R-7 的預期字眼完全一致。此設定一致且完整。

feedback.en: The plan reruns test set R-7 after any T-14 change, checks expected wording against status and stop count, and states that no real customer data is used. You also note that 5 of the 12 cases meet both conditions, matching the count answer.
feedback.zh: 計劃在每次 T-14 改動後重跑測試集 R-7，按狀態及剩餘站點數核對預期字眼，並說明不使用真實顧客資料。你亦指出 12 個個案中有 5 個符合兩項條件，與數字答案一致。

feedback.en: You state that the log covers only three cases and that the wording change source is unconfirmed, which frames the limits of the evidence honestly. The handover structure and 160-word length are clear and within the suggested range.
feedback.zh: 你指出記錄只涵蓋三個個案，且字眼改動來源未確認，誠實交代證據限制。交接結構清晰，160 字亦在建議範圍內。

feedback.en: You keep strictly to the fictional records, avoid real customer data, and make no claim that HKTV Group or HKTVmall endorsed this simulation. No unsupported assertions appear.
feedback.zh: 你嚴格使用虛構記錄，避免真實顧客資料，亦無聲稱 HKTV 集團或 HKTVmall 認可此模擬。並無無依據的聲稱。

summary.en: All four structured answers are correct and the handover covers cause, evidence, corrected configuration, regression plan, risks and next steps with specific source facts. The work is complete, evidence-based and appropriately cautious at roughly 160 English words.
summary.zh: 四項結構化答案全部正確，交接說明涵蓋原因、證據、修正設定、回歸計劃、風險及下一步，並引用具體文件事實。全文約 160 英文字，完整、有證據支持且措辭審慎。

nextSteps.en: Confirm the actual source of the T-14 wording change and whether any retroactive approval exists before release. Then rerun R-7, add a check that fails the build when guaranteed wording appears without both conditions, and monitor customer-facing wording after deployment.
nextSteps.zh: 在發布前確認 T-14 字眼改動的實際來源，以及是否存在追溯審批。然後重跑 R-7，加入當保證字眼在兩項條件未同時成立時即令建置失敗的檢查，並在部署後監察面向顧客的字眼。

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent learning simulation inspired by the company, not endorsed, no current vacancy). A customer asks about an accessible experience. All policies, records and staff here are fictional. Read the three sources, answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of around 100 to 180 words (or comparable Chinese). Cover the case identifier, confirmed condition, functional need, fee decision, uncertainty and next step. Do not infer mobility capability from a concern.
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（受該公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，未經認可，並非現有職位）。有客戶查詢無障礙體驗。本模擬所有政策、紀錄及員工均屬虛構。閱讀三份文件，回答問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字（或相若中文）的簡潔證據為本交接，涵蓋個案編號、已確認狀況、功能需要、費用決定、不確定事項及下一步。不得從疑慮推斷行動能力。

body.en: Fictional policy for this simulation only. Case KX-4471 concerns an accessible experience. A booking may be changed without fee only when the customer confirms a functional need and the supplier confirms an accessible option. Confirmation must come from the customer, not from a concern alone. While either confirmation is missing, the fee decision is held and no fee is charged. If both confirmations exist, the HKD 300 standard change fee is waived. If the customer confirmation exists but the supplier cannot confirm within 2 working days, escalate to the accessibility desk. Refund is not offered in this case.
body.zh: 本政策僅適用於本模擬。個案 KX-4471 涉及無障礙體驗。只有當客戶確認功能需要，且供應商確認有無障礙選項時，預訂才可免費更改。確認須來自客戶，不得僅憑疑慮。只要其中一項確認欠缺，費用決定暫緩，不收取任何費用。若兩項確認齊備，300 港元標準更改費可獲豁免。若客戶確認已備但供應商未能在 2 個工作日內確認，須轉交無障礙專責組。本個案不提供退款。

body.en: Fictional record. Customer: Mr Chan. Enquiry: accessible experience. Customer confirmed functional need: step-free access to the venue entrance. Customer did not state any mobility capability. Supplier reply pending. Supplier has not yet confirmed an accessible option. Booking value HKD 1,200. Requested change date is 14 November. No refund requested. No other cases linked.
body.zh: 虛構紀錄。客戶：陳先生。查詢：無障礙體驗。客戶已確認功能需要：場地入口需無障礙通道。客戶沒有說明任何行動能力。供應商回覆待定。供應商尚未確認無障礙選項。預訂金額 1,200 港元。要求更改日期為 11 月 14 日。沒有要求退款。沒有其他相連個案。

body.en: Fictional note for this simulation only. The standard change fee is HKD 300. While either confirmation is missing, the fee is held, so no charge is raised and no waiver is recorded. The fee is waived only after both confirmations exist. The fee is charged only after both confirmations exist and the waiver condition is not met. The accessibility desk reviews cases after 2 working days without supplier confirmation.

title.en: HKTVmall Order-Support Assistant: Cancellation Exception Handover

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on an independent learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall, not endorsed by it. Our fictional order-support assistant mishandled cancellation requests. Read the three invented source documents, answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese explaining the cause, the corrected configuration and a regression test plan. All policies, staff, logs and records are fictional learning assumptions. Do not execute code. A helpful target is around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 你是獨立學習模擬項目的 AI 工程師，本項目受 HKTVmall 啟發但未獲其認可。我們的虛構訂單支援助理錯誤處理取消請求。請閱讀三份虛構文件，回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，解釋成因、修正設定及回歸測試計劃。所有政策、職員、日誌及記錄均為虛構學習假設。請勿執行代碼。建議目標約為100至180英文詞或相應中文。

body.en: Fictional policy for this simulation only. A customer may cancel free of charge while the order status is Packing and the courier has not caused a delay. Once status becomes Shipped, cancellation is refused and the customer is directed to the return flow. Exception precedence: the Shipped rule always overrides the Packing rule. For a Packing order only, if the courier caused a delay and the parcel has not left the warehouse, support may cancel only after a supervisor confirms. The assistant must never cancel a Shipped order. Policy v3 replaced v2 on 1 September.
body.zh: 此為本模擬專用的虛構政策。當訂單狀態為「包裝中」且速遞商未造成延誤，顧客可免費取消。狀態一旦變為「已發貨」，取消會被拒絕，顧客會轉往退貨流程。例外優先次序：「已發貨」規則永遠凌駕「包裝中」規則。僅就「包裝中」訂單，若延誤由速遞商造成且包裹尚未離開倉庫，支援人員僅可在主管確認後取消。助理絕不可取消「已發貨」訂單。政策 v3 於9月1日取代 v2。

body.en: Fictional log for this simulation only. Order A100 status Packing, no delay, customer asked to cancel, assistant replied correctly. Order B200 status Shipped, courier caused a delay, assistant cancelled it, which broke policy v3. Order C300 status Packing, no delay, assistant refused cancellation, which was wrong. The assistant was still reading policy v2, which allowed cancellation of Shipped orders when a courier delay occurred.
body.zh: 此為本模擬專用的虛構日誌。訂單 A100 狀態為「包裝中」，無延誤，顧客要求取消，助理回覆正確。訂單 B200 狀態為「已發貨」，延誤由速遞商造成，助理取消訂單，違反政策 v3。訂單 C300 狀態為「包裝中」，無延誤，助理拒絕取消，屬錯誤。助理仍在讀取政策 v2，該版本允許在速遞延誤時取消「已發貨」訂單。

body.en: Fictional notes for this simulation only. Each test case states one order status, whether the courier caused a delay, whether the parcel has left the warehouse, and the expected assistant action. Test T1: Packing, no delay, parcel in warehouse, expected cancel. Test T2: Shipped, courier delay, parcel in warehouse, expected refuse and direct to return flow. Test T3: Packing, courier delay, parcel in warehouse, expected cancel only after supervisor confirmation. A test passes only when the assistant action matches the expected action exactly.
body.zh: 此為本模擬專用的虛構筆記。每個測試案例列出一項訂單狀態、延誤是否由速遞商造成、包裹是否已離開倉庫，以及預期助理行動。測試 T1：包裝中，無延誤，包裹在倉庫，預期取消。測試 T2：已發貨，速遞延誤，包裹在倉庫，預期拒絕並轉往退貨流程。測試 T3：包裝中，速遞延誤，包裹在倉庫，預期僅在主管確認後取消。只有當助理行動與預期行動完全一致，測試才算通過。

title.en: Shopping assistant invents unsupported product dimensions and load limits

brief.en: In this fictional simulation you support the HKTVmall shopping assistant team. A customer asked whether a folding walking frame suits outdoor use. The assistant replied with a 150 kg weight limit and a waterproof claim that appear in no product record. Review the synthetic sources, decide the correct reply, choose the safest configuration change, and calculate the corrected listing total from two components only. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese, covering evidence, decision, risk and next steps. Policies, staff and records here are invented for learning. This independent demo is not endorsed by HKTV Group.
brief.zh: 在此虛構模擬中，你支援 HKTVmall 購物助理團隊。有顧客查詢一款摺合助行架是否適合戶外使用，助理回覆了一個產品記錄中並不存在的150公斤承重上限及防水聲稱。請審閱合成文件，決定正確回覆，選擇最安全的設定變更，並只以兩項組成部分計算修正後的產品頁總額。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約100至180英文字或相應中文字，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。此處政策、職員及記錄均為學習而虛構。此獨立示範未獲 HKTV 集團認可。

body.en: Synthetic log, case A-114. Customer asked if the folding walking frame suits outdoor use. Assistant replied: maximum user weight 150 kg, fully waterproof, safe in rain. The product record lists no weight limit and no waterproof rating. The assistant cited no source. The reply was sent at 10:12. The customer has not yet ordered.
body.zh: 合成記錄，個案 A-114。顧客查詢摺合助行架是否適合戶外使用。助理回覆：最高使用者體重150公斤、完全防水、可在雨中安全使用。產品記錄並無列出承重上限，亦無防水等級。助理沒有引用任何來源。回覆於10:12發出。顧客尚未下單。

All names, versions, logs and policies here are fictional learning assumptions, not real company code or policy. This is an independent demo, not endorsed by any company and not a job opening. Do not run code.

body.en: Fictional log TL-9 for change CR-114 by developer K. Lau. Before: retries = 0, timeout = 10 seconds. After: retries = 3, timeout = 4 seconds. expectedEvidence.en: Retries are allowed only for 5xx responses and network timeouts. 400 and 401 must not be retried. Acceptable alternative wording that keeps the same scope.

description.en: Identifies the two rules broken by the 401 retry and the 12 second wait.

description.en: Supplies a concrete corrected patch that restricts retries, reuses the same idempotency key on retry, and keeps the zero-based page bounds.
description.zh: 提出具體修正，限制重試、在重試時重用同一冪等鍵，並保留零基頁界線。

expectedEvidence.en: Patch retries only when status >= 500 or a network timeout occurs, reuses one idempotency key per physical request instead of calling newKey() each attempt, and keeps start = page * size and end = (page + 1) * size. Acceptable alternative code with the same behaviour.
expectedEvidence.zh: 修正只在狀態 >= 500 或網絡逾時時重試，每個實際請求重用一個冪等鍵而非每次呼叫 newKey()，並保留 start = page * size 及 end = (page + 1) * size。可接受行為相同的其他程式碼。

description.en: Gives the seconds over the wait limit and the minimum number of required tests with a clear method.

expectedEvidence.en: 12 minus 8 equals 4 seconds over the limit. Minimum tests is 2, one 5xx success test and one 400 non-retry test.
expectedEvidence.zh: 12 減 8 等於超出上限 4 秒。最少測試數為 2，一個 5xx 成功測試及一個 400 不重試測試。

description.en: Notes what the synthetic logs do not show and avoids treating fictional records as real company facts.

expectedEvidence.en: Logs do not show network timeout behaviour, do not show whether the 8 second limit is enforced in code, and do not show test results. Records are fictional learning assumptions.
expectedEvidence.zh: 日誌未顯示網絡逾時行為，未顯示程式碼有否執行 8 秒上限，亦未顯示測試結果。紀錄屬虛構學習假設。

exemplar.en: Handover for CR-114. Evidence: the change sets retries to 3 and timeout to 4 seconds and retries all failures. The contract allows retries only for 5xx responses and network timeouts, so 400 and 401 must not be retried. Log L-1 shows a 401 retried 3 times with total wait 12 seconds. This breaks two rules: no retry for client errors, and maximum total wait of 8 seconds. The overage is 12 minus 8, which is 4 seconds. The retry count of 3 is within the limit. Log L-2 shows a 503 succeeding on attempt 4, which is allowed. No tests were added, but the contract requires at least 2 tests, one 5xx success and one 400 non-retry. Corrected patch: retry only when status >= 500 or a network timeout occurs, and create one idempotency key before the loop so every retry of the same physical request reuses it. Keep start = page * size and end = (page + 1) * size. Risk: the logs do not show network timeout behaviour or whether the wait limit is enforced in code. Next steps: apply the patch, enforce the 8 second wait limit, add the two tests, and request review before merge.
exemplar.zh: CR-114 交接說明。證據：改動把重試設為 3 次、逾時設為 4 秒，並對所有失敗重試。合約只允許對 5xx 回應及網絡逾時重試，因此 400 及 401 不得重試。日誌 L-1 顯示 401 重試 3 次，總等待 12 秒。這違反兩項規則：客戶端錯誤不得重試，以及最長總等待 8 秒。超出量為 12 減 8，即 4 秒。重試 3 次本身未超出上限。日誌 L-2 顯示 503 於第 4 次嘗試成功，屬允許情況。沒有新增測試，但合約要求最少 2 個測試，一個 5xx 成功及一個 400 不重試。修正：只在狀態 >= 500 或網絡逾時時重試，並在迴圈前建立一個冪等鍵，令同一實際請求的每次重試都重用它。保留 start = page * size 及 end = (page + 1) * size。風險：日誌未顯示網絡逾時行為，亦未顯示程式碼有否執行等待上限。下一步：套用修正，執行 8 秒等待上限，新增兩個測試，並在合併前要求審查。

All thresholds, budgets and records are invented learning assumptions, not legal standards. Read the two source documents, answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. State the claim decision, the calculation method, sample limits and one uncertainty. Do not treat scenario thresholds as official limits.

title.en: Synthetic monitoring records and scenario thresholds

body.en: Fictional client claim CL-204. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards. Water sample W-1: zinc 2.4 mg/L against a scenario threshold of 2.0 mg/L. Water sample W-2: zinc 1.6 mg/L. Soil sample S-1: lead 95 mg/kg against a scenario threshold of 120 mg/kg. Soil sample S-2: lead 130 mg/kg. Only W-1 and S-2 exceed their scenario thresholds. The client claim asks for a full site pass. The client budget for any follow-up sampling is HKD 5,000.
body.zh: 虛構客戶申索CL-204。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。水樣W-1：鋅2.4毫克／升，情境門檻為2.0毫克／升。水樣W-2：鋅1.6毫克／升。泥土樣本S-1：鉛95毫克／千克，情境門檻為120毫克／千克。泥土樣本S-2：鉛130毫克／千克。只有W-1及S-2超出其情境門檻。客戶申索要求全場合格。客戶就任何跟進採樣的預算為5,000港元。

title.en: Synthetic sampling limits and follow-up options
title.zh: 合成採樣限制及跟進選項

body.en: Fictional learning assumptions. Each water sample is one grab sample from one point in time. Each soil sample is one composite from one depth. No duplicate samples were taken. Zinc and lead results are single laboratory measurements with no stated measurement uncertainty. Follow-up option A: resample W-1 only, estimated cost HKD 2,800. Option B: resample S-2 only, estimated cost HKD 3,200. Option C: resample W-1 and S-2, estimated cost HKD 6,000. Option D: no follow-up, estimated cost HKD 0. The client budget is HKD 5,000. Costs are estimates and no contingency is included. Selection rule: maximise covered exceedances within the HKD 5,000 budget. If two plans cover the same number of exceedances, choose the plan with the lower total cost.
body.zh: 虛構學習假設。每個水樣為單一時點單一採集樣本。每個泥土樣本為單一深度單一混合樣本。沒有採集重複樣本。鋅及鉛結果為單一化驗測量，並無註明測量不確定度。跟進選項甲：只重新採集W-1，估計費用2,800港元。選項乙：只重新採集S-2，估計費用3,200港元。選項丙：重新採集W-1及S-2，估計費用6,000港元。選項丁：不作跟進，估計費用0港元。客戶預算為5,000港元。費用為估算，不包括應急費用。選擇規則：在5,000港元預算內涵蓋最多超標項目。若兩個方案涵蓋相同數目超標項目，選擇總費用較低者。

label.en: Which statement best describes the client claim for a full site pass?
label.zh: 哪項陳述最能描述客戶要求全場合格的申索？

label.en: The claim is supported because all samples are below threshold
label.zh: 申索成立，因為所有樣本均低於門檻

label.en: The claim is not supported because W-1 and S-2 exceed their scenario thresholds
label.zh: 申索不成立，因為W-1及S-2超出其情境門檻

label.en: The claim is not supported because only W-1 exceeds its scenario threshold
label.zh: 申索不成立，因為只有W-1超出其情境門檻

label.en: The claim cannot be assessed from the supplied records
label.zh: 根據所提供紀錄無法評估申索

label.en: How many of the four samples exceed their scenario thresholds?
label.zh: 四個樣本中有多少個超出其情境門檻？

label.en: Which follow-up option best fits the HKD 5,000 budget while covering the most exceedances?
label.zh: 哪個跟進選項最符合5,000港元預算，並涵蓋最多超標項目？

label.en: Option A: resample W-1 only, HKD 2,800, covers one exceedance
label.zh: 選項甲：只重新採集W-1，2,800港元，涵蓋一項超標

label.en: Option B: resample S-2 only, HKD 3,200, covers one exceedance
label.zh: 選項乙：只重新採集S-2，3,200港元，涵蓋一項超標

label.en: Option C: resample W-1 and S-2, HKD 6,000, covers two exceedances but exceeds budget
label.zh: 選項丙：重新採集W-1及S-2，6,000港元，涵蓋兩項超標但超出預算

label.en: Option D: no follow-up, HKD 0, covers no exceedances
label.zh: 選項丁：不作跟進，0港元，不涵蓋任何超標

label.en: Which limitation most affects interpretation of the single results?
label.zh: 哪項限制最影響單一結果的解讀？

label.en: No duplicate samples and no stated measurement uncertainty
label.zh: 沒有重複樣本，亦無註明測量不確定度

label.en: The client budget is too low for any laboratory work
label.zh: 客戶預算太低，無法進行任何化驗工作

label.en: The scenario thresholds are legal discharge standards
label.zh: 情境門檻為法定排放標準

label.en: Soil samples were taken from more than one depth
label.zh: 泥土樣本取自多於一個深度
