The only weakness is length, as the handover exceeds the suggested word range without adding material evidence. This reflects your independent simulated submission only and is not a certification or employment judgement.

title.en: Fictional usability findings for saved-route settings
title.zh: 已儲存路線設定的虛構易用性研究結果

body.en: Fictional study, 12 participants, synthetic prototype. Finding A: 9 of 12 could not tell whether a saved-route change applied immediately. Finding B: 8 of 12 expected an undo option after deleting a saved route. Finding C: 7 of 12 missed the confirmation message because it appeared for 2 seconds. Finding D: 5 of 12 wanted to compare two saved routes side by side. The fictional design budget allows one pattern only. Patterns: inline undo banner, two-step confirmation dialog, or side-by-side comparison panel.
body.zh: 虛構研究，12名參與者，合成原型。發現A：12人中有9人無法分辨已儲存路線變更是否即時生效。發現B：12人中有8人預期刪除已儲存路線後可復原。發現C：12人中有7人因確認訊息只顯示2秒而錯過。發現D：12人中有5人希望並排比較兩條已儲存路線。虛構設計預算只容許一種模式。模式：行內復原橫幅、兩步確認對話框，或並排比較面板。

title.zh: 虛構無障礙及互動要求

body.en: Fictional internal requirements, not external standards claims. Requirement 1: every destructive action must offer a reversible path. Requirement 2: status messages must remain visible for at least 5 seconds or until dismissed. Requirement 3: any reversible action must be available for at least 10 seconds after the change. Requirement 4: comparison views are optional and out of scope for this release. The fictional budget covers one pattern. A pattern may satisfy more than one requirement. The inline undo banner pattern is defined as follows: after any saved-route change or deletion, the banner shows a status message and an Undo control, both remain continuously available for at least 10 seconds, and the Undo control is labelled Undo. The Undo control restores the previous saved-route state, including restoring a route after deletion.
body.zh: 虛構內部要求，並非外部標準聲明。要求1：每項破壞性操作必須提供可復原途徑。要求2：狀態訊息必須至少顯示5秒，或直到使用者關閉。要求3：任何可復原操作必須在變更後至少10秒內可用。要求4：比較檢視屬可選，不在本次發佈範圍。虛構預算涵蓋一種模式。一個模式可滿足多於一項要求。行內復原橫幅模式定義如下：任何已儲存路線變更或刪除後，橫幅顯示狀態訊息及復原控制項，兩者持續至少10秒內可用，復原控制項標示為「復原」。復原控制項會還原先前的已儲存路線狀態，包括在刪除後還原路線。

label.zh: 哪一種模式最符合虛構預算及要求？

exemplar.en: Recommendation: use the inline undo banner as the single pattern. Finding B shows 8 of 12 participants expected an undo option after deleting a saved route, and Requirement 1 requires a reversible path for every destructive action. The banner also meets Requirement 3 because the undo stays available for at least 10 seconds, and it can meet Requirement 2 by keeping the status message visible for at least 5 seconds or until dismissed. Finding C supports this visibility change. Finding D is out of scope under Requirement 4. The study used 12 participants on a synthetic prototype, so results are directional only and do not prove behaviour in a live service. Next step: test whether 10 seconds is long enough for slower interactions and confirm the banner wording is understood.

title.en: Journey Disruption Notice: Error Recovery Review
title.zh: 行程受阻通知：錯誤復原檢視

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by MTR Corporation, not endorsed by it and not a job opening. You are a UX designer reviewing a fictional passenger app disruption notice. Read the three synthetic documents. Answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese. Recommend the best partial funded plan and state clearly whether release can be approved. All internal thresholds, records, budgets and findings are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 此為受港鐵公司啟發的虛構模擬，未獲港鐵公司認可，亦非招聘職位。你是用戶體驗設計師，正檢視虛構乘客應用程式的行程受阻通知。請閱讀三份合成文件，回答問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔且以證據為本的交接說明，英文約100至180字或相若中文。請建議最佳的局部資助方案，並清楚說明可否批准發布。所有內部門檻、記錄、預算及發現均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional study, 8 participants, 2 tasks. Task A: 6 of 8 participants could not find the recovery action after a notice error. Task B: 5 of 8 could not tell whether the notice applied to their line. Average time to locate recovery: 41 seconds. Internal design requirement: recovery action must be visible within 10 seconds for at least 7 of 8 participants. No real passengers were involved.
body.zh: 虛構研究，8名參與者，2項任務。任務A：8人中有6人在通知出錯後找不到復原操作。任務B：8人中有5人無法判斷通知是否適用於其路線。平均尋找復原時間：41秒。內部設計要求：至少8人中有7人須在10秒內看到復原操作。不涉及真實乘客。

body.en: Fictional notice states: normal, disrupted, recovery. Recovery state must show one clear action and one reason. Draft copy uses the word error twice and offers two actions of equal visual weight. Fictional accessibility requirement: status text must not rely on colour alone and must be readable at 200 percent zoom. Draft fails the zoom check at 200 percent. No real service information is used.
body.zh: 虛構通知狀態：正常、受阻、復原。復原狀態須顯示一個清晰操作及一個原因。草稿文案兩次使用「錯誤」一詞，並提供兩個視覺比重相同的操作。虛構無障礙要求：狀態文字不得只靠顏色表達，且須在200%縮放下可讀。草稿在200%縮放檢查中不合格。不使用真實服務資訊。

body.en: Fictional options. Option A: single primary recovery action, plain reason line, colour plus icon plus text. Estimated reduction in recovery time: 18 seconds. Cost 12,000 HKD. Option B: two equal actions, larger text only. Estimated reduction: 6 seconds. Cost 5,000 HKD. Option C: single primary action plus zoom fix. Estimated reduction: 24 seconds. Cost 16,000 HKD. Hard budget: 15,000 HKD. Options can stack only if stated. A and B do not stack. A and C overlap and do not stack. B and C stacking is not stated, so B and C do not stack. Option A does not fix the 200 percent zoom failure. Only Option C fixes the 200 percent zoom failure. All mandatory fixes must be in place before launch.
body.zh: 虛構選項。選項A：單一主要復原操作、簡明原因行、顏色加圖示加文字。預計復原時間減少：18秒。成本12,000港元。選項B：兩個同等操作，僅放大文字。預計減少：6秒。成本5,000港元。選項C：單一主要操作加縮放修正。預計減少：24秒。成本16,000港元。硬性預算：15,000港元。選項僅在明確說明時可疊加。A與B不疊加。A與C重疊，不疊加。B與C疊加並未說明，因此B與C不疊加。選項A不修正200%縮放不合格。只有選項C修正200%縮放不合格。所有強制修正須在發布前完成。

label.en: How many participants failed to find the recovery action in Task A?
label.zh: 任務A中有多少名參與者找不到復原操作？

label.en: Which option gives the maximum estimated reduction within the hard budget?
label.zh: 在硬性預算內，哪個選項帶來最大預計減幅？

label.en: Which statement about stacking is correct?
label.zh: 關於疊加的陳述，哪項正確？

label.en: A and B do not stack, A and C do not stack, and B and C do not stack
label.zh: A與B不疊加，A與C不疊加，B與C亦不疊加

label.en: Which accessibility check does the draft fail?
label.zh: 草稿在哪項無障礙檢查中不合格？

label.en: Status text relies on colour alone
label.zh: 狀態文字只靠顏色表達
沒有無障礙檢查不合格

label.en: Given the mandatory requirements and the hard budget, what is the correct release decision?
label.zh: 在強制要求及硬性預算下，正確的發布決定是甚麼？

label.en: Approve launch with Option A because it is within budget
label.zh: 以選項A批准發布，因其在預算內

label.en: Approve launch with Option C because it fixes zoom
label.zh: 以選項C批准發布，因其修正縮放

label.en: Do not approve launch because the 200 percent zoom fix is unfunded and the 10 second and 7 of 8 threshold is unproven
label.zh: 不批准發布，因200%縮放修正未獲資助，且10秒及8人中7人門檻未經證實

label.en: What is the estimated reduction for Option C in seconds?
label.zh: 選項C的預計減幅是多少秒？

expectedEvidence.en: Identifies the 200 percent zoom failure, notes only Option C fixes it and exceeds budget, so the zoom fix remains unresolved pending funding, and recommends colour plus icon plus text so status does not rely on colour alone.

exemplar.en: Evidence: the fictional study shows 6 of 8 participants could not find the recovery action, average 41 seconds, against a 10 second requirement for 7 of 8. The draft also fails the 200 percent zoom check. Decision: choose Option A, a single primary recovery action with a plain reason line and colour plus icon plus text. Calculation: Option A costs 12,000 HKD and reduces 18 seconds, within the 15,000 HKD hard budget. Option C reduces 24 seconds but costs 16,000 HKD, over budget. A and B do not stack, A and C do not stack, and B and C do not stack. Option A does not fix the 200 percent zoom failure, so it is a partial funded improvement, not a releasable compliant design. 41 minus 18 equals 23 seconds estimated average, which is not evidence that the 10 second and 7 of 8 threshold is met. Release decision: do not approve launch, because the mandatory 200 percent zoom fix is unfunded and the 10 second and 7 of 8 threshold is unproven. Risks: the sample is small and fictional, and the zoom fix is unresolved pending funding. Next steps: escalate the budget gap, retest with 8 participants against the 10 second and 7 of 8 thresholds, and secure funding for the zoom fix before launch.
exemplar.zh: 證據：虛構研究顯示8人中有6人找不到復原操作，平均41秒，而要求為8人中7人須在10秒內完成。草稿亦在200%縮放檢查中不合格。決策：選擇選項A，即單一主要復原操作，配簡明原因行及顏色加圖示加文字。計算：選項A成本12,000港元，減少18秒，在15,000港元硬性預算內。選項C減少24秒，但成本16,000港元，超出預算。A與B不疊加，A與C不疊加，B與C亦不疊加。選項A不修正200%縮放不合格，因此屬部分資助改善，並非可發布的合規設計。41減18等於23秒預計平均，並不證明已達10秒及8人中7人門檻。發布決定：不批准發布，因強制的200%縮放修正未獲資助，且10秒及8人中7人門檻未經證實。風險：樣本小且屬虛構，縮放修正因資金未定而尚未解決。下一步：上報預算缺口，以8名參與者按10秒及8人中7人門檻重測，並在發布前為縮放修正取得資金。
